s1_mathilde.why: 灵格底子是二档，但她出身不明，十几年只做接生婆，再没上弦，只留着两件弓手年月的旧附魔件，所以减到一档。衣裳照接生婆的路子穿，实用，不加装饰。
s1_mathilde.battle: Going out on a night that might turn bad, in two pieces of old wall gear kept from her bow years: the oilcloth cloak fastened at the throat over a grey wall-issue enchanted leather-and-plate jack, its edges stitched with a thin rune line glowing faint blue-white; on the left forearm a salvaged steel bow-vambrace with one small lit crystal at the wrist, the old bowstring wound above it; the skirt kilted up over leggings and boots, the medicine pouch tied shut. She holds a plain old hunting bow low in her left hand with one arrow loose between the fingers of her right, the string she once drew every day; a steady, level look.

s1_dietrich.why: 他是退下墙的老刀手，如今靠箍桶过日子，家境贫，所以从灵格减到一档。从箱底翻出来的只有一件旧甲和一块机兵甲片。他靠隐息伏击，符文要压暗。
s1_dietrich.battle: On the night the inspectors came, in the old wall knife-man's gear dug out of the chest: the canvas apron off, a dark salvaged enchanted brigandine buckled over the shirt, its rune lines banked down to a dim blue so they do not show in the doorway shadow; a scarred forearm plate cut from a clockwork war machine strapped to the left arm, its etched circuit barely lit; boots; the string of brass clasps at his belt, each with a faint rune mark of his own. A plain long knife held low behind his leg in his right hand, a heavy cooper's mallet hanging at his left hip; he stands in a doorway with the weight on the back foot, a hard, level stare.

s1_selka.why: 她是段城兵户出身，家境本该减档。不过墙上发给她的整套旧附魔甲已经穿了二十年，修得合身，正合二档，所以不加也不减。
s1_selka.battle: Holding the gate, in the full wall-issue harness she wore for twenty years: the old grey enchanted half-plate buckled tight, the breast plate rubbed bright, a rune line along its edges glowing faint blue-white and one magic crystal still lit at the breastbone; matching re-strapped pauldron and vambraces over the rolled sleeves; the oilcloth cloak thrown back. She grips a short spear low in her right hand and a round wall-issue shield in her left, a dull crystal set in its iron boss, the feet planted wide in the middle of the passage so that it looks half as wide; a flat, unmoving stare.

s1_simon.why: 刻名匠不出手，他的手艺也不能拿来打仗，所以不穿甲。只把挂钩上的灯换成这一纪满地都是的符文灯，照他天黑就发花的眼。
s1_simon.battle: A man who does not fight; the stone-carver at work on the wall at dusk: the dust-whitened smock, the leather apron tied on, nothing of the war on him; beside him on a hook hangs a small salvaged rune lantern with a pale crystal flame, close enough to light the letters for his dimming eyes. He is cutting a name with a narrow chisel held in his left hand and the wooden mallet raised in his right, leaning in close to the stone; a squinting, absorbed stare.

s1_koen.why: 他是启源的孤儿，不打仗。炉边干活的孩子身上只多一件捡来的机兵甲片，拿来挡烫，手里的遮光灯不换。
s1_koen.battle: Running a night errand through the streets: the sheepskin coat buttoned to the collar, the apron tied close, the pouch of chisels slung across his chest, boots laced tight; strapped over his right forearm a scorched brass-jointed plate cut from a clockwork war machine, given him at the forge as a burn guard, its etched rune circuit glinting faintly. He holds a small shuttered lantern out in front of him in both hands to light the way; he carries no weapon.

s1_lynn.why: 她是见习生，守在病床边，不出手，殿里也不给她发甲。她的本事在烛和面包上，照原句不改。
s1_lynn.battle: Not a fighter; on the night watch beside a sickbed: the grey robe buttoned to the collar, the flour apron tied on, a white candle lit and held upright in both hands in front of her. She keeps her feet together and her chin up, an earnest, steady look; she carries no weapon.

s1_karsten.why: 他是共鸣斥候，家里五代当兵，家境一般，所以是在斥候衣裳外头加两三件捡来的轻附魔件。斥候要藏身，符文压暗，家传的铜铃照旧挂着。
s1_karsten.battle: Scouting the line, in light salvaged scout gear: the short sand-coloured cloak pulled forward with the white-edged hood up, under it a thin grey wall-issue enchanted brigandine with its blue-white rune lines dimmed to a glimmer; rune-etched steel vambraces, the left one worn below the blackened family bell; the rope coiled across his chest with small rune knots, the muffled bells in his belt beside a small crystal cell. The short knife drawn and held low in his right hand, the left hand spread flat as if feeling the air; a crouching, listening, narrow-eyed stance.

s1_arno.why: 他是上弦手，不打仗。只添一件机兵前臂拆下来的护手，防的是年轻时咬掉他半截小指的那种膝关节。钩杆和摇柄照旧。
s1_arno.battle: Not a fighter; winding the line of kneeling machines at dawn: the oil-soaked canvas jacket, the whistle at his neck, and the one piece of war gear the yard ever gave him, a brass-jointed forearm guard cut from a clockwork soldier's arm strapped over his left hand and wrist against the knee joints, its etched circuit faintly lit. A long hooked pole in his right hand and a small crank handle in his left, bent to turn a key set in a kneeling machine's back; a focused, careful look.

s1_tova.why: 她是灵格，深井匠家出身，家境中等，所以是一套改合身的炉前工甲。料子取自机兵和深井自家的掘进魔像，符文是炉火色。她从不带灯，这一样不添。
s1_tova.battle: At the furnace mouth, in Deepwell forge-harness: the thick leather apron tied tight and faced with riveted plates of salvaged war-machine steel, a faint rune line glowing ember-orange in each seam; heavy brass-jointed forearm guards of Deepwell make, cut from an old digging golem's arms, etched with glowing runes; iron-capped boots with runed toe-plates planted wide; she carries no lamp. She holds a great forge hammer upright in both hands with its head on the floor, a long chisel stuck in her belt, the glow of the furnace on her face; a hard, steady stare.

s1_mika.why: 她是共鸣的捡骨孩子，不打仗。身上的护件都是从死机兵上撬下来的，拿绳子绑着，旧军外套照样罩在外头。
s1_mika.battle: Climbing into a fallen machine, in what she has prised off the dead ones: the oversized army coat buttoned up, the sleeves rolled, under it a small dented chest plate cut from a clockwork machine and re-strapped with rope, one dull crystal still glimmering in its socket; a brass-jointed knee guard on each leg; a rope tied round her waist and a bag of ash at her belt. She holds the crowbar upright in both hands in front of her like a staff, the knife tucked into her belt, braced low; a wary, determined frown.

s1_matthias.why: 他是共鸣，段城号手家刚被裁下来，家境贫，所以只在旧号手皮甲外头加两三件墙上的附魔件。长号和短枪不换。
s1_matthias.battle: On the gate tower at the signal, in salvaged wall-herald's gear: the leather jerkin buckled tight under a grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass, re-strapped, a thin rune line along its edge glowing faint blue-white; one old enchanted pauldron on the left shoulder; rune-etched vambraces; the horn's shoulder strap on, rubbed shiny. The polished horn lifted to his lips in both hands with the bell pointing up and out, the runed mouth-ring glinting, the short spear leaning at his side; his chest filled, a fierce, focused look.

s1_tira.why: 她是灵格，长辙家赶车几代，家境中等，所以是一套照半身人身量改小的旧附魔路甲。车铃里存着青风，所以铃泛淡绿。
s1_tira.battle: Holding a wagon train together, in a carter family's fitted road harness: the short leather coat buttoned up and lined at chest and back with small salvaged enchanted plates cut down to her size, a rune line glowing blue-white at the collar; rune-etched vambraces over the forearms with one small lit crystal at each wrist; the bell-ringed hem swinging, the brass bells glinting pale green with stored wind, the braid tucked into her collar. She holds a long cart whip coiled in one hand and the lead rein of two startled mules in the other, braced on the driver's bench; a sharp, level stare.

s1_nico.why: 他是灵格护卫，盐蹄家六代按路程收钱，家境中等，所以是一套改合身的旧附魔护车甲。三枚家传铜扣钉在胸甲上，倒钩短枪不换。
s1_nico.battle: On caravan guard, in the Saltshoe family's refitted guard harness: an old enchanted half-plate buckled over the leather armour, the three Saltshoe copper buttons riveted to its breast, wall-ward rune lines glowing faint blue-white down its edges; a single enchanted pauldron on the left shoulder with one lit crystal; rune-etched steel vambraces; a slit at the back for the tail. The barbed spear gripped low in both hands with a small rune plate on its head, ready to hook a rider off a mule, weight on the back foot, ears pinned flat, tail low and stiff; a hard, level stare.

s1_hano.why: 他是十岁、刚从车上赎出来的孩子，不打仗，也没人给他东西，所以照原句不改。往后几页他在雨城记名字，照样不靠装备。
s1_hano.battle: Not a fighter; standing guard over the wagon in the dark: the hemp shirt buttoned up to the neck under an old wool jacket, cloth boots, a rope belt. He holds a small shuttered lantern in both hands in front of him and watches the road, his weight steady, a wary, unblinking stare.

s1_melchior.rank: 灵格（估，原页没写，照洁墙执石的身份估）
s1_melchior.why: 他是验血官，不出手，洁墙的灰袍和领口白石就是他的那一身。他只信日光、不信灯火，法器是白石和银针，所以照原句不改。
s1_melchior.battle: Not a fighter; at his work in the courtyard: the grey robe buttoned to the throat, sleeves rolled back from the wrists. In the full light of the day he holds a white stone up to the sun in his left hand and a thin silver needle in his right, bent to look at it; a patient, precise look.

s1_himmel.why: 他是传奇，照档用这一纪最好的附魔甲，但他一向朴素，腰上是掉了漆的仿剑，斗篷毛边越拖越长。所以甲不刻纹章、不镀金，符文藏在铆钉里，只透一点淡蓝。
s1_himmel.battle: Ready for a hard night on the wall, in plain gear of the very best make: the flax cloak thrown back over a close-fitted brigandine of the finest enchanted plates covered in plain blue cloth, no crest and no gilding, rune lines along the hidden rivets showing only a faint pale-blue glow; a plain enchanted vambrace of the same steel on the right forearm, the left sleeve buttoned tight over the faintly glowing arm. He grips the worn plain sword upright in his right hand before him, the blade lit by a pale blue glow, and counts heads with a glance over his shoulder; a calm, determined stance.

s1_heiter.why: 传奇不看家境，档在最顶。可他是守床治伤的白烛祭司，从不出手，所以不穿甲，这一纪最好的东西都落在法袍和护符上。酒囊和没点的烛头一样不动。
s1_heiter.battle: Healing on the line, in the finest healer's vestments of the age rather than armour: the white robe belted tight, its narrow gold trim re-stitched with ward thread whose engraved runes glow a soft warm white, the wax-stiffened hem lined with a thin band of old enchanted silk that sheds a faint protective shimmer; a heavy old White Candle reliquary charm on a chain at the chest, its pale crystal lit; the sleeves pushed up, the glasses on, a needle and thread tucked in one sleeve. His right palm lifted and glowing with a soft white light, the other hand on the worn wine flask at his belt with its never-lit white candle stub in the mouth; he kneels on one knee and does not fight.

s1_eisen.why: 传奇不看家境，用的是顶上的那一身。他念旧，斧面的坑不许敲平，所以没有换新，而是由深井的大匠把老盔、老甲、老斧原样重锻刻纹。
s1_eisen.battle: Holding the ground, in his old Deepwell harness reforged by the clan's master smiths rather than replaced: the old horned iron helmet with the nose guard, now banded with deep-cut rune grooves that glow a low forge-orange; the Deepwell chain shirt rewoven with rune-lit iron links and a pair of massive iron pauldrons engraved with clan runes, buckled tight; rune-etched iron vambraces; the faded red cloak thrown over one shoulder; the small brass lamp lit at his thick belt. He grips the single-edged Deepwell axe in both hands across his body with the pitted face outward, faint forge-light glowing in the rune lines along its back. The feet planted wide, the white beard braids with their iron rings hanging over the mail; an immovable, level stare.

s1_baltina_teen.why: 原页没写位阶，照她能一个人压住一队护卫估作灵格。她是门洞里长大的孩子，家里穷，又不跟人动手，所以只把斗篷和护臂换成捡来的附魔件，不披甲。跨页往上走的时候，照样不靠装备。
s1_baltina_teen.battle: Not a fighter; on the road at dusk with something to settle, in a few salvaged ward pieces over her travelling clothes: the grey cloak fastened at the throat with the plain clasp, the hood back, its worn hem stitched with an old ward thread that glows faint blue-white; plain leather bracers over the sleeves with a thin salvaged enchanted steel plate riveted on each, a tiny lit crystal at one wrist; the leather-bound notebook open in her left hand. Her right palm is held upward and a small steady smokeless lamp flame burns in it; she keeps her chin level, a calm, serious look.

s1n_sirin.why: 灵格本来是二档，她是渡口提夫林人家出身，家里穷，降一档，就是在渡工衣服外头罩几件捡来的附魔件。跟样张对得上，照样张交回。
s1n_sirin.battle: Holding the crossing, in salvaged war gear over her ferry clothes: a grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass from the last great war, re-strapped with tarred ferry rope, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along its edge and one small magic crystal still lit in its socket at the breastbone; on the left shoulder a single pauldron cut from a clockwork war machine's forearm plate, etched with a glowing rune circuit; both forearms in brass-jointed vambraces salvaged from the same machine; a small rune lantern with a pale crystal flame hangs at the broad belt; the trousers bound at the shins with cloth strips, bare feet planted wide. She holds the long white-ash pole crosswise in both hands like a quarterstaff, the fish-skin-wrapped butt angled forward and capped with a ring of old enchanted steel that glows faint blue. The brows drawn together, the mouth set.

s1n_sene.why: 原页没写位阶，她跟妲蕾格同时凝名，估作英雄，到了这一阶就不看家境。她是盐湖干活的人，不拿兵器，所以料子用好的、量身做，样子还是干活的衣服。盐白的双臂和赤脚要露在外头。
s1n_sene.battle: Holding back the brine, in plain made-to-measure gear of the finest stuff kept to working-clothes cut: the deep green sleeveless smock belted tight with the hem tucked up, over it a fitted sleeveless cuirass of brine-cured enchanted leather made for her, unadorned, its seams traced with thin sea-green rune lines that glow faintly wet; a plain enchanted gorget hidden under the collar; close-wrapped grey wool leggings, bare feet, the pale cyan braids tied back with a strip of cloth, the small blue glass bottle at her belt. Both salt-white arms are flung wide and bare, a thin arc of brine rising from her palms and crusting into white salt ribs along her forearms; the orange-gold eyes hard, the mouth set.

s1n_nathan.why: 原页没写位阶，照他二十八岁就是自学的魔导天才，估作灵格。他门洞出身，家里穷，本该落到一档，可机兵零件他自己会拆会改，所以给二档的一套改合身的旧件。他不拿兵器，只拿刻令笔。
s1n_nathan.battle: Working in the field, in a machinist's rig he refitted himself from war-machine salvage: a short dark-blue coat with brass buttons over the white shirt, a fitted salvaged machine chest plate under the leather apron, etched with a rune circuit glowing faint blue; brass gear-jointed guards at both elbows; a forearm plate on the left arm set with a lit crystal cell; a satchel of tools across the chest, a small crystal lantern at the belt, thick work gloves on both hands, the brass goggles pulled down over the eyes. He holds up a long brass engraving stylus whose rune-lit tip glows blue, ready to cut a command line into a machine's armour, NOT holding any weapon.

s1n_wigbert.why: 原页没写位阶，照段守的位子估作极境。他出身旧兵户，家底中等，到了极境家境也差不多抹平了。穿成套的附魔战装，招牌是父亲那把镶龙骨的长刀。对他来说仗一直没打完，所以照常披挂。
s1n_wigbert.battle: Storming a gate, in a full matched set of refitted wall war-plate: the old family mail hauberk rewoven with rune-lit links under a fitted enchanted breastplate and heavy pauldrons, their edges glowing blue-white, crystal sockets lit at the shoulders; the deep red surcoat with the white numeral 13 over it; enchanted steel gauntlets with rune-etched knuckles; a grey-brown wool cloak thrown back over the shoulders. In both hands he raises his father's long blade, a long straight single-edged sword, NOT a curved sword, an ivory-grey strip of ancient dragon bone inlaid along its spine and a crackle of crimson lightning running down the edge; a cold, set face.

s1n_zettel.why: 他是机兵所的书记，从来不出手，又嫌机兵上的锈，不碰零件。所以不穿甲，只在跟车的旅装上加一件买来的护符和一盏路灯。
s1n_zettel.battle: On the road with a convoy of crates, unarmoured as ever: the dark grey coat buttoned to the throat with the black sleeve guards, a grey wool travelling cloak over the shoulders whose hem carries a cheap bought ward thread glowing faintly blue-white, a small enchanted ward charm pinned at the collar, a flat grey felt hat, sturdy boots; a small rune lantern hangs at the belt beside the brass machine-office plaque. He clutches the ledger shut against his chest; he never fights and holds no weapon.

s1n_rudolf.why: 他是极境，又是上城北坡老宅的家主，家底加一档，用量身做的整套。他在井底干的是见不得人的事，所以甲藏在皮外套底下，不露家纹。招牌是家传的绞链。
s1n_rudolf.battle: At the bottom of the shaft, in a tailored harness made for him and kept out of sight: a long dark leather coat cut to his frame, lined with slim enchanted plates whose seams glow a dull bronze, over a fine short shirt of rune-lit mail; a fitted gorget, no house crest anywhere; a broad belt, heavy boots, an enchanted leather glove on the right hand only, the left hand bare with the iron ring. The heirloom chain is wrapped twice around his right forearm and hangs from his fist, its old rune-cut links lighting up one by one in a dull bronze glow and lifting like a snake; a calm, cold face.

s1n_ferian.why: 约22年他的名字凝住，所以估作英雄。他看一眼就能熄掉附魔火和晶匣里的晶，身上挂附魔件反倒碍事，所以不披甲，也不带会亮的东西，只穿厚实的好料子。
s1n_ferian.battle: Wearing nothing enchanted, since his own gaze would snuff any crystal or rune-light on him: the silver-grey coat of thick good wool buttoned to the throat, a short dark grey wool cape over the shoulders, the cravat tucked in, plain black gloves, no plate, no lit crystal, no charm. He holds no weapon: one hand raised before his face with two fingers lifted as if about to pinch out a flame, the amber-gold eyes glowing, the mouth closed.

s1n_enoch.why: 原页没写位阶，照他的逆祷和烬兽估作极境。他的逆祷倒着念，能松开祷词管着的东西，护符和刻纹到他身上都靠不住；火又伤不了他，所以照旧什么都不披。
s1n_enoch.battle: Wearing no ward or rune-plate at all, since his backward prayers unbind them and fire cannot hurt him anyway: the purple coat buttoned to the throat, its too-long sleeves scorched dark at the cuffs, the jabot tucked in, a short dark grey wool capelet, the small round felt cap. He holds no weapon: one too-long sleeve raised near his chin as he recites a prayer backwards, small embers and tongues of flame curling around his hands without burning him, the eyes open and wary, the mouth closed.

s1n_mabel.why: 原页没写位阶，她是年轻的白烛医者，估作共鸣。门洞出身，家里穷，又不拿兵器，所以在法袍外头只罩一件捡来的墙上附魔件，再挂一盏灯。
s1n_mabel.battle: On the wall on a bad night, a single salvaged ward piece over her healer's robe: the white gold-edged robe under a navy wool cloak with the hood thrown back; a grey wall-issue enchanted gorget-and-shoulder guard strapped over the cloak, a rune line glowing faint blue-white along its edge, one small crystal lit; the sleeves tied up with tapes, a leather satchel of bandages across the body, a small rune lantern hanging from its strap. She holds no weapon: both hands held forward, a soft white healing light between the palms, a determined face.

s1n_perrin.why: 他是守门人的帮手，肺被烟熏坏了，家里穷，就在墙上发的旧外套外头罩两三件捡来的附魔件。他不拿兵器，只举那盏灯。
s1n_perrin.battle: Keeping the gate at night, in a few salvaged war pieces over his work clothes: the oversized grey-brown wall coat belted with a rope, a grey wall-issue enchanted pauldron strapped on the left shoulder, its rune line glowing faint blue-white; a brass gear-jointed vambrace from a clockwork war machine on the lantern arm; a sand-coloured short cloak with white cloth strips sewn round the hood, the long rust-red scarf, a small brass whistle on a cord at the chest. He holds no weapon, only a horn-shuttered lantern with a pale crystal flame raised in one hand, the other arm flung out wide as if barring a doorway, a stubborn grin.

s1n_maribel.pref: 照常（守着做她的人给的那身裙子）
s1n_maribel.why: 原页没写位阶，照她的法术估作灵格。她是工程师手里改出来的机关人偶，配一套改合身的旧件，可那身黑红裙子是做她的人给的，样子不换，甲件都缝进裙子里。
s1n_maribel.battle: In battle the black-and-crimson gown her maker made, refitted with salvaged enchanted pieces built into it: thin obsidian-black enchanted plates sewn into the bodice, their edges glowing faint frost-white; a fitted black half-cape over the shoulders lined with small articulated plates; a red-gold gearwork gorget over the choker with a small lit crystal; the lace headdress tied tight, black gloves on the left hand only. One bare right hand raised palm out with a faint glowing lotus pattern on the palm, small luminous squares lighting up one by one around her and frost-white light gathering at her fingertips; a flat, cold stare. She holds no weapon.

s1n_eckbert.why: 原页没写位阶，估作灵格。他是守盐路门的边军世家的二少爷，穿家里传下来的整套，所以从二档抬到三档。剑不出鞘，真正的兵器是那只封蜡的血瓶。
s1n_eckbert.battle: Leading thirty gate soldiers to the well, in his house's handed-down enchanted harness: fine rune-lit riveted mail under a fitted breastplate and vambraces of old wall steel engraved with the gate-tower crest, the grooves glowing faint blue-white; the grey-brown wall coat over it, a sand-coloured short cloak over one shoulder, leather gloves, a straight enchanted arming sword sheathed at his left hip and left untouched. A flat oak bottle case with a brass latch hangs open on a strap across his chest, rows of small vials inside; in his raised right hand he holds up one narrow-necked glass vial of dark red blood stoppered with red sealing wax pressed with a seal, his thumb on the wax. Calm and precise, not angry.

s1n_dalreg.rank: 传奇（系冰那一夜是英雄）
s1n_dalreg.why: 系冰那一夜她刚入英雄，英雄不看家境，用量身打的战装。她的钱都花在给人修船上，平时就是深蓝长外套和木槌，所以甲是好料子，样子不加装饰。身上的鳞本来就是她的甲。
s1n_dalreg.battle: Holding the ice on the frost river, in plain made-to-measure war gear with no ornament: the navy long coat buttoned tight over a fitted unadorned iron-grey enchanted cuirass, its seams glowing faint frost blue, under a grey wolf-fur short mantle; the scaled forearms bare. A thick enchanted iron ferry chain, its links cut with frost runes, is wound twice around her forearm and gripped hand over hand in both fists, braced to haul; frost-blue light leaks from between her scales, a thin pale breath of frost at her lips, NOT a cigarette. The feet wide, the weight on the front foot, the tail braced behind her, the jaw set.

s1n_efelin.why: 传奇位阶，用的是这一纪顶上的那一身，到这个位阶不再看晨栎家的家世；他是学院教官，长相写的是素铜发扣、不戴首饰，弓也是一把素的精灵长弓，所以料子用最好的，样子不加装饰。
s1n_efelin.battle: Calling the watch, in the finest old war gear worn plain: a weathered grey-green field coat buttoned to the throat over a long elven scale shirt from the last great war, its fine overlapping plates of old enchanted steel lit by a faint blue-white rune line along every row, no ornament anywhere; fitted steel vambraces etched with a single ward rune; a small crystal cell glowing pale at the belt; the plain elven longbow slung across his back, one thin rune line along its heartwood. With both hands he lifts a tall wooden banner pole high, the old torn and patched blue banner of a bow-and-tower company unfurled above him, wet and dripping, a faint blue glow along its edges. The mouth open in a call, the eyes steady, the feet planted.

s2a_evander.wealth: 世家（北境旧骑士家，王死后已衰）
s2a_evander.why: 极境老骑士，铁桦家传了四代的北境鳞甲正是这一纪北人的霜纹甲。家道已衰，甲上缺的几片是故事里的，保留不补，招牌是那杆带冰晶的骑枪。
s2a_evander.battle: Leading the column on the road, in the Ironbirch family's handed-down northern war harness: a heavy frost-rune scale jacket whose plates breathe a faint cold mist, the etched runes glowing pale ice-blue, a few plates still missing with bare leather showing through; matching rimed steel pauldrons and gorget; the faded white coat over it embroidered with the iron-grey birch; frost-rune riding gauntlets and boots. A long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, its head carrying a small ice-blue crystal ringed with frost, the long northern sword at his hip. He stands braced and square, looking back down the line.

s2a_liv.why: 启源的穷孩子，只数人不打仗。九年雪路上要夜里点数，只添一件捡来的符文灯挂在杆头，别的不改。
s2a_liv.battle: The long march: the oversized wolf-skin coat with the sleeves rolled three times, its hem at her knees; two more full notched birch poles tied across her back beside the one in her hand; a small salvaged rune lantern with a pale blue-white crystal flame hung by a thong from the top of the tall white pole she grips upright, lighting the notches; the carving knife on its leather cord at her neck; boots wrapped in rags against the snow. She does not fight.

s2a_sif.why: 换生灵，冷伤不了她、靠的是霜精的血。光脚、挂鞋不穿是她这个人的标记，她也不打仗，所以不加甲，照原句。
s2a_sif.battle: The long march: the red wool dress her grandmother wove under the too-big sheepskin coat, buttoned up, its sleeves too long; the little soft leather shoes still hanging round her neck on their cord; bare feet in the snow, which do not sink and leave only light prints. She wears no armour and no charms, and needs none; the cold cannot hurt her. She does not fight.

s2a_embra.why: 灵格的雪线猎户，家里穷。外头的白狼皮是伏雪藏身用的，不能换，只在底下加一件改过的霜纹鳞背心和一只护臂。她冬天也不戴手套，照她的习惯来。
s2a_embra.battle: Hunting on the road, in plain salvaged war gear under her hunter's whites: the white-cured wolf-skin coat worn fur inside, small bone charms stitched along the seams, over an old frost-rune scale vest from the wall armouries, its re-laced plates showing faint ice-blue lines at the collar; a single rune-etched steel bracer on the left forearm against the string; bare hands, no gloves. The great horn-and-birch bow drawn halfway, a frost crystal set in its tip, a white-fletched arrow nocked, the quiver at her back, the knife and rope at her belt, one knee dropped low in the snow, the pale gold eyes narrowed on the far distance.

s2a_quillin.wealth: 贫（南岸木匠家，衣裳是宫里发的）
s2a_quillin.why: 共鸣的剑童，跪守、不带兵器。只在白外套底下加宫里发的一件薄附魔胸甲。护膝是父亲缝的，照旧，空手也照姿势句。
s2a_quillin.battle: The pre-dawn kneeling at the steps: the white page's coat, a little short at the wrists, with a slim palace-issue enchanted breastplate worn beneath it, a faint blue-white rune line showing at the collar; the white cord at the waist with the square-folded white linen cloth; both leather knee pads his father sewed strapped on, plain and unenchanted; the grey blanket folded and set aside, gloves off, bare hands open on his knees. He carries no weapon.

s2a_florian.why: 灵格佣兵，要攒钱赎车行，穿的是团里重漆过的旧墙甲，这正是长夜佣兵的样子。家穷所以是拼凑的一套，靠底档。
s2a_florian.battle: On the wall at night watch, in the Rustless Horn's refitted wall gear: an old enchanted half-plate from the wall armouries repainted in the company's dull brass-and-grey, the bugle badge painted on its breast, crystal sockets refilled with two lit crystals, rune lines along the edges glowing blue-white, worn over the worn leather jerkin; one mismatched pauldron; rune-etched steel vambraces. A short spear gripped in both hands with the oilcloth stripped off its head, a faint blue-white glint along the blade, the polished brass bugle at his belt, boots set wide, the green eyes level and unsmiling.

s2a_moritz.why: 书记学徒，不带兵器。只添一枚审判庭发的护身领针，墨壶上加一圈符文，本色照旧。
s2a_moritz.battle: The moment the order comes: the grey scribe's coat with its black cloth sleeve guards, a small tribunal-issue ward brooch pinned at the collar with a faint blue-white rune glowing in it; the ink pot at his belt banded with a thin lit rune ring, the pen case and paper knife beside it; a heavy ledger clutched to his chest against his coat and a pen held reversed in his other hand like a small blade, braced and nervous, the lenses pinched on his nose. He carries no weapon.

s2a_viola.why: 她靠走路无声、不被人记住过日子，金属甲片和亮光都会坏事，所以不穿甲，照原句。
s2a_viola.battle: Down the back stairs at night: the grey long-sleeved maid's dress with the white apron and white cap, nothing enchanted and nothing that could clink or glow, for she lives by not being noticed; the ring of small brass keys clutched in one hand so it makes no sound against her apron, a silver tray with a glass balanced perfectly level on the other; on tiptoe, light on the balls of her feet. She carries no weapon.

s2a_paula.why: 七十二岁的洗衣妇，不打仗，靠的是河阶调。照原句，只添一盏捡来的符文灯，领人走黑地用。
s2a_paula.battle: Down the river steps: the heavy oilcloth apron over the coarse linen skirt washed near white, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, the wooden-soled shoes; a heavy basket of wet laundry hoisted on one hip and a wooden washing paddle in her other hand, held low; the small thread scissors and reel of linen thread at her waist, beside a dented salvaged rune lantern with a dim blue-white crystal for leading people through the dark. She does not fight.

s2a_nat.why: 炭巷光脚跑腿的孩子，本事是无灯步，所以不带灯、不穿甲。只把敲管的铁片写成机兵上拆下的刻纹片，这是他淘零件的来历。
s2a_nat.battle: The night of the run: his father's oversized coat flapping, the sleeves rolled five times, its pockets heavy with scavenged brass gears and pins; the rope at his waist with its iron strip, a polished plate cut from a dead war machine with a faint rune circuit etched on it, lifted to tap a rhythm on a pipe; bare feet, soot on his face. He carries no light and wears no armour; he runs in the dark by feel. He does not fight.

s2a_wink.why: 研究者不打仗，靠的是铜簧和手艺。只加一只从机兵上拆来、改成工具用的黄铜关节护手，算是他的家什，不当甲穿。
s2a_wink.battle: Out in the field at the machine: the greasy leather coat with its countless pockets and brass buttons, the row of little brass reeds on its thong across the chest, the wire-bound notebook at the belt; on his left forearm a brass-jointed gauntlet salvaged from a war machine and refitted as a work tool, its etched rune circuit glowing faint blue-white; a big brass winding key held out in that hand toward unseen machines and a small brass reed whistle lifted to his mouth, the lens in place. He carries no weapon.

s2a_gerhard.why: 灵格城卫，穿的是冠台发的一套改合身的旧墙甲，按城卫的身份给。招牌那把泥刀照留。
s2a_gerhard.battle: At the mouth of the lane while sealing the gaps, in Crown Terrace guard-issue gear: an old enchanted wall breastplate and gorget re-strapped under the grey-blue coat, rune lines along the edges glowing faint blue-white, the copper guard's badge on the chest; plain steel pauldrons and rune-etched vambraces; the long guard's spear held in both hands lowered and braced across the opening, its head lit with a thin rune line; the short sword at his hip and a mason's trowel hanging at his belt, boots planted wide.

s2a_niv.why: 营里养人的医者，不带兵器，靠血和汤。长生系的袍子就是她的样子，所以只在汤锅上加一圈暖符，衣服照原句。
s2a_niv.battle: Carrying the pot through the camp: the long pale grey robe of her people with the left sleeve rolled up to the elbow, showing the name embroidered inside; the apron with its wooden spoon and bundle of dried herbs; soft-soled shoes that make no sound. Both hands grip a big steaming iron pot of soup held perfectly level in front of her, an old salvaged warming rune ringed round its belly glowing a faint ember red. She carries no weapon.

s2a_yago.why: 外圈的提夫林，宴上连碗都没有。灵格的本事配最穷的家境，只在硬皮背心上拼两三块捡来的甲片。弓和箭必须是他自己削的，这一点不换。
s2a_yago.battle: On the outer ring of the camp, in scavenged pieces over his own work: the stiff cured leather vest with its arrow loops, a dented dark enchanted chest plate riveted on over it, a faint red rune line still glowing at its edge; on the thick left arm a salvaged scale bracer, re-laced; the home-made short bow drawn full with a shaft he whittled himself nocked, its feathers glowing like embers; the quiver at his hip, the knife, thread and fish glue at his belt; the burnt horn tips black against the red sky, one eye grey and one eye red narrowed on the target.

s2a_dels.wealth: 中（绯宴收血人，替高座当差）
s2a_dels.why: 灵格收血人，替高座当差。深红外套扣到下巴、窄袖不沾血，这一身不能改，所以护甲藏在里头，血字符文只在匣子和袖口亮一点。
s2a_dels.battle: Making his rounds on the road: the deep red coat buttoned to the chin with very narrow cuffs, lined beneath with a fine enchanted mesh shirt, thin bands of blood-script runes glowing dark red at the cuffs; the black lacquered box strapped to his back, its seals lit faint red; a slim enchanted gorget under the high collar; a small knife held reversed low in his right hand, a dark red rune glinting on the blade; the pouch with the seal at his chest; boots planted, the wine-red eyes fixed on a wrist.

s2a_suren.why: 极境唱名人，靠的是歌和嗓子，又得藏着走，不穿甲。按她的位阶，护身的东西都缝在旧斗篷里、刻在老师的杖上，外表朴素。
s2a_suren.battle: Walking the camps: the old cloak washed colourless thrown back, its lining stitched with faint ward threads that glow a soft violet at the hidden pockets; the plain grey dress with her own name embroidered on the left cuff; no armour; her teacher's staff held upright in both hands, its hand-polished head bound with an old rune ring that shines pale silver when she sings. Her chin lifted and her mouth open to sing, the silver braid swinging with its eleven coloured threads.

s2a_saska.why: 底座是灵格（LVL 44），可看蛋的人不碰兵器，她从不出手。这一格不给她穿甲，只在苇皮绳上系一颗捡来的护窝魔晶，替蛋保暖。
s2a_saska.battle: Watching the clutch, in no war gear at all, only the egg-keeper's things: the woven reed apron over the plain linen dress, the leather cord belt with the small clay jar of white salt, and knotted beside it on reed cord one small salvaged ward-crystal from the last great war, glowing a faint warm amber to keep the clutch's heat; the long hollow reed pipe pushed into the warm mud mound, its other end held to her mouth in one hand while she bends close, the other four-fingered hand pressed flat on the mound, the tail braced behind her. She carries no weapon.

s2a_asha.why: 开局是灵格（LVL 52），西泉逃户出身，家里穷，按档减一。她要背水夜飞，所以只在皮甲外头罩两三件捡来的轻附魔件，翼缝和光脚照旧。
s2a_asha.battle: Flying the night run, in two or three pieces of salvaged war gear over her water-carrier's clothes: the short leather jerkin with its two back slits, now faced across the chest with small re-laced enchanted scales from the wall armouries, a thin blue-white rune line along their edges; a single old enchanted pauldron strapped to the left shoulder clear of the wing root, one dim crystal still lit in its socket; rune-etched leather-and-steel bracers. Her patched wings spread wide, the six waterskins full and heavy at her belt, the short reed-wrapped bow gripped in one hand, bare feet tucked, the teal eyes wide in the dark.

s2a_hano.why: 位阶是极境（LVL 86），可他在门洞记名，不拿兵器。偏好压过位阶，不穿甲，只在雨城斗篷的下摆缝一道护身符线，本子上的字会发光。跨页也照这个路子走。
s2a_hano.battle: At the gate in the rain, in no armour: he is a recorder, not a fighter, and the only war-age thing on him is in the cloth. The washed-pale grey rain-city cloak thrown back over the tunic, its hem stitched with an old ward thread whose rune line glows faint grey-white in the wet; the small copper bell on his left wrist; the two leather pouches at his belt; an open notebook held in the left hand, the charcoal names on its page faintly lit, and a charcoal stick poised in the right; the grey-white eyes watching a face and a wrist. He carries no weapon.

s2a_marek.why: 共鸣（LVL 31），铁匠家的学徒。他不是打仗的人，只在干活的衣服外头加一件捡来的附魔护臂，炭盆照旧当盾使。
s2a_marek.battle: Carrying the coals up the street, with one salvaged war piece over his apprentice clothes: the short leather apron with the chisel pouch, and strapped over the left forearm an old grey wall-issue enchanted vambrace, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; the oilcloth roll on his back; the iron brazier of glowing coals raised in his right hand like a shield, the wet cloth on its rim steaming, an old war crystal riveted to its side glowing orange; a chisel gripped low in his left hand, its tip faintly red with carving runes. He is not a fighter.

s2b_baltina.why: 原页说一个营的护卫也敌不过她，所以估为传奇。可她不愿动手，一身磨毛的灰斗篷是她自己选的。这一格不给她穿甲，只在灰呢里织进看不出来的护身符文。往后各页偏好不变。
s2b_baltina.battle: Walking into a camp of armed guards, in no armour by her own choice: the long grey hooded cloak belted tight over the dark wool dress, the hood up, the frayed cuffs left plain, but woven through the grey wool are fine ward runes that show only as a faint silver sheen where the light touches them; the sleeves tied back, laced boots, the leather-bound notebook tucked into her belt under her left hand. Her right hand is held open at chest height with a small, steady, smokeless flame of pale light floating above the palm; she carries no weapon; a level, unafraid look, the mouth closed.

s2b_guide.why: 约320年跨进传奇，到这一档已经不看家境。他的旧皮衣不带纹章，也不佩剑。这一格给他霜厅的上等霜纹鳞甲，样子一概去掉装饰。
s2b_guide.battle: At the third snow line holding the pass, in the plain gear of a man who has crossed into legend: the old crestless northern leather coat belted over a long shirt of fine overlapping iron scales from the Frost Hall's armouries, every scale scratched with frost-rune lines that glow pale ice-blue and breathe a thin cold mist; a hood of white wool pulled up; fur-lined steel gauntlets with frosted rune knuckles, no ornament anywhere. He draws the white wooden longbow to the full, the silver plate in its limb glinting, the string shimmering faintly cold, an arrow at his cheek, aimed down into the blowing snow; no sword. A hard, steady look.

s2b_thrower.why: 他是传奇，不看家境。可他扔掉了全部兵器，只留一支铜标枪。这一格的料子是顶上的，样子朴素，不加纹章，也不加别的兵器。
s2b_thrower.battle: Hunting the thing in the valley, in gear as plain as the life he chose: the heavy undyed wool coat belted tight over a close shirt of dark enchanted scale, unadorned, its frost-rune lines so faint they show only at the seams; plain dark steel bracers and greaves with no crest; a short grey cloak, the grey scarf hanging loose. He carries no sword, shield or axe. He grips the short back-weighted dull-red copper javelin overhand in his right hand, drawn back to throw, a deep red rune glow waking along its head, the left arm stretched forward for balance; a stern, level look.

s2b_emperor.why: 他从小拿笔多、拿剑少，位阶估为共鸣。皇室家境加两档，所以阅兵时穿量身的附魔胸甲。他扶剑登位、不拔剑，这一格不配剑，也不挂铳。
s2b_emperor.battle: At the spring review of the troops, in a harness made for the throne and worn without a blade: a fitted cuirass of slim old-war enchanted steel, pale grey, the Dawn crest etched on the breast and rune lines along its edges glowing soft white-gold, worn over the old-cut grey coat; matching shaped pauldrons; white gloves, with gem-set enchanted bracer cuffs at the wrists that glow faintly when he closes his hand; a short white cloak with a single crystal clasp; tall riding boots; the thin gold circlet. No sword and no spell-gun at his hip: one white-gloved hand rests flat on the front of the cuirass, the other holds a rolled decree; a composed, steady look.

s2b_theodor.why: 原页说他没拿过刀，这一格不给他穿甲。只在审判庭发的大衣里缝暖身符文，再挂一枚庭印护符，合他书记的身份。
s2b_theodor.battle: On the crown terrace on the morning of the rite, with nothing of war on him but what the Tribunal issues: a heavy grey winter greatcoat over the tribunal coat, its lining stitched with old warming runes that show as a faint amber line at the cuffs; a grey wool cap; the black sleeve-guards; a small tribunal seal-charm with a dim crystal hung on a cord beside the reading lenses; a ledger held flat against his chest with both arms, the pen between two fingers. He has never held a blade and carries none; a sharp, unyielding look.

s2b_heather.why: 450年成为传奇，到这一档已经不看家境。她把剑格上的家纹都磨掉了，所以甲用最好的料子，样子做成矿工式的灰扑扑，不带纹，也不擦亮。
s2b_heather.battle: In the tunnels under the lane, in war gear of the best make worn as plainly as a miner's: over the work shirt a crestless enchanted half-plate of dark steel, scuffed and dulled with coal dust, its rune lines glowing a low dull red; plain enchanted vambraces and knee-plates in place of boiled leather, nothing polished, nothing engraved; a brass rune lamp with a pale crystal flame on a strap at her left shoulder. She grips the mountain-copper greatsword in both hands by its rough hemp-wrapped hilt, the crest ground off its guard, kept low and short, its flat braced up against a timber beam, dull red rune lines along the blade; a fierce, stubborn look.

s2b_greyflag.why: 他连下三城，又独自在山口迎战九尊之一，位阶估为英雄，这一档不看家境。甲是从高座营城缴来的，外头照旧罩着灰褂子，不加装饰。
s2b_greyflag.battle: On the slope below the pass at night, in gear stripped from the high seat's own garrisons and worn plainly under camp grey: the unbleached grey jacket tied closed with a cord over a dark captured scale coat, its old ember-red rune lines still glowing faintly at the seams; a captured blackened steel pauldron on the bow shoulder; a company strip of grey cloth on one arm stitched with a red mark; extra quivers across the back and hip, the arrowheads glinting with spell-light; a rune-etched steel arm guard and finger guard. He draws the mountain-copper bow to the full, the torn grey sleeve-strips nailed to its limbs, the limbs glinting, the arrow aimed at the dark pass; red firelight glows on the slope behind him.

s2b_kasia.why: 她看了一百七十年蛋，位阶估为灵格。看蛋的人不碰兵器，这一格不穿甲，只在苇披肩上系旧护骨和一颗魔晶，杖上加一圈暖光符环。
s2b_kasia.battle: Barring the way to the egg-beds, in no war gear, only what a keeper owns: the pale reed apron and long undyed wool tunic with a thick reed-woven shawl over the shoulders, a few old ward-bones and one dim salvaged crystal knotted into the shawl's fringe, glowing faint amber; bare clawed feet planted wide; the reed-root staff held crosswise in both hands in front of her body like a bar across a door, a faint warm rune ring wound around its middle. She carries no weapon. A stern, flat look.

s2b_helong.why: 他从西陆领了四百人出来，位阶估为灵格。逃户家境差，按档减一。这一格只给他从营里带出来、又补过的两三件附魔件，猎弓照旧。
s2b_helong.battle: Defending the spring in the reeds, in a few pieces carried out of the western camps and patched for the marsh: the hide vest laced over the tunic and stitched with small red wards that glow like embers, a salvaged dark iron plate sewn over the chest; old enchanted bracers and greaves with blood-red rune lines; the river stone at his belt faintly warm. He draws a plain wooden hunting bow to the cheek, its grip wound with a ward cord and the arrow tip glinting red, aimed out across the marsh; a hard, level look, the cloth-wrapped horn glowing faintly.

s2n_yolanda.why: 开局共鸣（LVL 24），暗巷出身。这一格给她斩夜者发的便宜旧附魔件，重漆成团里的灰色，件数少、分量轻，好在湿瓦上跑。
s2n_yolanda.battle: On the rooftops at night, in the Night-Slayers' cheap salvaged kit kept light for running wet tiles: the grey short cloak pulled tight with the hood up, the faded red headscarf tied over her nose and mouth as a mask so only the teal-green eyes show, both wrists bare of it; over the charcoal tunic a thin vest of small enchanted plates repainted company grey, a faint blue-white rune line along their edges; rune-etched leather bracers over the sleeves, one tiny crystal lit at the wrist; dark trousers, the soft roof boots. She holds the old plain straight sword low and forward in her right hand, a straight double-edged blade, NOT a curved sword; the empty worn scabbard at her left hip; a low, light ready stance on the balls of her feet.

s2n_nickel.why: 他是启源（LVL 16）的学徒，不拿兵器。这一格只在工具背心上添一盏捡来的符文小灯，加一只旧附魔护臂。
s2n_nickel.battle: Out on a night job with his master, with only a couple of cheap salvaged pieces: a dark grey hooded short cloak over the long-sleeved shirt, a snug dark leather tool vest with narrow pockets of picks, and at its chest a small salvaged rune lamp shuttered down to a thin pale crystal glow; an old enchanted leather-and-plate bracer on the left forearm, its rune line faint blue-white; dark trousers and soft-soled boots; the hemp rope coiled over his right shoulder, its small iron hook gripped in one hand, a thin steel pick ready in the other; the brass key tucked inside his collar. He holds no weapon.

s2n_lennart.rank: 共鸣→灵格（这一格是火起那一夜）
s2n_lennart.why: 他是兵户出身，开局共鸣，枪刃起火那一夜到灵格。穷人家，灵格减一档，干活的衣服外头罩两三件捡来的墙上旧甲。样张对得上这一档，照样交回。
s2n_lennart.battle: Holding the ford at night, in old war gear refitted for the marsh: a dark enchanted scale vest from the wall armouries, its small plates re-laced and lit by a faint blue-white rune line down each edge, worn over his shirt; a single articulated enchanted pauldron on the right shoulder with an empty crystal socket and one lit crystal; rune-etched steel vambraces; a short faded grey-brown cloak thrown back over the shoulders, its hem stitched with a glowing ward thread; a bandolier of reed darts whose tips glint with spell-light. He grips the sawn-off half spear in both hands, the polished old iron head forward, a thin line of flame running along the blade edge. The feet set wide, the grin gone, the jaw set.

s2n_ilowen.rank: 英雄（估，长夜凝名的四位之一）
s2n_ilowen.why: 凝名够得上英雄，用好料子；她穿补过的衣裳、不戴首饰，所以甲只做成贴身的守望者旧甲，不加装饰。
s2n_ilowen.battle: Holding the breach in the Wall, in a Watcher's old war gear kept plain: a short moss-green hooded cloak over a fitted dark green leaf-scale jerkin of old enchanted elven make, its small overlapping plates traced with a faint white rune line along each edge, neatly mended with white thread; the long dress kilted up over brown leather leggings; a rune-etched leather-and-steel bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us); a quiver of arrows on her back, its fletchings faintly lit. She draws the pale wooden longbow with an arrow nocked, faint glowing white tree-like veins running along her hands and forearms; the feet planted.

s2n_kosser.rank: 英雄（估，长夜凝名的四位之一）
s2n_kosser.why: 凝名够得上英雄，英雄不看家境；沼地出身，战装用骨和皮配旧附魔件，招牌是那支缠得整齐的骨矛。
s2n_kosser.battle: Standing outside the weapon circle, in marsh-made war gear set with old enchantments: a hardened leather cuirass faced with layered bone plates over the reed kilt, each plate carved with a rune line glowing faint blue-green, a salvaged war crystal set at the breastbone; heavy layered bone pauldrons bound with bronze rings; leather forearm guards reinforced with rune-etched steel strips. He grips the bone spear in both hands, its red-wrapped shaft lit by a faint blue-green glow that runs up his spine and along the shaft; the feet planted wide, the tail braced behind him.

s2n_bertram.wealth: 中（世家管家，用家里库房的东西）
s2n_bertram.why: 位阶估在灵格，他管着瓦赫特家的旗库，穿的是家里配下来的整套北境霜纹鳞甲，在灵格档上往上加一档。
s2n_bertram.battle: Out on the snow line, in the Wachter house's northern war kit drawn from the vault: a heavy wolf-skin coat worn fur inside, the outside tanned pale, over a fitted shirt of frost-rune iron scale whose engraved runes glow pale ice-blue and breathe a thin cold mist at the collar; rune-etched steel vambraces under fur-lined gloves; tall boots; the brass vault keys at his hip. He holds upright a tall pole carrying an old, faded, tattered war banner of the Wall's northern legions, the pole's iron-shod tip serving as his spear, a faint rune line glowing along the tip; standing straight and composed.

s2n_luitpold.why: 他不拔剑，本事估得很低，可他是皇帝，所以穿一套典礼用的附魔甲，只有护身的符文，手里不拿兵器，跟第三格的姿势对得上。
s2n_luitpold.battle: The ceremonial armour of the sword-propping rite: a polished white-gold enchanted breastplate and pauldrons of the old war, the warding runes along their edges glowing a soft pale white, worn over a long deep blue coat; a white mantle on the shoulders, its hem stitched with a faint silver ward thread; slim white-gold tassets; the white gloves, nothing set over them; a white-gold gorget engraved with the fourteen houses' marks in a ring; an empty sword belt with no sword in it, its scabbard ring left bare.

s2n_adalbert.why: 北墙老枪骑出身，位阶估在极境，世家再加一档；原句就写不加装饰，所以他用一流的附魔钢甲，样子是素的。
s2n_adalbert.battle: As the old lancer of the northern Wall, in the Clemens house's best steel worn without ornament: plain, unadorned enchanted half-plate of old wall steel, its only marks the fine rune lines along the edges that glow a faint cold white, over a long white coat whose chest is embroidered in silver thread with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings; matching plain steel pauldrons; steel gauntlets with a single dark crystal at each wrist; tall boots. He grips a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, the lancehead etched with a faint glowing rune; the feet planted, the face cold and composed.

s2n_daisy.rank: 英雄（420年那一夜；405年时是灵格）
s2n_daisy.why: 她是靠歌唱上英雄的，在这之前从没出过手，也没去挣过装备；身上只有老佣兵抵酒钱留下的旧东西，所以照下街的穷人穿，力量在歌里。
s2n_daisy.battle: The one night she goes up on the rooftops, in what the old mercenary left behind the bar: dark trousers tucked into boots, an old enchanted leather-scale jerkin over the white linen blouse, its worn plates showing a thin rune line that wakes faint blue-white; a single scuffed wall-issue vambrace on the sword arm; a short dark hooded cloak; the curls pinned tight with the wooden pin, the dried daisy above her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us). She holds an old plain straight sword in her right hand, a straight double-edged blade, NOT a curved sword, a faint rune line relit along its fuller; the lute left behind; a low, ready stance, no smile.

s2n_flip.why: 他是极境，东西多半从上城偷来；做贼不穿甲，所以只拿一套偷来的贼用附魔件，招牌是那串包了软皮的钥匙，手里只拿撬锁针。
s2n_flip.battle: Out on a night job, in a burglar's kit stolen piece by piece from the upper city: a dark grey hooded short cloak lined with a muffling rune thread that dims to a faint grey shimmer, over close-fitting black clothes with a thin flexible enchanted mesh beneath; soft black boots with silence runes stitched faintly glowing at the soles; thin white gloves copied from a mansion owner's pair; the leather-wrapped key ring at his hip bound tight with a strap, a few of the copied keys faintly rune-lit. A slim belt of tools with a tiny crystal lamp shuttered dark. He holds a fine steel lockpick raised.

s2n_kunigunde.why: 她是公证官，不上阵，所以不穿甲；照上城的家底，法袍上是贵重的附魔护纹，那块白石是她的法器。
s2n_kunigunde.battle: Presiding over the pressing of a contract, in a notary's enchanted robes rather than armour: the deep teal dress under a long black wool notary's over-robe closing down the front, its hems and cuffs traced with a fine silver binding-rune line that glows faint white; a slim enchanted silver chatelaine set with a small clear crystal; the white-stone seal at the throat; white gloves. She holds the white notary stone, a pale light gathered in its polished face.

s2n_muttaz.why: 469年他已是英雄，所以穿一身设计过的祭司战袍，不穿甲；招牌是那只百门提炉，手里另外拿一根素杖。
s2n_muttaz.battle: Ready to pour fire, in a high priest's war robe of the Ash throne: the black white-edged robe belted tight with a black mountain-copper girdle, its long skirt slit at the sides for walking, the white edging stitched with fireproof rune thread that glows faint white; black mountain-copper bracers over the sleeves, engraved with a ring of tiny gates that shine white; a high copper-ringed collar. The censer swings out on its chain from his left hand, white fire spilling in a thin bright stream from the gates in its wall, and in his right hand he grips a plain black priest's staff. His look is flat and certain, his mouth closed.

s2n_wigand.why: 十四家里的一位家主，又是无双的弓手，位阶估在极境，世家再加一档，穿量身做的弓手战装；箭杆照原页保持素的。
s2n_wigand.battle: Leading the boundary bowmen, in the Grenz house's tailored archer's harness: a fitted dark slate-blue archer's coat over a slim enchanted breastplate, its edges engraved with boundary-stone runes glowing soft white, the white-stone badge at the collar; a single light steel pauldron on the left shoulder; a gem-set leather-and-steel bracer on the left forearm whose pale crystal lights when he draws; a quiver of plain smooth-shafted arrows at his right hip. He holds a tall pale longbow half drawn with three arrows on the string at once, the deerskin-wrapped fingers on the string, and his ice-green eyes are fixed on a far target.

s2n_sorend.why: 他是传奇，贴身的是这一纪最好的霜纹甲；可他从不带纹章，也不佩剑，所以甲藏在没有纹章的旧皮衣底下，只看得出一点冷光。
s2n_sorend.battle: Out hunting on the snow line, the finest northern work hidden under plain clothes: the emblemless hide coat belted tight over a close-fitting shirt of frost-rune scale of the highest make, its runes showing only as faint cold-blue lines at the collar and cuffs and breathing a thin mist; a hood of grey wool; plain leather bracers lined with rune-etched silver; a quiver of arrows across his back, no crest anywhere. He holds the light, brittle white wooden bow with the flake of rough true silver in its arm, an arrow nocked and half drawn, standing very still with the ice-blue eyes fixed on the distance.

s2n_germon.why: 他把剑、盾、斧和长枪都扔在了雪线上，不想再当王的长枪手，所以不穿甲，身上只留那支山铜短标枪，衣裳照谷里猎人的样子。
s2n_germon.battle: On the beast's trail, wearing no armour by choice, only a hunter's clothes: the wolf-skin coat belted tight over a quilted wool jerkin, plain leather bracers, a hood thrown back, mud on the boots, no crest and nothing of the king's spearman left on him. He holds the short mountain-copper javelin raised back over his right shoulder, ready to throw, the body coiled, and a faint copper glow runs down the shaft, thin copper runes waking along its weighted butt. His eyes are hard and his mouth is closed.

s2n_ingvi.rank: 英雄（336年过雪线时；约395年到传奇）
s2n_ingvi.why: 雪线那一回她刚到英雄门口，英雄不看家境，所以用好料子；她自己补披肩、自己缝靴子，所以甲是素的旧墙钢，没有一件多余的。
s2n_ingvi.battle: Carrying fire across the snow line, in plain old wall steel under her own patched clothes: the fur capelet tied tight over a plain enchanted scale vest worn beneath the buttoned wool jacket, its rune lines glowing warm ember-orange from her heart-fire; plain leather-backed steel vambraces; the red skirt kilted up over leggings, her self-stitched boots; the copper ladle at her belt. She holds the small iron fire basin forward in both hands, warm flame rising from it and glowing along her arms up to the shoulders, and she wears a determined, unafraid face.

s2n_kiro.why: 她是靠身体和翅膀托起重物的，不用兵器，所以只穿夜翼式的皮背心，加一点会跟翼脉一起亮的符文线，不穿甲，光脚。
s2n_kiro.battle: Bearing the weight, almost unarmoured by choice: the old leather vest belted tight with the back slits open for the wings, a few small dark enchanted plates sewn over the chest, their rune lines glowing faint gold like her wing veins; leather wraps on the forearms stitched with gold rune thread; canvas trousers bound at the knee, barefoot. Her wings are spread wide, the grey-purple membranes lit with gold veins, and she has no weapon. Both arms are raised overhead with the palms up as if holding something enormous, her jaw set.

s2n_daud.why: 他是传奇，可他不报名号、不报出身，所以只在外圈人的灰外套底下穿一件缴来的、没有标记的鳞衫，招牌是那张山铜弓。
s2n_daud.battle: Holding the pass, in outer-camp grey over captured gear with every mark filed off: the grey coat belted tight over a close-fitting dark scale shirt taken from a flame-horn camp, its rune lines dulled to a faint grey glow; the left sleeve torn short, a mountain-copper bracer etched with plain runes on the left forearm; a full quiver at his right hip. He draws the mountain-copper bow to full length, the nailed grey strip snapping from its arm, and the arrow on the string glows white. His eyes are steady and his mouth is closed.

s3a_odilia.why: 灵格按位阶是二档。她出身白烛祭司世家，家境中等。白烛站在两边中间的人不带刃也不披甲，所以不给她加甲，只把白烛一路的东西升成附魔的，袍子仍然朴素。
s3a_odilia.battle: Standing between two lines in a gate passage, in the White Candle's own kind of protection rather than armour: the grey-washed white robe belted tight with the white cord, the sleeves rolled, a small white candle embroidered on the left chest in thread that holds a faint warm glow; a grey wool cloak pinned at the throat, its hem and lining stitched with pale ward-thread runes shining soft white; the wax-sealed bronze tag at her neck glowing faintly through the wax; no blade, no armour. She holds her right hand out flat and open, palm forward, as if asking everyone to stop, and a lit white candle stub in her left hand held at chest height, its flame steady and haloed in clear white light; a stern, unafraid look.

s3a_hano.why: 极境本应是三档成套战装。他是灰雨城的书记，四百多年只记名不动手，所以不给他穿甲，只把斗篷、铜铃和本子升成灰雨城的附魔物件。别的页上也照这个不打仗的路子画。
s3a_hano.battle: Standing his ground at a gate passage, protected the way a Grey Rain clerk is, not armoured: the washed-out grey cloak pinned tight, its inner lining stitched all over with fine grey-silver ward script that glows faintly at the hem and collar; the pouches buckled shut, their flaps marked with small lit runes; the Long-Axle brass bell on his left wrist shimmering with a faint pale light; sturdy dark boots; he carries no weapon. He holds up an open notebook in his left hand, its pages edged with a thin line of grey-white light, and a charcoal stick in his right as if about to write a name; a level, unflinching look.

s3a_gisela.why: 共鸣是一档。她是车夫家出身的书记，袖口打着补丁，家境贫。她不出手打仗，所以只在外套上罩一两件捡来的护身附魔件，册子和笔照旧拿在手里。
s3a_gisela.battle: Reading out names at the gate-tower, a clerk with only salvaged protection: the patched grey coat buttoned up, sleeves pushed to the elbow, a single grey wall-issue enchanted breast-plate strapped over it with old harness leather, one small magic crystal still lit at its edge and a thin blue-white rune line along the rim; the leather case at her belt; her father's brass whistle on its cord; sturdy boots. She holds a thick open register in her left hand, its brass-cornered binding faintly rune-lit, and raises her right arm with a finger pointing along a line of names; she carries no weapon.

s3a_ludda.why: 灵格本是二档，但她在地牢里关了两年，又是过墙换盐的人，家境贫，降到一档。她是药师，不拿兵器打人，只在骨刀和围裙上带一点她们部里血术的光，不给她加甲。
s3a_ludda.battle: Working in a field aid tent, a healer with nothing but her own craft for protection: the grey robe belted tight, the sleeves tied back, a dark apron over it with a thin line of blood-script runes stitched along its hem glowing a faint dull red; the empty herb satchel at her waist with one salvaged crystal vial clipped to it, softly lit; the small bone knife at her neck. She kneels on one knee holding the small bone knife in her right hand, its polished edge glinting faint red, over a roll of bandage in her left; she carries no other weapon.

s3a_boru.why: 灵格本是二档，但他身上带着烙印，妻子关在粮仓，给戴希家白干，家境贫，降到一档。他是铁匠，捡来的附魔甲件是他自己在炉上改合身的，跟灰褂、铁链、大锤叠在一起穿。
s3a_boru.battle: Standing in front of a sluice-mouth gate, in salvaged pieces he re-forged himself: the grey smock buttoned across the chest, the scorched apron over it, a single huge grey wall-issue enchanted pauldron on the left shoulder hammered out to fit him and repainted with the Daixi weir pattern, its rune line glowing faint blue-white; heavy war-machine forearm plates riveted onto leather on both forearms, their etched circuits lit; the iron chain at his waist; heavy boots. He grips the huge hammer in both hands, the head raised high, the blue scorch ring on it glowing faintly; braced at the very front, a hard, unmoving look.

s3a_helga.why: 共鸣是一档。她住在闸底，领着欠债的人和过墙人过日子，家境贫。她要钻窄沟，所以只加贴身、不挂东西的一两件捡来的附魔件。
s3a_helga.battle: Breaking through a rusted grating in the dark, in light salvaged pieces that won't snag: the oilcloth coat tied tight, the hood up, under it a close salvaged vest of fine enchanted mesh glinting blue-white at the collar; a single rune-etched steel guard strapped on the left forearm over the blue wrist-line, both glowing faintly; gloves with the fingers cut off, the nailed boots braced. She grips the short iron pry bar in both hands against a bar of the grating, the shuttered tin lantern hanging at her belt with a salvaged crystal glowing behind the shutter; a fierce, focused look.

s3a_max.why: 共鸣是一档。他是南岸码头出身，靠当兵的饷钱养家，家境贫。身上是墙上发的旧件，换成附魔的那一版，盾上戴希家的堤纹会亮。
s3a_max.battle: Holding the west gate, in wall-issue salvage: the old leather armour buckled tight with a grey enchanted breast-plate strapped over it, a thin blue-white rune line along its edge; the left shoulder plate worn bright from standing in line, a small magic crystal still lit in its socket; rune-etched steel bracers; a dented iron cap with a faint rune band. He holds the round shield in front of his chest, the Daixi weir pattern painted on it glowing softly along its lines, and the short spear low and ready behind it, his feet planted a half-step apart; a hard, level look.

s3a_bastian.why: 灵格本是二档，但他是下街的穷佣兵团出身，家境贫，降到一档。团徽是露易丝手绣的，他不换，只在旧坎肩和外套上加两三件捡来的附魔件。
s3a_bastian.battle: Hauling on a rope at the mouth of a flooded dock, in a poor company's salvage: the leather vest buckled over the canvas coat, a sheet of glowing enchanted mesh sewn inside it showing blue-white at the collar, the crooked bell-and-seven-lines badge on the left chest; one crystal-lit enchanted pauldron on the right shoulder, repainted in the company's colour; leather gloves, sturdy boots braced on wet stone. He grips the hemp rope in both hands, hauling, the brass bell at its end hanging beside him and shimmering with a faint echoing light; a clenched-jaw, intent look.

s3a_herbert.why: 共鸣是一档。他是穷守坞人，七十一岁，不打仗。只让钥匙和一盏捡来的符文灯带上附魔的光，不给他披甲。
s3a_herbert.battle: Working the old dock-gate winch, an old dock-keeper with only salvaged lights about him: the oilcloth coat buttoned, the scarf, fingerless gloves; the key ring at his belt, the great winch key etched with old sluice runes glowing faint blue-white; a small salvaged rune lantern with a pale crystal flame hung from the belt beside it, the dock register wrapped in oilcloth tucked in his coat. He grips the long wooden lever of the winch in both hands, the whole stooped body leaning into it; a stubborn, set look; he carries no weapon.

s3a_julius.why: 极境按位阶是三档，他是法师世家的儿子，加一档到四档。他嫌铳是工程院的玩意，所以不带铳、不带刃。战装是量身裁的术式院法袍，附魔都在袍子、袖扣和手套上。
s3a_julius.battle: Quelling a furnace, in a tailored institute war robe of his house: the long deep blue robe cut close and belted tight, its lining woven with fine ward lines that glow pale blue along the seams; the sleeves bound at the wrists by engraved silver cuffs whose pattern-rings shine softly; the Rosenthal brooch at the collar, its central core lit; thin enchanted leather gloves etched with drawing lines at the fingertips. He kneels on one knee and draws a line of glowing pattern on the stone floor with a stick of charcoal, the other hand held flat above it; he carries no firearm and no blade.

s3a_vista.why: 641年以后她已是传奇，五档，英雄往上不看家境。她的旧皮甲补过也从不换新，样子照旧朴素，好料子只藏在里面，一件装饰都不加。
s3a_vista.battle: Leading the company, plain on the outside and the finest under it: the old leather armour with the mended sleeves buckled tight, never replaced, with a close shirt of fine dark mesh from a sunken tower beneath it whose deep glow shows only at the mended seams; plain unadorned steel bracers; the rope and knife at her belt, the crudely stitched white raven banner unrolled and tied across her back on a short pole; no ornaments. She grips the re-forged narrow sword in both hands, raised in front of her shoulder, faint pale veins of the sealing stone glowing in the blade; braced on the front line, a fierce look, the heavy brows drawn together.

s3a_hanna.why: 启源是一档。她是村里穷人家的姑娘，只给人送饭，不打仗。衣裳几乎不动，只让碗带上她长明之焰的暖光，再加一块捡来的护符。
s3a_hanna.battle: Carrying food to the fighters in the dark, a village girl with only a little salvaged protection: the long wool dress under a short thick wool jacket buttoned to the neck, a scarf, the apron, sturdy boots, the braid tucked into the collar; on a cord at her neck a small salvaged ward-charm, its tiny crystal lit. She holds the chipped clay bowl level in both hands with a cloth over it, a steady warm golden glow seeping from under the cloth and around the rim; a determined look.

s3a_gotthard.why: 灵格本是二档，但他是乡下封石匠，家境贫，降到一档。他不打仗，只在围裙和凿锤上加了捡来的附魔件，右腕的麻布缠法照旧。
s3a_gotthard.battle: Sealing a stone, in a village smith's salvaged pieces: the burnt leather apron with an old grey enchanted breast-plate riveted onto its bib, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; heavy leather gloves, the right wrist wrapped in its linen strip; a cloth tied over his nose and mouth against the dust; a short hammer in his right hand, its head bound with a band of old enchanted steel, and a broad chisel in his left whose edge glows faint white. He holds the chisel against a stone block and raises the hammer to strike; a set, patient look.

s3a_karn.why: 极境按位阶是三档，但他的猎队烧没了，家境贫。极境以上家境至多减一档，所以是二档：一套改合身的旧附魔轻甲，猎队传下来的老弓不换。
s3a_karn.battle: On a ridge before the shooting, in refitted old enchanted kit: the old coat buttoned with the collar up, its hem and cuffs stitched with faint blue-white rune thread, over a close shirt of salvaged enchanted mesh glinting at the collar; a crystal-lit enchanted pauldron on the right shoulder repainted with the white raven badge; a rune-etched steel bracer on the left forearm with a small lit crystal at the wrist; the quiver on his hip, the arrow fletchings faintly glowing. He holds the short bow at full draw, the arrow aimed far out and slightly up, its head glinting with spell-light; a still, focused look.

s3b_toren.why: 极境按位阶是三档，但他从小跑路无家，家境贫，减一档到二档。他是骑手，甲要轻，所以是一套改合身的旧附魔轻甲，加长的骑枪不换。
s3b_toren.battle: Ready to charge with the company, in refitted light enchanted gear: a salvaged enchanted scale jerkin re-laced to fit his narrow back, buckled over riding leathers, a blue-white rune line down each edge; a crystal-lit pauldron on the left shoulder; rune-etched steel bracers; an open iron cap with a faint rune band round the brow; a white crow banner stitched badly and crooked on a short pole across his back. He stands square on both feet, holding the long lance low in both hands, level and pointing forward, the steel head glinting with spell-light. A fixed, expressionless look.

s3b_hod.why: 极境是三档。他从前是手巧的锁匠，家境中等。战装成套，招牌是炉城维格迪丝打的那把新重剑。空着的工具袋照旧挂着，旧皮甲肩上的两块铁也留着。
s3b_hod.battle: Breaking a door in a wall fight, in a matched dwarven harness: a fitted dwarf-forged enchanted cuirass over the old leather jerkin, the two iron shoulder plates reworked into heavy rune-plates whose engraved lines glow ember-orange; matching enchanted gauntlets and iron-capped boots; the flat, empty locksmith's pouch still at his belt; a badly stitched white crow banner crooked on a short pole across his back. He grips the new heavy dwarven sword in both hands, its thick straight blade lit along the fuller by forge-runes, raised behind his shoulder for a smashing swing, the feet set wide. A fierce, braced look.

s3b_lisel.why: 极境本该一身成套，她却只靠嗓子和那枚护符传声，守井夜里也不打仗，所以不披甲，只让外套和护符带上法光。
s3b_lisel.battle: the grey-blue coat buttoned to the top, a faint blue-white ward thread stitched along its hem and cuffs against the night cold, standing on the stone rim of a well at night, the feet together and the back dead straight, one hand holding the black amulet up at her throat, its porcelain-smooth face glowing a soft cold light as if about to carry a voice across the dark, the lips parted a little to speak; the water skin at the belt; she carries no weapon.

s3b_lithia.why: 灵格加上夜绯家主的女儿，家里给得起好东西，可她坐长桌替营里说话，从不拔刀，只在斗篷扣和手套上带一点家里的法饰。
s3b_lithia.battle: seated very upright on the end of a long bench at a plain table, the black cloak buttoned to the throat with a small dark crimson crystal clasp glowing faintly at the collar, the thin dark red gloves with their black silk wrist bands, a fine crimson rune thread worked into the silk, one gloved hand flat on the wood and the other holding the small wallet, the head turned to watch the far end of the table; she carries no weapon.

s3b_selephen.why: 共鸣、逃来雨城的穷孩子，轻骨背不动重东西，只在旧背心上多一两件捡来的轻巧附魔件。
s3b_selephen.battle: the old leather vest with the two wing slits, its seams re-stitched with a salvaged ward thread that glows faint blue-white, a thin enchanted leather bracer with one small lit crystal on the balancing forearm, the wings half spread behind him and the bare feet gripping the edge of a roof tile, one hand out for balance and the other holding the flat pouch against his chest, the copper button on its cord at his waist, the head turned over one shoulder; he carries no weapon.

s3b_benedict.why: 灵格加上上城圣堂人家，本可一身好装，但白烛的规矩不带兵器、不披甲，他只穿洗软的灰袍，好东西都在烛台和护符上。
s3b_benedict.battle: the grey candle robe with the sleeves pushed up above the elbows, its hem stitched with faint white ward runes, a small salvaged crystal ward-charm hung from the plain rope belt, kneeling on one knee beside a patient on the ground, one big hand pressed on a bandaged wound with a warm glow under the palm, the other holding the bronze candlestick up for light, its white candle burning with a pale steady holy flame, the head bowed; he carries no weapon.

s3b_baltina.why: 英雄的档不看家境，可她扮话少的精灵法师，白木杖只是道具，身上不能露出魔族的东西，只在兜帽里藏一道淡淡的符文。
s3b_baltina.battle: a grey-green hooded long cloak with the hood up over the braid, the inner edge of the hood lined with a fine grey rune script that glows only faintly, a lock of hair falling over the forehead mark, a plain white wooden staff with nothing carved on it held upright in one hand as a prop, the other hand raised palm out as if asking two groups of people to be quiet; she stands very straight and calm and carries no real weapon.

s3b_thornevia.why: 极境定在成套附魔战装，苇棚区出身在这一档只差一点；她一直不喜欢华丽的东西，所以照档用好料子，样子朴素，一件不多，剑照旧不镶石头。
s3b_thornevia.battle: Holding the wall: over the washed-out grey coat, a plain grey wall-issue enchanted cuirass with matching pauldrons, re-strapped over the old leather patched three times at the shoulders, a single unadorned rune line glowing faint blue-white along each edge, no gems, no ornament; plain rune-etched steel vambraces; a plain open iron cap with one thin rune band; the cloth bag at her back. She grips the hemp-wrapped plain sword in both hands low in front of her, the point forward, the feet set wide and the weight steady. A hard, level look.

s3b_frieren.why: 传奇是这一纪顶上那一身，但她是法师，一向不在乎甲，顶上的东西只落在古法刻的护臂、斗篷和长杖上。
s3b_frieren.battle: Casting at the wall: the silver-grey cloak thrown back, its faded dew-drop embroidery shining faintly like an old ward, a fitted pale tunic and trousers, slender silver-white elven vambraces engraved with fine Silver-Dew script that glows pale green. She holds the tall staff out in both hands, the cloudy crystal glowing pale green, rings of precise pale-green script turning slowly in the air before it, the red drop earrings swinging, the feet set apart. A flat, calm, unhurried look.

s3b_ruprecht.why: 原页没写位阶，照守墙家主的身份估作灵格；措尔家守鹳桥两百年、收了几十年赎金，家里拿得出带家纹的附魔件，可他在门楼上喊令不动手。
s3b_ruprecht.battle: the old greatcoat with the half-stork badge buttoned to the chin over a steel gorget of old enchanted wall steel, a thin blue-white rune line along its rim, a crested enchanted round shield slung on his back whose painted stork crest glows faintly along its lines, standing on the top of the fort gate with a fist on the stone parapet and the other hand pointing, the mouth open to shout an order; he carries no weapon.

s3b_dorkan.why: 原页没写位阶，照营主的身份和身量估作极境；部里缺盐，家境一般，他话少不改口，一身实用的重甲，铁杖照旧是招牌。
s3b_dorkan.battle: Standing at the head of his camp: the long dark coat thrown back over a heavy cuirass of dark salvaged war plates riveted onto thick leather, the seams lit by faint storm-blue rune lines; broad rune-etched black iron vambraces in place of studded bracers, a lit crystal set at each wrist; the iron staff gripped upright in his right hand and planted hard in the ground, a faint crackle of stormlight round its foot; the left hand open at his side. A hard, immovable look.

s3b_lorenz.why: 原页没写位阶，老号手估作共鸣，又是段城兵户，只在号衣外头多一两件墙上发的旧附魔件；他吹号不出墙。
s3b_lorenz.battle: the thick grey fort coat buttoned to the chin, a single old wall-issue enchanted pauldron strapped over the left shoulder with one small lit crystal in its socket, a small rune lantern glowing pale at the belt, standing on the top of the gate tower in the cold dawn with the long cow-horn bugle raised to the lips in both hands, the old command-marks cut round its body catching a faint rune glow, the cheeks puffed round, the stooped back straightened; he carries no weapon.

s3b_regina.why: 原页没写位阶，照能起几十块封石估作灵格；她的本事全在祭堂和誓词上，离了封石只是拄杖的老人，所以不披甲，只让袖口的封石纹和杖头白石带光。
s3b_regina.battle: the long black robe buttoned to the throat, the ring of stone-sealing marks round each cuff glowing a faint warm white, sitting upright and alone at the end of a long chapel table with the copper lot-tube set in front of her and one hand flat on its lid, the other holding the staff upright, the small white stone in its head softly lit, waiting for someone who does not come; she carries no weapon.

s3b_heinz.why: 原页没写位阶，他是算账的代表，估作启源；魏岑家是阶上十四家，家里给他一枚护身的晶石别针，可他不打仗，不披甲。
s3b_heinz.battle: the dark green coat buttoned up, a small crystal ward-brooch from the family glowing faint blue at the lapel, seated at the table with the thick ledger open flat in front of him, its brass clasp etched with a faintly lit locking rune, one finger pressed on a line of figures, the other hand holding up a pen as if about to strike something out, the mouth open to speak; he carries no weapon.

s3b_therese.why: 原页没写位阶，守最南门三十年，估作灵格；格伦茨是守墙世家，家里有成套的东西，可她性子直、不讲排场，只穿实用的，堵门时不拔兵器。
s3b_therese.battle: the old riding coat buttoned up over a fitted coat of fine enchanted mail whose links glow faint blue-white at the collar and cuffs, the boundary-stone badge on the chest with its rope notch faintly rune-lit, standing square in the middle of the narrow gate passage at the southernmost gate with the feet apart, one hand holding up the heavy key ring, each key faintly glowing, and the other held out flat to stop someone, the jaw set; she carries no weapon.

s3b_rudiger.why: 原页没写位阶，替墙上兵说话的兵家次子，估作灵格；埃森家是阶上世家，低位阶时家境加两档，所以是家里打的整套，带家纹亮盾和大魔导刻的铳。
s3b_rudiger.battle: Defending a gate, in the Essen soldier house's harness: the dark green coat over a fitted enchanted breastplate and fine glowing mail, the iron shield badge on his chest, rune-etched steel vambraces, an open iron cap with a blue-white rune band. He holds the brass casting piece out at arm's length in one hand, its great-mage rune-lines glowing and a crystal cartridge lit in its breech, and in the other a round iron-rimmed enchanted shield whose iron-shield crest shines along its lines, the feet planted wide and the casting piece pointed along the wall. A hard, narrow look.

s3b_servian.why: 原页没写位阶，夜绯家主估作极境，家里给得起量身打的东西，可这一格他摘了手套摊开空手表明身上无物，所以手边不能有任何亮的家什，只在领口留一道家里的护线。
s3b_servian.battle: sitting at the table with the black cloak off, the long deep red coat buttoned to the throat with a fine crimson ward thread glowing faintly along the high collar, the two dark red gloves laid side by side in front of him, the black silk worn away at one wrist, both bare hands spread palms-up and flat on the wood as a plain sign that there is nothing in them, the face calm; he carries no weapon.

s3b_torbe.why: 原页没写位阶，烤面包的炎角估作启源，营里穷，他也不打仗，只在干活的衣服上多一件捡来的隔热附魔护臂。
s3b_torbe.battle: the long flour-white canvas apron over the shirt, a salvaged rune-stitched leather heat-guard strapped over one scarred forearm, its faint orange runes holding back the heat, standing in front of a blazing flat baking stone, both hands holding a wooden peel with loaves on it out of the heat, steam on his face, the mouth set in a grim line; he carries no weapon.

s3b_valdrak.why: 角冠家的孩子，这时在工匠街学炉二十年，估灵格；家里是高座底下最体面的一家，他又是铁匠，能自己回炉锻一身成套的。照灵格加世家一档定在3。黑甲、焦红斗篷、素铁大剑照旧，只在焊缝里透余烬光，不提前写往后的事。
s3b_valdrak.battle: Standing guard at the craft-street gate, in war gear he forged and fitted at his own anvil: a thick black cuirass of salvaged enchanted wall plate re-forged to his frame, its seams burnt dark and glowing a dull ember red along the welds; matching black plated pauldrons; forged-iron vambraces with a small lit fire crystal set at each wrist; a scorched dark red cloak over the shoulders. He grips a heavy plain iron broadsword in both hands, the point low, the feet planted, the black horns catching the light. A hard, steady look.

s3b_mortus.why: 他是钟楼长家的孩子，可五岁就没了家，跟着哈诺在雨城长大，家境按中算。这一格是门边抄名，姿势句写明不带兵器，他的路子是记名，不是打仗，所以原句不改。
s3b_mortus.battle: the grey high-collared coat buttoned to the throat, kneeling beside the gate-passage fire with the thick name-ledger open on one knee and a pen in the hand, the lips moving as he reads a name back; he carries no weapon.

s3b_grom.why: 他生在锁奴的粮仓，是补屋顶的手艺人。这一格是房脊上递钉子给孩子，姿势句写明不带兵器，这是他选的样子，所以原句不改。
s3b_grom.battle: the leather apron over the jerkin, standing on a steep roof ridge with the feet set wide and a hammer raised in one hand, the other holding out a nail to a child who stands just below, the face patient; he carries no weapon.

s3b_delo.why: 她是镜殿家的小女儿，家里富，可这一格是夜里守做噩梦的孩子，姿势句写明不带兵器。她靠的是梦和影子，不靠甲，所以原句不改。
s3b_delo.battle: the dark indigo dress and grey shawl, standing with one hand held out open and the other holding a small lamp, the face gentle; she carries no weapon.

s3b_sirentia.why: 她是十岁的孩子，这一格坐在长桌角记名，姿势句写明不带兵器，孩子不硬穿甲，所以原句不改。
s3b_sirentia.battle: the sea-grey dress, sitting on a high bench at the corner of the long table with the feet not reaching the floor, the little notebook open in front of her and a pencil in her fist, the face screwed up in concentration; she carries no weapon.

s3n_pepper.why: 底座写共鸣 LVL 38。她是下街散了班的篷车戏法人，家境穷，又要轻身上房，只在干活的衣服外头加两三件捡来的附魔件。
s3n_pepper.battle: Ready for a trick that can kill, in a few salvaged pieces over her road clothes: the diamond-check cape is thrown back off the shoulders. Over the linen shirt a snug brown vest of old enchanted leather from the wall stores, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along its seams; on both wrists salvaged steel bracers with brass hinges and one small lit crystal each, playing cards slotted inside; the shorts with the striped stockings, and soft shoes for climbing rooftops. The trunk is left behind. A spray of playing cards fans out from her right hand, a few already spinning in the air, and her left hand is held open and empty, palm out. Sharp bright eyes and a closed-mouth smirk.

s3n_medaena.why: 底座写共鸣 LVL 24。她是谷外打井人家的姑娘，替买不起渠水的村子找水，穿的是捡来拼上的附魔件。旧桶和短镐不动。
s3n_medaena.battle: Ready for the dry riverbeds and what crawls in them, in salvaged pieces over her well-finding clothes: a worn grey wall-issue enchanted leather jerkin laced over the blue tunic, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; one dented enchanted pauldron re-strapped with well rope on the left shoulder, a single small crystal still lit in its socket; brass-jointed forearm guards from a broken war machine; a wide belt with a water skin and a small rune lantern, the trousers tucked into her boots. The bucket stays on her back on its rope. She holds the short pick low in her right hand, a faint white line of light along its iron head, and her left hand is open toward the ground as if feeling it. A level, focused look.

s3n_sebald.why: 原页只给 AI 的那一层写明他是灵格的凡人，家境是山边村子的打井人，穷。姿势句说他不是兵，所以只把下井的家什换成捡来的附魔件，蜡烛头和长镐不动。
s3n_sebald.battle: Going down a well, in a digger's kit pieced from war salvage rather than a soldier's harness: a heavy oilcloth apron over the blue tunic with a salvaged grey enchanted breastplate strapped over it, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; a rope harness at the waist hooked with brass clips cut from a clockwork war machine; leather wrist wraps under brass-jointed forearm plates etched with a dim rune circuit; a stub of candle in a tin holder hooked at his belt. He grips the long pick in both hands across his body, a thin white line of light running along its iron head. A calm, set face.

s3n_baruna.why: 凝名的人照塞巴德那一档，估灵格。她出身营里，不报家姓，家境穷。她只拿身子扛东西，不拿兵器，所以只加捡来的肩甲和臂甲，两只烧黑的掌心照旧露着。
s3n_baruna.battle: Ready to carry what no one else can, in salvaged war plate over her work clothes: two heavy grey enchanted pauldrons from a wall armoury riveted onto the dark leather jerkin, rune lines glowing faint blue-white along their rims; both forearms wrapped thick and cased in brass-jointed plates salvaged from a clockwork war machine, stopping short of the bare palms; a broad belt cinched tight, the apron, hobnailed boots, the iron camp tag at her throat. She carries no weapon. Both burnt-black hands are raised palm up at shoulder height as if bracing a stone beam, legs braced, with a calm, intent face and the mouth closed.

s3n_dona.why: 凝名的堰口枪手，估灵格。她出身下堰的村子，脖后有债印，家境穷。她是守石颈的兵，身上是堰口发的旧附魔墙甲，拼凑起来改合身。607年捡的那杆旧枪不换。
s3n_dona.battle: Holding the narrow stone neck, in old weir-garrison war gear pieced together and refitted: over the wide-seamed coat a grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass re-laced with leather thongs, a blue-white rune line glowing along its edge and one magic crystal lit at the breastbone; a single scuffed enchanted pauldron on the spear shoulder; a mended rune-etched steel bracer on each forearm; the coat skirt tucked into the belt, and heavy boots. She holds the plain old weir spear she picked up in 607, its grip wrapped in faded cloth, tucked tight under her arm and aimed forward, a thin white light glinting at the point. Feet planted, a hard, focused look.

s3n_nenia.why: 她是坟原那一座黑山的座前祭司，活了近三百年，估极境，身份贵重。姿势句写明她不用刀、不动手，所以照她的档用好东西，只落在法衣上：发光的坟符纹和骨银护颈，不穿甲。石灯不动。
s3n_nenia.battle: Calling the dead, in the vestments of her throne rather than armour: her black veil, its hem stitched with grave-runes in thread that glows faint blue-green, is swept back by a cold wind over the high-collared black gown, whose small bone buttons are each carved with a warding sign and lit pale; a close gorget of thin bone-silver plates at the collar; the bone bell swings at the end of her braid. She raises the stone lamp high in her right hand and lifts its pierced shade away with her left, the blue-green flame flaring upward. No weapon. A serene, unpitying face.

s3n_dipold.why: 他是上城大教堂旧派的老祭司，管九道门的祷文，有教堂供着，家境算富。他是修士，不穿甲，所以档落在祭衣上：附魔羊毛袍、发光的九针圣带、白石护符。祷杖不动。
