s3n_dipold.battle: Calling the Nine Gates, in the cathedral's warding vestments: the white robe woven of heavier enchanted wool, its hem and cuffs edged with a faint white rune line; small white-stone ward plaques sewn at both shoulders, each lit like a candle; the grey stole fluttering, the nine white stitches at its ends glowing in an arch; a rope belt hung with little white-stone charms. He raises the staff high over his head in his right hand, all nine white stones blazing like noon, and holds his left hand open as if blessing. His mouth is open in a shout and his pale eyes are wide.

s3n_gondolf.why: 他是段城的段守，出身兵户世家，估极境。极境加家境一档，定在4，是量身打的段守战装。他人板正，只讲数，所以甲上只刻段号，不加装饰。直剑和铜尺不动。
s3n_gondolf.battle: Commanding from the wall, in the segment-keeper's fitted war harness: a short coat of fine enchanted mail glowing faint blue-white at the links under the old grey-brown gunner's coat; a fitted steel gorget and shoulder plates engraved only with his segment's number, no ornament; steel gauntlets with small crystal sockets stained dark red with crystal powder, one lit; the segment-keeper's seal on a chain round his neck, and polished black boots. He draws a plain straight arming sword with his right hand, NOT a curved sword, while his left hand holds the brass range ruler up beside the red crystal eye to sight the distance. A hard face.

s3n_linhart.why: 宴火六人在649年以前都是英雄里最高的一截，英雄不看家境，定在4。用的是斯滕家传下来的整套墙甲，配会亮的家纹盾，跟样张对得上，照样张交回。
s3n_linhart.battle: On the road to the hall, in the Sten family's handed-down war harness: a fitted breastplate and tassets of old enchanted wall steel over glowing fine mail, the plates engraved with the Sten stone-course pattern whose grooves shine soft white, matching steel pauldrons and vambraces, a faded grey-brown surcoat cut short over it; a round enchanted shield on his back whose painted stone-course crest lights up along its lines. He holds the straight longsword drawn in both hands, NOT a curved sword, with white fire running along the blade from the pale god-killer core set in the crossguard. A calm, grim face.

s3n_tishawen.why: 她是宴火六人之一，英雄，不看家境。她是翠冠的守望者，要拉长弓，所以穿量身打的轻鳞甲，不上重甲。鹿角长弓和发光的箭不动。
s3n_tishawen.battle: On the ridge, in an old watcher's harness of the Verdant Crown: the silver-grey cloak pinned back, its edge stitched with a faint silver ward thread; over the moss-green tunic a fitted light cuirass of overlapping silver-green enchanted scale, a thin pale rune line glowing along each plate; a single matching scale pauldron; the bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) now of rune-etched ward steel with one small lit crystal; the quiver on her back. She draws the longbow to her cheek, the antler bound to its upper tip and an arrow nocked with pale light along its shaft. A calm, exact gaze.

s3n_kurga.why: 他是宴火六人之一，英雄，出身奴坑，可英雄往上不看家境。他不拿刀不拿棍，只靠锁链和身子，所以照英雄的档用好料子，样子朴素、不加徽记。左锁骨的奴印和右脚踝的断环都露着，铁链不改。
s3n_kurga.battle: Braced to hold a gate, in heavy war plate kept deliberately plain: over the hemp shirt a thick enchanted leather-and-plate cuirass cut open at the left collar so the slave brand stays bare, a dull blue-white rune line along its seams, no badge or ornament; massive grey enchanted pauldrons riveted on both shoulders; wide rune-etched iron bracers; a leather apron of the pit workers strapped over the trousers, the hide shoes bound tight, the split ring still on his right ankle. A long length of heavy iron chain is slung across both shoulders behind his neck, both fists gripping it; no blade, no club.

s3n_yerdan.why: 原页没写位阶，他活了近两百年，靠秤和买卖立身，从不拿刀，按共鸣估。集口作保、换盐换药，家底是富，可他从不出手，拿刀的是他雇的人，所以不穿甲。只照白鸦年间遗迹货的样子，给一件缝了护符线的斗篷、一枚沉塔里出来的护符，暗处还衬一层轻甲网，都是走蛾子路防身的东西，不是打仗的东西。
s3n_yerdan.battle: On the road through the reeds, dressed to pass unharmed rather than to fight: a hooded reed-green oilcloth cloak over the buttoned coat, its lining stitched with a faint ward thread that glows dull green-white along the hem and hood edge; a soft dark felt cap pulled down under the hood; beneath the coat a thin salvaged mesh from a sunken tower, glimpsed only at the cuff as a faint silver shimmer; oilcloth gaiters over the boots; a leather satchel slung across the body, a small dim-lit ward charm of old tower glass hanging from its strap. He holds a small brass weight on its cord in one hand; he carries no knife and no weapon.

s4a_hano.why: 极境底子是三档，但他是从盐井边赎出来的书记，从不拿兵器。所以不给他穿甲，只在斗篷里缝西边的血书护符，照旧蹲着记名字。
s4a_hano.battle: Sitting out a night at the gate under attack, unarmed by choice, warded rather than armoured: the washed-pale grey Rain City cloak pulled close and buttoned at the throat, its deep grey lining stitched with blood-script ward runes that glow a dull red when stones fly; a plain dark shirt beneath, no plate; the small brass bell on its cord at his left wrist; the two leather pouches at his belt, soft boots. He crouches low behind a stone with the notebook open on his knee and the charcoal stick held ready, the fresh ink on the page shifting dark and pale. A steady, unblinking gaze.

s4a_dot.why: 灵格，门洞守卫出身穷，所以在旧皮甲外头罩几件墙上捡来的附魔件。瑟尔卡的盾、短枪和十七道刻痕的瓢照旧，原句里写的“新朝发的”在661年还对不上，改成旧墙甲。
s4a_dot.battle: Holding the gate passage, in salvaged war gear over her gatekeeper's clothes: the oilcloth cloak thrown back over the old boiled-leather jerkin, a patch sewn on the left shoulder, and strapped over it a grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass from the last great war, re-buckled to fit, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; one rune-etched steel vambrace on the spear arm; leather gloves, sturdy boots; the willow gourd ladle with its seventeen tally marks and an empty waist-tag ring at the belt. She braces behind the round shield, its old iron rim engraved with runes that glow faint blue and a salvaged magic crystal lit in the boss, the short spear levelled over its edge. Feet planted wide, a hard, level gaze.

s4a_regha.why: 灵格，公所信使家里不宽裕，又要跑三天三夜，所以只加几件轻的捡来附魔件。刀照旧不拔。
s4a_regha.battle: Running a message through a war zone, light by trade: the guild coat buttoned to the throat, lined with a salvaged panel of fine enchanted mesh whose seams glint faint blue-white; thin rune-etched leather bracers on both forearms; the flat letter satchel strapped tight across her chest, its flap stitched with a glowing ward thread; the iron-soled boots, the crooked sole plates scratched with small glowing runes; a leather glove on each hand. She is mid-stride at a flat run, one hand holding the letter satchel, a short knife at her belt that she never draws, a fierce, focused look.

s4a_ithan.why: 灵格的老信使，家境寻常，跑长程要轻，所以只换一件附魔软甲、一块小肩甲。跟瑞嘉的差别在挡箭的肩甲和腕上的晶粒。
s4a_ithan.battle: Running a letter through the line, in a long-runner's light salvage: the guild coat buttoned over a thin enchanted padded vest from the wall armouries, a faint blue-white rune line along its hem; a single small rune-etched pauldron on the left shoulder against arrows; the satchel strapped across his chest, its two buckles faintly rune-lit; long boots, leather gloves with a tiny lit crystal at each wrist; a coil of rope at the belt. He is at a steady long-striding run, one arm swinging, a short knife in his belt that he never draws, a focused, level gaze.

s4a_ruda.why: 极境，但她是出过地牢的药师，从不拿刀打人，所以不披甲。用西边车队深灰皮围裙上的血书符文和单只黑手套来显她的档次和来路。
s4a_ruda.battle: Running a field dressing-station on a battlefield, a healer who will not fight: the washed-pale grey robe belted tight, the sleeves bound, one cuff torn short; over it a deep grey leather apron from the westward caravan, its hem and pockets lined with blood-script runes glowing dull red; a thin black glove on the left hand only, its back written with red-lit runes; both herb pouches at her belt; the bone knife on its leather cord. She crouches over a wounded soldier pressing a bandage into place, the bone knife in her other hand, a thread of drawn blood running back into the wound, a fierce, exacting gaze.

s4a_derk.why: 极境底子是三档，替役老兵出身穷，减一档成一身拼来的旧墙甲。招牌是长钩和会亮的白石。
s4a_derk.battle: Holding the tail of the caravan, in thirty years of wall gear refitted: the pale-washed wall coat buttoned over a mismatched set of grey wall-issue enchanted plate, breastplate, one pauldron and tassets salvaged from different men and re-strapped with cart harness, faint blue-white rune lines along every edge; rune-etched vambraces, leather gloves; a battered enchanted iron cap pushed back off the horn stumps; the empty name-tag ring and a bag of chipped white stones at his belt, the stones glowing a soft white line; the driver's whip coiled at his back. He braces with the long wrought-iron hook held across his body in both hands, the inner curve of the hook lit white, feet wide, a hard, level gaze.

s4a_thornevia.why: 英雄位阶不看家境，用的是好东西，但她一直不喜欢华丽的装备，所以去掉纹章、晶石和雕饰，补过的旧皮甲照穿。跨页到668年传奇时只升料子，样子照旧朴素。
s4a_thornevia.battle: Marching the line, in gear as good as her rank and as plain as she wants it: the patched leather armour, four patches on the shoulder, worn over the faded officer coat with its insignia torn off, and under the leather a fitted brigandine of dark enchanted steel plates, unpolished, with no crest, engraving or crystal on show; plain steel vambraces of the same make, their rune lines hidden on the inside; a worn plain cloak thrown back, riding boots, the cloth bag at the back of her belt. She holds the hemp-wrapped sword drawn point-down in front of her with both hands, a faint pale gold light along its edge, a grounded, unmoving stance, a hard level gaze.

s4a_benedi.why: 灵格的白烛祭司，家里有姓，教会派出来的，不带兵器。所以只给一件缝护线的短披肩和领口一颗护晶，烛台和白烛光照旧。
s4a_benedi.battle: Kneeling among the wounded on a burning slope, a priest who carries no weapon: the grey robe with the white candle on the left chest belted tight, the sleeves bound, the knees patched; across his shoulders a short grey white-candle mantle stitched with a pale ward thread that glows white where sparks fall; a small salvaged ward crystal sewn inside the collar; leather gloves; the cloth bag of powder at his hip. He presses a bandage to a soldier's side with one hand and holds the soot-blackened candlestick up like a small lamp in the other, its white flame steady in the wind; a steady, calm gaze.

s4a_joren.why: 灵格的苇棚区厨娘，打不了仗，所以不穿甲。只在背锅的地方垫一块捡来的墙甲片，锅底的火照她的本事发亮。跨页照旧不打仗。
s4a_joren.battle: Feeding a camp while the line is under attack, a cook and not a fighter: a thick wool coat under the burn-patched oilcloth apron, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a wool scarf; a scrap of grey enchanted wall plate strapped across her back as a pad under the great iron pot, its rune line glowing faint blue-white; the pot's thrice-patched bottom glowing a low ember red with the fire that will not go out; the salt bag and kitchen knife at her belt. She grips the long-handled iron ladle in one fist like a club, feet planted, a gruff, stubborn look.

s4a_sanna.why: 十三岁的孩子，衣服是同行的人凑的，她出来是找人，不是打仗。所以不加甲，照第三格的姿势句交回，只补上腕上那截绳。
s4a_sanna.battle: Out in the lanes after a lost child: the grey coat buttoned up to her chin with the sleeves rolled three times, a wool cap pulled down over her ears, sturdy boots, a coil of rope over one shoulder, the burnt length of rope knotted round her left wrist; she carries no weapon and wears no armour, standing braced, holding the rope end tight in both hands and looking sharply ahead.

s4a_niko.why: 共鸣的短程信使，穿父亲改小的外套，所以只多一块捡来的、嫌大的附魔肩甲。
s4a_niko.battle: Running a short message along the road, a girl in borrowed kit: her father's cut-down guild coat buttoned to the throat, one salvaged enchanted shoulder guard too big for her strapped over the left shoulder with extra cord, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; the flat satchel with its two buckles strapped across her chest; soft boots, gloves, the small salt pouch at the belt. She is mid-stride at a flat run, one hand on the satchel strap, a determined, focused look.

s4a_gunter.why: 灵格本身出身苇棚区，但穿的是冠台宫库配的整套，所以加一档。原句胸口的井纹是布伦海姆家的，“不镀金”是新朝的样子，这里改回旧冠台卫兵的鸢纹。
s4a_gunter.battle: On the crown terrace on the night of the rising, in the crown's own guard harness: the white guard coat with the gold-embroidered kite at the collar and the captain's gold shoulder edging, buttoned over a polished enchanted steel cuirass and gorget from the palace armoury, a thin blue-white rune line along every rim and a small kite engraved on the breast; steel shoulder plates under the coat; rune-lit gauntlets with a small crystal at each wrist; a cap-helm with a short white plume; the square of folded white linen at his belt, boots polished to a shine. He holds the long white-plumed spear grounded in both hands, its blade etched with a pale line of rune light, a stern, unmoving stance and a hard level gaze.

s4b_renate.why: 灵格，种麦人家出身，跟着逆军，没有配发，所以在补了二十几回的皮甲外头拼两件墙上捡来的附魔件，盾心嵌一颗晶石。
s4b_renate.battle: Facing the palace stair on the night of the uprising, in a farm girl's pieced-together salvage: the patched leather cuirass, its left shoulder mended with sacking, over the tunic with a small embroidered dike mark on the back; strapped on top a single grey enchanted pauldron and one rune-etched vambrace picked off the wall, faint blue-white lines along their edges; the scuffed wall-issue boots laced tight with knotted laces, planted wide. The short spear levelled forward in both hands with a faint rune scratched along the shaft, the dull round shield painted with a dike pattern braced on the left arm, a salvaged magic crystal glowing in its boss. A hard, forward, determined gaze.

s4b_johanna.why: 史官世家，照档该穿得好，但她只记不打。所以只给一支护身的白烛和镜片上的家传符纹，照第三格的姿势句写柱边、举笔、手里拿写字板。
s4b_johanna.battle: Standing at the upper step of the long stair during the night of the dawn coup, recording rather than fighting: the long dark grey historian's robe buttoned at the neck, the black sleeve-guards, the ink pot, pen case and paper knife at her belt; her only protection a small white candle in a brass holder clipped to the writing board, its steady flame throwing a faint ward of light around her; the old family lens clipped on her nose, its rim faintly rune-lit. Very straight beside a pillar, one hand holding a pen raised as if mid-word, the other the small writing board. She carries no weapon.

s4b_jens.why: 灵格，伙房长大的孤儿，本该是拼来的，但670年在新朝营里，新朝发的旧铜护喉护臂补足一档。祖父的肩片、段旗、铳和面包袋都照旧。
s4b_jens.battle: Holding a narrow lane in the Fourteen Houses' fighting, in the new dynasty's plain issue over his old leather: the old leather cuirass with his grandfather's left shoulder piece polished bright, pale runes flickering on it; over it a plain old-copper gorget and vambraces with engraved law lines holding a warm amber glow, no gilding; the short spear levelled in the right hand, the round shield with a painted dike pattern high on the left arm and a salvaged war crystal lit in its boss; the rolled faded banner across his back; a short spellcasting wand-arquebus with a small crystal cartridge and the bread bag at the belt. A steady, hard gaze.

s4b_berta.why: 极境再加九旗将世家，给家传的整套附魔板甲。投了新朝的老家甲上不镀金，所以样子素，只有井徽和白色符文亮，重剑是招牌。
s4b_berta.battle: On the wall in a siege night, in the Brenheim heirloom harness: full plain wall plate of old enchanted steel, close-fitted and buckled to the collar, the well emblem worked on the breastplate and no gilt on any rim, runes cut along the pauldron and tasset rims glowing a steady pale white; steel gauntlets; the heavy grey wolf-fur cloak that was her father's thrown back; the brass whistle at her belt. She holds the great two-handed sword point-down in front of her with both hands on the pommel, its well-rail crossguard wrapped in old leather, a pale thread of light along its fuller. A wide, braced stance, a hard, determined gaze.

s4b_helene.why: 启源（LVL 6）的十三岁孩子，祖上是白鸢王族，可家已被封、父亲判死，她只穿得上自己那一身。她本来就不出手，所以不加甲。手套上的白鸢微微发亮，写的是她血里的东西，不是装备。
s4b_helene.battle: Standing her ground at the foot of the ladder in the dockside house during the upheaval, in her own clothes with no armour at all: the navy wool dress buttoned to the collar, its worn cuffs kept neat; the white gloves on, the embroidered white kites at the wrists catching a faint silver-white glint, as the old house doors once answered her blood; the wooden clogs planted on the planks. One gloved hand points firmly down the lane and the other holds a small folded letter. No weapon, no armour, no charm; she does not fight.

s4b_grom.pref: 朴素实用，锁匠围裙当甲
s4b_grom.why: 极境（LVL 104），家境已经不大要紧，够得上成套的战装。他是锁匠，用自己拆来的门锁甲片把围裙加固成甲，招牌是那把刻纹短柄锤。跨页都照这个路子，只随位阶加厚。
s4b_grom.battle: Standing as a living gatepost at the camp, in a locksmith's war apron he built himself: the heavy leather apron belted tight over the sleeveless tunic, faced with overlapping iron lock-plates salvaged from wall gates, each plate stamped with a keyhole rune glowing faint violet; a thick iron gorget forged from old shackles; blackened iron vambraces wound with lock-wire, red blood-script runes running along the wire; heavy iron-capped boots; the old granary key on its leather cord at his neck; thin violet sparks in the beard. He grips the short-handled locksmith's hammer, its head etched with runes now glowing violet-white, in his right hand and plants his feet wide, a still, heavy, braced look.

s4b_lithia.pref: 礼装为甲，宴约之内不带刀
s4b_lithia.why: 她是极境（LVL 96）的世家家主，装备够得上成套，但她坐桌子从来不拔刃。所以把甲藏进骑装：衬里是附魔细网，手套上走血书符文，招牌是指尖牵出的绯丝。跨页同样不带刀。
s4b_lithia.battle: On the road to a table that may become a trap, dressed for the table and armoured beneath it: the deep crimson riding habit cut from rune-woven cloth, a fine lining of enchanted black mesh under the fitted jacket showing only at the cuffs; the black cloak buttoned to the throat, its hem stitched with a thread of dark red ward-light; black gloves banded with black silk, thin blood-script runes glowing red along each finger; tall black riding boots with slim dark steel shin plates. One gloved hand raised a little with the palm open, faint crimson threads trailing from the fingertips, the other holding the small leather wallet. She carries no blade, for within a banquet truce she never draws one.

s4b_selephen.why: 极境（LVL 88），按位阶该有成套战装。可他骨头轻、背不动重物，又光脚抓地，所以只穿薄甲片背心和护腕，招牌是喉下那枚风护符。前后各页都不拿兵器。
s4b_selephen.battle: Scouting ahead of the caravan, in light flying gear with nothing heavy: the old brown leather vest closed, refaced with thin dark leather plates over the chest, red blood-script runes glowing along their edges, the two back slits left wide for the wings; the slate shirt under it; light rune-stitched leather bracers; the flat leather pouch on its strap across the chest; a small wind charm of grey feather and crystal at the throat, lit pale green; the copper messenger bell wrapped tight at his belt; the deep teal wings half open behind him, bare feet gripping. He carries no weapon.

s4b_tilman.why: 灵格（LVL 61），修院收养的孤儿，进的是自封的骑士团，所以是一套改过的旧附魔甲，零件拆来拼凑、彼此不配。钥匙和没出鞘的剑照原样留着。
s4b_tilman.battle: Holding the keep gate against the self-styled order, in a poor knight's patched harness: the white surcoat with a thorn-wound star crown over old mail whose rings are etched with tiny thorn runes glowing faint white; on the right shoulder one dented enchanted wall pauldron and on the left forearm a mismatched vambrace, both re-strapped, their rune lines a dim blue-white, one small war crystal still lit in the pauldron; a plain steel gorget; the ring of eleven keys glinting with a thin gold light at his belt; the rust-ringed sword still in its scabbard gripped in his right hand like a club. A tight, wary, determined gaze.

s4b_valdrak.why: 720年英雄（LVL 152），到这一位阶不看家境，甲和刀都是自己锻的量身之物，刀够得上传家。他不讲装饰，烧穿的地方不补，甲也照旧只扣一半，前后各页一样。
s4b_valdrak.battle: Leading the redemption band at the mine pit mouth, in war gear he forged for himself and wears plainly: the black cuirass of his own forging, leather over dark iron plates, burned through in places and still only half-buckled by habit, an iron forge-core plate riveted over the chest glowing dull orange; a heavy dark-iron pauldron whose forged rune seams glow like cooling lava, its rim ringed with the clan's black glass; bare scarred arms in plain forged iron vambraces; mended road boots. The huge obsidian-edged blade gripped in both hands and planted point-down in front of him, a thin line of orange heat along its flat. A wide, braced stance leaning slightly forward, a hard, determined gaze.

s4b_sirentia.why: 极境（LVL 96），潮主家的女儿，流亡在外。她以唱潮为本事，不穿重甲，只用成套的织符潮袍、鳞披肩和鳞护腕，招牌是那只海螺。姿势照第三格，改成海螺凑到唇边。
s4b_sirentia.battle: Singing the tide on the old shore, in a tide-singer's robe instead of armour: the deep blue short robe belted, woven through with silver rune thread that glows like deep water along the slit hem; a short shoulder-mantle of overlapping tide-blue scales; slim sea-scale bracers each set with a small blue crystal; dark leggings, bare feet in the shallows; the salt pouch at her belt, the oilcloth notebook tucked away. One hand holds the spiral shell up to her lips, its rim ringed in silver glowing faint blue, and the other is raised palm-out toward the water; she carries no weapon. The jacket closes down the front with plain round buttons in a single straight row, no looped cords, no knotted toggles or frog fastenings.

s4b_boru.pref: 朴素实用，铁匠围裙当甲
s4b_boru.why: 极境（LVL 104），做铁匠的自己锻自己穿。用砧钢板加固围裙，招牌是那把落过雷的大锤。和儿子格罗姆的锁片围裙分开写：他这一身是雷纹砧钢板。
s4b_boru.battle: Standing at the forge doorway of the old forge camp, in the smith's own war kit: the burned leather apron belted tight, faced with heavy anvil-steel plates he riveted on himself, a thunder rune on the chest plate holding a faint blue-violet glow; bare scarred arms in thick iron vambraces with lightning-blue marks fused into the metal; the three loops of chain at his waist, every clasp turned outward; heavy iron-capped boots. He holds the big hammer in both hands planted head-down in front of him, a thin blue line of light along its head and the old lightning spots glowing. A wide, immovable stance, a grim, level gaze.

s4b_ugo.why: 灵格（LVL 66），但刚出坑，一无所有，也忘了手艺，靠的是一身钢骨。只给他一块格罗姆从拆料车里找来的旧胸甲。他不拿兵器，跨页也一样。
s4b_ugo.battle: Blocking a doorway against the dark, with almost nothing on him but what he was given: the patched brown coat buttoned up, short in the sleeves; strapped over its front a single dented old enchanted chest plate that Grom pulled from the salvage cart, its rune line nearly dark, one cracked crystal faintly lit; the three chain loops at his waist, clasps turned outward; heavy worn boots. He stands braced with both long arms spread wide across the frame, his head lowered; he carries no weapon.

s4c_lowei.why: 她以前守过塔，又活了六百多年，估作灵格。可如今只看书屋、不出手，所以不加甲，只留守望者的旧物：斗篷上的护缝线和皮手套，再拿一盏符文灯。
s4c_lowei.battle: Hauling the shelves down in the night, no armour, only the old warden's things she never gave up: the faded grey warden's cloak tied back, its hem still stitched with a worn ward-thread glowing faint green-white; sleeves rolled and tied; old warden's leather gloves with thin rune-lit cuffs; a canvas sling across the chest taking the weight of a stack of books. In one hand a small rune lantern with a pale crystal flame lifted to show the cellar steps, the other arm clutching one last tall stack of books to her chest; no weapon.

s4c_servian.why: 他是夜绯家主，又代表四座营来签约，估作极境，按位阶本该有成套战装。可这一格画的是他把手套放在桌上、摊开两手，空手是他自己选的，所以不加甲，只点明手套上的暗纹已经熄了。
s4c_servian.battle: Seated at the long table, in the clothes of the table and nothing more, by his own choice: the dark crimson coat of the plain western cut closed to the throat with small black buttons, a black waistcoat and white shirt beneath, no armour, no mesh, no charm; the dark red gloves taken off and laid side by side on the wooden table, the black silk worn through on the left, their faint red rune stitching gone dark; both bare hands spread flat and open beside them, palms down; nothing held. A level, quiet look.

s4c_torbe.why: 他是烤面包的炎角，估作共鸣。围裙外头罩两件捡来的附魔件，手里照旧握着那根铁头炉耙。
s4c_torbe.battle: Standing his ground when the night turns bad, in his kitchen clothes with two salvaged pieces over them: the leather-trimmed apron tied tight, an old grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass strapped over it with oven straps, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along its edge; one brass-jointed war-machine vambrace on the left forearm; the cap pulled down over the horn holes; thick oven gloves. He grips the long iron-tipped oven rake in both hands across his body like a bar, the iron tip glowing dull red with oven heat. A stubborn, planted stance, the jaw set.

s4c_baltina.why: 灰之魔女，活了六百多年，估作英雄，不看家境，穿的是做工好的量身战装。她向来朴素，铳上不刻纹，所以甲也不加纹章、不刻花，只是好料子；那把自制的火药短铳照原样留着。前后各页都一样朴素。
s4c_baltina.battle: On the road after a bad night, in plain, well-made gear with no ornament: a grey hooded cloak over the long deep grey coat, the coat lined with a fine dark enchanted mesh that shows only at the frayed hem, a plain dark steel breastplate fitted beneath it without crest or engraving; plain black leather vambraces; the black gloves on, riding boots, the notebook at her belt. In one hand, held low and pointed at the ground, a plain short black-powder pistol of her own making with no runes cut in it; the other hand open at her side, a thin trace of grey ash drifting from the fingertips. A still, level look, the mouth closed.

s4c_pavel.why: 二十一岁的碑匠，估作共鸣。这一格画的是干活，所以只在工装外头加一对机兵拆下来的护腕和一盏符文灯。
s4c_pavel.battle: The working stance of a carver, in his work clothes with salvage over them: the heavy leather apron tied tight, a pair of brass-jointed forearm plates salvaged from a clockwork war machine buckled on as wrist guards, their etched rune circuits glowing faint blue-white; a small rune lantern hooked at his belt beside the roll of chisels; a cap against flying chips. He grips a chisel set slanted against a slab of black glassy stone in one hand, its steel point lit with a thin line of spell-light where it bites, and the mallet raised in the other, the weight forward on one foot, an intent look.

s4c_zulak.why: 他领一队收血人，估作灵格，穿的是高座发的整套差服。照西边的样子，外套里缝黑皮甲片，手套和甲片上走血书红纹。刀照旧不碰。
s4c_zulak.battle: On the road with his work, in a collector's issue kit: the charcoal coat buttoned under the chin with small brass buttons, thin black leather plates sewn inside its front and shoulders, their edges traced with blood-script runes glowing dull red; a short black cloak; black riding gloves with red blood-script lines along the backs; the wax seal on its fine chain at his wrist; tall boots; the thin curved knife sheathed and untouched. He holds the black lacquered box against his chest with both hands, standing perfectly still, a polite, flat look.

s4c_exemperor.why: 他是退位的皇帝，一生不拔剑，连剑都绕着走，估作共鸣，家境本可以抬到第三档。可这一格画的是坐在河边、冠搁在膝上，不打仗是他一生的路子，所以不加甲，照原样只写那身灰外套。
s4c_exemperor.battle: Seated on a stone bench by the river in the plain undyed grey coat buttoned to the collar, no armour and no sword, as through his whole reign; a white linen shirt at the throat, soft old boots, the worn walking stick leaning against the bench; a thin gold crown laid across his knees with both long hands resting on it, the head slightly bowed, the eyes on the water; nothing else held, a quiet, still look.

s4c_melchior.why: 极境定为第三档，施特伦家三代圣骑士算世家，到了极境家境差不出多少。旧派骑士团讲苦修，所以战装用好料子，样子去掉装饰、不镀金，招牌是三代传下来的那把剑。
s4c_melchior.battle: Standing perfectly upright, in the Thorn-Crowned Order's war harness worn plain: the long white surcoat with the thorn-wound star crown stitched on the chest, cut over a full shirt of old enchanted wall mail and a fitted breastplate whose edge rune lines glow a faint white, no gilding, no ornament; plain steel pauldrons and vambraces, one lit war crystal set at each wrist; a plain leather belt with a bundle of thorn switches hung at it. Both hands rest on the pommel of the long sword planted point-down before him, the Strehlen family's three-generation blade, thorn runes along the fuller holding a cold white glow. The face stern and still, the mouth closed.

s4n_adalbert.why: 他能凝名，又守一段墙，估作极境，定第三档。埃森旁支的家底中等，不加档。为人谨慎，不戴首饰，所以装备成套但朴实，招牌是刻着家纹的那只附魔护臂。
s4n_adalbert.battle: On the wall through the night, in an Essen branch officer's wall harness: a grey-blue wool garrison coat over a fine shirt of enchanted wall mail, the collar still left open, thin blue-white rune lines running down the mail's edges; plain ungilded steel pauldrons from the wall armoury; on the left forearm an enchanted steel archer's bracer bearing the small iron-shield crest, a magic crystal set in it glowing blue-white; a leather finger tab on the right hand; a quiver crammed with arrows at the right hip, its rim rune-lit. He holds a tall, plain yew longbow in his left hand with an arrow nocked and drawn to the cheek. The shoulders perfectly level, the eyes narrowed and fixed.

s4n_silvio.why: 坑里的锁奴，凝名前估作灵格。家境最差，低位阶时要减一档，只能在破衣裳外头挂几件从守卫身上扒下来的东西。他是西边的人，符文用血书的红光。
s4n_silvio.battle: Lifting the chain, in what he tore off the pit guards: a sleeveless dark leather jerkin with a few scavenged black leather plates stitched on, their blood-script runes glowing dull red, over a ragged shirt; a single dented guard's pauldron lashed to one shoulder with rope; bloody rag strips wound round both palms, an old iron shackle cuff on the right wrist reused as a bracer; the boot laces now pulled tight and knotted. He grips a short, heavy iron mining chain in both hands, a lump of iron weight on its end, and swings it back over one shoulder; the links are smeared with his blood and glow red-hot along the iron. The knees bent, the eyes fierce, the mouth tight.

s4n_celestin.why: 662年时是极境，但出身苇棚区，装备是修院和埃森管家出钱配的，减一档。修院的猎人不挂徽记，所以只穿一套合身的好甲，不加任何装饰。
s4n_celestin.battle: Ready to bind, in a hunter's kit the monastery and the Essen steward paid for, kept plain: the crestless grey surcoat belted tight over a light grey steel half-cuirass and a fitted shirt of fine enchanted mail, a faint blue-white rune line along the hems and plate edges, no badge, no ornament; plain steel vambraces and fingerless leather gloves. The bramble at his wrists has grown out, and thorned white tendrils trail from it and curl in the air with a faint white glow. He holds a plain straight double-edged sword in his left hand, NOT a curved sword, point low and forward, with the right hand open and raised. He stands light on the toes, with cold, calm eyes.

s4n_cordula.why: 极境定第三档。珀尔滕家世代替埃森掌门，家境到了极境只差一截。她手里没有兵器，招牌是那串带符文光的钥匙和掌心的烙印。这一档和样张对得上，照样张交回。
s4n_cordula.battle: Raising the gate ward, in the warden's war kit of the new dynasty: over the iron-grey coat buttoned to the throat a plain old-copper breastplate and gorget with engraved law lines holding a warm amber glow, no gilding; a short grey cape over copper-plated shoulders; copper vambrace on the left forearm with a salvaged war crystal set in it; the heavy key ring on the belt, each key faintly rune-lit. She holds her bare right palm out flat in front of her, the eleven-stroke iron shield brand glowing pale white and faint white runes lifting from it into the shape of a hovering shield. The left hand at her side, the feet set, the face stern.

s4n_odorich.why: 管家自己不拿剑，本事全在总钥上，位阶是估的。埃森家有钱，但他不上阵，不该硬给他穿甲，只给一件缝了护身线的骑行斗篷。
s4n_odorich.battle: On a night raid with riders who carry no banner: a long black riding cloak over the black coat, the hood down, its dark lining stitched with a ward thread that glows faint blue-white along the hem and edges; black leather riding gloves, the iron ring worn over the left glove; no armour at all. He carries no sword. He holds the iron master key up in his right hand, its shield-shaped bow glowing faintly white, with the left hand open at his side. Upright and composed, the feet set.

s4n_jerg.why: 极境定第三档。断桅团八十来人，家底中等，靠遗迹捡来的东西凑成一身，重新漆上团徽。招牌是那根带链的桅钩。
s4n_jerg.battle: Leading a boarding, in his company's salvaged river kit: over the tarred coat an old enchanted wall half-plate repainted black with the white broken-mast badge, its rune lines glowing blue-white and one lit crystal at the breastbone; a dented enchanted iron cap with a rune band round the brow; brass-jointed vambraces salvaged from a clockwork war machine; a coil of hemp rope across the body. He swings the chained mast hook, the heavy iron hook flying out on its chain from one hand while the chain wraps round the other forearm, rune-lit iron rings flaring along the links. The feet braced wide, the beard plaits flying, the grin fierce.

s4n_seyfried.why: 英雄定第四档，到了这一阶家境已经不起作用。克莱门斯是十四家里最老的一家，战装量身打造，招牌是那杆鸢喙铳。
s4n_seyfried.battle: At Kite's Feather Shoal, in the Clemens house war harness made to his measure: a white surcoat with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, embroidered on the chest, over a tailored silver-white enchanted half-plate engraved with kite-feather lines glowing soft blue-white; matching articulated pauldrons and gorget, a pale crystal set in each; a long deep-blue cloak and white gloves with the kite at the cuffs. He levels Kite's Beak, the long rune-engraved spell-gun with the hooked, beak-shaped muzzle, in both hands, NOT a musket, its crystal cartridge lit, a thin blue-white thunder bolt crackling at the muzzle. His face is calm and cold.

s4n_heimrich.why: 灵格加上世家，本可以穿得更好，但他从不上阵，不穿甲。体面只放在缝了护身线的大衣和亮着符文的钥匙上。
s4n_heimrich.battle: Out on the gate towers in the cold: a heavy black wool greatcoat with a grey fur collar over the blue coat, its lining stitched with a ward thread that glows faint blue-white at the cuffs and hem, a small iron-shield clasp at the throat set with a dim war crystal; no armour. His left hand is bare, showing the iron shield ring. He carries no weapon: in his right hand he holds up a heavy ring of iron gate keys, their shield-shaped bows faintly rune-lit. Standing solid and unmoved, the feet planted.

s4n_sieghard.why: 极境本是第三档，格伦茨家守着南端大门，收过路钱，家底厚，加一档。这身是弓手的设计：只护左肩，好让拉弓的手臂放开。
s4n_sieghard.battle: At the gate with his branded arrows, in the Grenz house's archer harness: a grey wool coat cut short over a fitted shirt of enchanted mail and a light steel breastplate engraved with the boundary-stone crest, its grooves shining soft white; a single articulated pauldron on the left shoulder only, leaving the drawing arm free; an enchanted steel bracer on the left forearm with a lit crystal at the wrist; a leather archer's glove on the right hand; a quiver of pale arrows with the boundary mark burned into their shafts at the right hip. He holds a tall recurved longbow of horn and pale wood in his left hand, a branded name-arrow nocked and its shaft glowing with a faint white line. The right shoulder drops as he draws, and he keeps a calm smile.

s4n_reinhold.why: 院长只在受封时念那一句，从不打仗，位阶是估的。他穿的是礼袍，不该穿甲，只让圣带上的荆条绣线透一点白光。
s4n_reinhold.battle: At a knight's dubbing: a long white-and-grey ceremonial robe that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves, a white stole embroidered with thorn branches whose threads hold a faint white glow, the polished iron emblem at the chest; no armour. He carries no weapon. He holds a small bundle of thorned white bramble raised in his right hand, the left hand open and lowered as if resting on someone's head, murmuring. Standing still and solemn.

s5a_valdrak.pref: 照常，甲和刀都是自己炉边打的，靴子还是旧的
s5a_valdrak.why: 传奇，不看家境，用这一纪最顶上的一身。他的甲和刀都出自自己的炉子，所以写成角城最好的熔岩接缝重甲。补了又补的旧靴是他自己留着不换的，照留。
s5a_valdrak.battle: At the head of the Redemption Army on the seven bends of the lava road, in the finest war harness of the Horn City, forged by his own hands: massive plates of dark black iron whose every seam glows like cooling lava, forge-core runes burning deep red across the breastplate, heavy layered pauldrons and clawed gauntlets that smoulder at the knuckles, a dark cloak with the embroidered army badge, the old patched boots kept beneath it all. He grips the long-handled heavy blade in both hands, angled low across his body, its edge glowing like iron fresh from the forge, the twenty notches on the broken horn glowing red; braced at the very front, a hard, level look.

s5a_idna.pref: 照常，肩上那两块七坑的铁不换
s5a_idna.why: 七道弯以后到了英雄，不看家境，穿角城炉子给她量身打的一身。肩上两块是七坑的枷环熔的，这是她不肯换的东西，照留在新甲上。
s5a_idna.battle: Holding the way back, in a Horn City harness forged to her measure: a fitted cuirass and tassets of dark black iron with seams glowing a dull lava red over a dark padded tunic, and on each shoulder still the plates cast from the melted shackle rings, now riveted into the new harness, each bearing a ring-rune glowing a dull orange; dark iron vambraces, and greaves strapped over her scarred shins; the seven-knotted sash at her waist. She grips the long spear in both hands, its iron-capped butt glowing like a hot brand, slanted low across her body like a bar across a road, braced over a line she has just scored in the black ground, a level, unblinking look.

s5a_lithia.pref: 不靠装备，宴约之内从不拔刀，坐桌子的人
s5a_lithia.why: 位阶到了顶上一档，可她是坐桌子的人，宴约之内从不动刀，所以不给她硬穿甲。顶档的料子都用在骑装上：红园法织的布、带活红光的血棘纹、手套指尖的丝，姿势句里的空手照旧对得上。
s5a_lithia.battle: On the road to a table that may turn into a trap, in the Red Garden's finest work worn as clothing rather than armour: a deep crimson riding habit of spell-woven wool, a fitted jacket and long split skirt, blood-thorn vines embroidered at collar and cuffs that pulse with a faint living red light; the black cloak buttoned to the throat, fastened with a thorn-steel clasp set with a single blood crystal; black gloves banded with black silk, a few crimson threads glinting at the fingertips; tall black riding boots; the leather wallet at her waist. She carries no blade, for within a banquet truce she never draws one.

s5a_evelyn.pref: 不打仗，七夜以后一身黑
s5a_evelyn.why: 灵格，又是第十二席的家主，家境按世家往上提一档。不过她不出手，只给她红园做的护身斗篷和血晶扣，不穿甲。七夜以后只穿黑，这一点照旧。
s5a_evelyn.battle: On a banquet night when someone at the table may draw, in the twelfth seat's quiet protections: the high-collared black dress, a short black cloak buttoned to the throat and lined with ward-runes that glow a faint dark red, fastened by a small thorn-steel clasp with a blood crystal; a narrow black thorn-steel gorget hidden under the collar; the slim leather case at her belt, its brass catch faintly lit; soft black shoes. She carries no weapon; she holds a silver cup upside down in one hand and her slim silver needle in the other, a bead of red light at its point.

s5a_bennet.why: 灵格，宴城侍酒算中等家境，定第二档。他不动手，所以只在侍酒那一身里衬一层红园的附魔细网，再给誓簿和提灯加一点光，不加甲。
s5a_bennet.battle: Going down into the cellar with a lamp to count who is in the house: the long black coat buttoned to the collar, lined beneath with a fine mesh of thorn-steel from the Red Garden armoury whose links glint dark red at the cuffs, a single blood-crystal stud at the throat; white gloves; dark trousers and polished black shoes. The oath ledger is under one arm, its brass clasp faintly glowing and red thumbprints shining along the page edges. He holds up a lantern in his right hand, its crystal flame a low steady red; he carries no weapon.

s5a_sadie.rank: 共鸣（约790年，LVL 34，照三十八岁的样子估）
s5a_sadie.pref: 不打仗，身上不带会响的东西
s5a_sadie.why: 她三十八岁的样子大约在790年，那时是共鸣，又是没有家的孩子，只给一两件捡来的东西。东西都要不出声，所以是一件带消声符文的斗篷和一盏暗晶灯。
s5a_sadie.battle: Leading hidden people through the dark root tunnels: the dark short coat buttoned up under a short dark hooded cape salvaged from an old scout's kit, a muffling rune thread stitched along its hems that glows the faintest dim violet and swallows every rustle; the cuffs and hems tied close; soft shoes; nothing that makes a sound, no buckle, no bell; the copper hoop-plate tucked inside the collar. She holds a small shuttered lantern low in one hand, its old crystal giving a thin amber light, and raises the forefinger of the other to her lips; she carries no weapon.

s5a_mortus.why: 极境，家境中等，本该是成套的战装。但他是记名的人，从不出手，所以这一档都放在袍子和斗篷的护符上，招牌是那口灯箱，不穿甲。
s5a_mortus.battle: Walking a field after a battle to name the dead: the charcoal robe buttoned to the throat, its hem stitched with ward-runes that glow a pale cold white, under a grey hooded travelling cloak of spell-woven wool; the cuffs bound with cloth; the lamp chest on his back, its little compartments faintly lit and its corners capped in bone-silver; the pouch of Rain City ash and the bone bell clapper at his chest. He holds a small lit clay lamp in one hand and the open register against his chest with the other, its written names catching a faint glow; he carries no weapon.

s5a_mortus_bell.why: 到了传奇，用墓城最好的料子，不看家境。他从来不出手，跟前一页一样，所以不穿甲，只用骨银扣链和挂了小铃的斗篷来显钟楼长的身份。
s5a_mortus_bell.battle: Leading a company of lamp-bearers to a field of the dead, in a bell-tower keeper's finest robes: the grey high-collared keeper's robe woven through with silver ward thread, the notched bell at the hem glowing soft white; a long dark grey hooded travelling cloak fastened with a chain of bone-silver plates at the chest, tiny silent bone-silver bells hanging from its edge; the bone tag at his chest; the reading crystal at his eye. He holds up a small lit lamp in one hand and the open register against his chest with the other, the names on its pages glowing faintly; he carries no weapon.

s5a_rune.why: 灵格，钟楼长家的孩子，家境中等，定第二档。他是守夜拉钟的，不出手，所以只把护腕换成骨银的，再加一块护胸，好扛住绳子。
s5a_rune.battle: On the tower through the night watch, in a bell-ringer's issue from the tomb city: the grey apprentice robe belted tight with the old bell rope, its red-mended strand intact; over the chest a light bone-silver plate on straps, a pale rune line along its edge that brightens as the bell sounds; bone-silver wrist guards hung with two tiny bells; soft shoes; the bone tag at his chest. He holds a heavy coil of thick bell rope in both hands in front of him, the rope's old fibres faintly rune-lit; he carries no weapon.

s5a_rosanne.pref: 跑信，不带兵器，越轻越好
s5a_rosanne.why: 灵格，车队里跑信的人家，家境中等，定第二档。她要跑长程，所以用的都是轻件：一层附魔细网衬在里面，一副刻了符文的护臂，一件带护风符线的斗篷。
s5a_rosanne.battle: Running a long road through bad country, in a courier's light salvaged kit: the oilcloth jacket buttoned up over a thin shirt of enchanted fine mesh whose links glint blue-white at the collar, under a short hooded travelling cloak stitched along the hem with a weather-ward thread that glows faintly; rune-etched steel bracers, each with a small lit crystal at the wrist; cloth wraps round the shins; the letter bag strapped tight across her body, its triple-tied cord rune-sealed; the water skin and salt pouch at her waist; the three copper bells on her tail.

s5a_bearer.why: 灵格，但一辈子背水，家里穷，降一档。他不出手，只垫一块捡来的深潮鳞甲护肩，好让绳子不勒肩。颈上照旧什么都不挂，因为他没有名字可刻。
s5a_bearer.battle: Walking at the head of the stone-bearers into the fog: the patched homespun belted with the straw rope, and over the rope-worn shoulders a single salvaged pad of old tide-blue scale armour, its scales holding a faint glow like deep water, strapped on to take the bite of the ropes; cloth wraps round the shins; worn boots; nothing at his neck. A rough grey stone slab is roped onto his back. He grips the ropes at his chest with both hands; he carries no weapon.

s5a_yelin.why: 灵格刚起步，车队里修车人家的孩子，家境贫，降一档。工装照旧穿，只换成捡来的附魔护手和护膝，再加一件防潮斗篷。
s5a_yelin.battle: Working at the edge of the fog, salvaged gear over her stonecutter's clothes: the canvas work suit belted tight, and over the hands a pair of old enchanted steel gauntlets from the wall armouries, re-strapped, a blue-white rune line along each knuckle; old war-machine knee plates with brass gear joints buckled over the leather patches; a hooded grey canvas cloak with a damp-ward thread glowing faintly at the hem; the box of tools on her back; the crooked stone tag at her neck. She holds the hammer and a chisel ready to strike, the chisel edge faintly lit.

s5a_turben.why: 灵格，饥原挖井的，家境贫，降一档。只在油布外套和手套上加两三件捡来的东西，御寒、护膝，不加甲。铜油灯照旧不换。
s5a_turben.battle: Going down a frozen shaft in winter, a few salvaged pieces over his digger's clothes: the patched brown clothes under a thick oilcloth coat lined with an old enchanted warming thread that glows dull amber at the seams; leather gloves reinforced with rune-etched steel finger plates; salvaged war-machine knee guards with brass gear joints; a cloth for the nose and mouth hanging loose at the neck; the copper oil lamp lit at his belt. He grips the short pick in one hand, its head faintly rune-lit, the knotted cord coiled over the other shoulder.

s5a_hasha.why: 共鸣，饥原碗主家的女儿，家境穷，又不出手。只给她一件捡来的护风斗篷和一枚护身扣，袍子不动。
s5a_hasha.battle: On the last night of the year at the edge of the crater: the ochre-red robe belted tight, under a dark hooded cloak salvaged from some old army stores, a cold-ward rune thread glowing faintly blue-white along its hem, fastened at the throat with a chipped clasp holding one dim crystal; the copper steelyard and tally board at her waist. She holds an empty stone bowl turned upside down in both hands, about to set it on the ground; she does not fight.

s5a_delo.rank: 极境（LVL 104，742年前后），约771年以后英雄
s5a_delo.pref: 不靠装备，守夜的旧长外套
s5a_delo.why: 极境，镜殿家出身，家境最多加一档。她守夜、入梦，不打仗，偏爱那件补过的旧长外套，所以只在外套的料子和衬里上加梦护符文，不穿甲，也不戴会反光的东西。
s5a_delo.battle: Going down into a child's nightmare: the long deep grey coat buttoned to the collar, its many-mended hem now relined with dream-warded cloth from the mirror city, faint violet sleep-runes glowing softly along the lining and cuffs, the folded scrap of paper still tucked in one cuff; nothing reflective on her; the cloth bag at her waist; soft boots. One hand is raised with a faint glitter of sleep-sand at the fingertips; the other holds the tin cup.

s5b_nur_child.why: 启源的十岁孩子，家里穷，又不出手。只给她挂一枚捡来的避火护符，哥哥那件旧外套和光脚都照旧。
s5b_nur_child.battle: On the west wall of the Horn City on the day of the seven bends, calling out where the fire is: the outgrown coat buttoned up to the collar, the sleeves rolled, and hung on a cord over it one small salvaged fire-ward charm of dark black iron, its etched rune glowing like a coal; the small pouch of black stones at her waist; bare feet on the warm stone, the red cord tied tight for once. One hand is cupped beside her mouth as she calls and the other points down the slope; she does not fight.

s5b_nefra.why: 803年下四十九层时是英雄（LVL 158），镜殿世家的女儿，按档该穿量身做的。但她进梦不带兵器，身上也不能有照得见人的东西，所以不穿镜城那身嵌镜片的甲，只穿镜殿给守梦人做的哑光护身衣。旧外套、字条、锡杯都照留。
s5b_nefra.battle: Going down into a sleeper's dream at the bedside, in the mirror hall's dream-warden garb made for her, with nothing on it that shines or reflects: the old deep grey coat belted close over a fitted deep teal robe of the mirror-city cut, its tied cuffs and high collar stitched with matte ward-thread that glows a faint violet; a thin lining of dull dark enchanted mesh under the robe, no metal showing; a small unpolished black-stone ward charm on a cord at her throat; the folded note in her cuff, the cloth bag at her waist. One hand is raised with a faint glitter of sleep-sand at the fingertips, the other holds the dented tin cup; she carries no weapon.

s5b_esben.why: 灵格，是入赘磨镜家的工匠，家境中等。他守灯时自己不进梦、不打仗，所以只照灵格的底子在外套里加一件改合身的护身甲，把铜灯升成刻了符文的守灯灯，不给兵器。
s5b_esben.battle: Keeping the lamp for someone who has gone down into a dream, in a lamp-keeper's refitted ward gear: under the thick dark grey-teal wool coat buttoned to the collar, an old matte enchanted scale vest from the war, re-laced to fit his long frame, a faint violet rune line along its edges; the pale leather apron over it, its pockets heavy with grinding stones; a wool scarf stitched with a glowing ward thread; soft shoes that make no sound. He holds the lit copper lamp up before his chest in both hands, a ring of runes etched round its base glowing soft violet and throwing his shadow long; he never goes into the dream himself and carries no weapon.

s5b_lotta.why: 九岁的孩子，启源（LVL 9），磨镜家家境中等。她在床边唱歌，这一段里是被护着的人，不该穿甲，所以只加父母给的一枚护身符，和母亲在披肩里织进的护线。
s5b_lotta.battle: The five days she sat by a sleeper's bed and sang the way up, in a child's warding rather than armour: the oversized knitted shawl pulled tight over the long dark teal dress, a single ward thread knitted through its edge by her mother glowing faint violet; the cuffs tied; a small matte black-stone ward charm from her father's workshop on a hemp cord at her neck; one braid tied with the workshop hemp cord; thick stockings, bare feet. She holds a small cup of water in one hand and beats time in the air with the other, singing; she has nothing to fight with.

s5b_selephen.why: 824年冲进风眼那一夜到了传奇（LVL 204），出身寒微的事到这一档已经不算了。他天生轻骨，背不动重物，又一直穿那件旧皮背心，所以按顶档用最好的黑翼天塔料子，但只做成一副轻甲衣，样子朴素，背心照旧穿着。
s5b_selephen.battle: Going into the eye of the storm to drag the airships out, in the lightest black-wings war harness of the sky tower: over the old leather vest, buckled tight, a fitted harness of thin overlapping dark feather-shaped plates across the chest and shoulders, the edges glowing deep teal, leaving the wing slits free; plain dark plated vambraces with rope-grip palms; the leather harness strapped across the chest, the flat pouch on its strap; the thin rope coiled on one shoulder, bare feet. All six wings are half open behind him, the deep teal pair and the four of dark glass-like light and wind. He rings the small copper bell in one hand and grips a taut, thick tow rope over his shoulder with the other; he carries no weapon.

s5b_auro.why: 灵格，原是高巢的人，后来一辈子靠手艺吃饭，算中等家境。她是缝帆的，不出手打仗，所以照灵格的底子只穿一副改合身的轻羽甲、一件缝了辉羽的油布斗篷，护的是她在风里站得住。
s5b_auro.battle: Aboard the seventh airship on the night of the storm, in light sky-tower gear refitted for a sail-maker: the canvas dress belted short over dark wool leggings; a plain breast harness of dark feather-shaped metal plates over it, the edges glowing faint deep teal; a heavy oilcloth cape over the shoulders and the folded wings, one of her own luminous feathers sewn into each corner and shining soft white; the pouch of needles at her waist, the old feather on its cord at her neck. She holds a roll of spare sailcloth under one arm and the big sail needle in the other hand; she carries no weapon.

s5b_tuya.why: 灵格（LVL 47），生在大营，母亲是遗民的后人，家里穷，所以比同档的人低一档，穿的是塔港库里拆下来拼的旧羽甲片。她干的是挂索的活，用的东西照实用来。
s5b_tuya.battle: On the ropes between the airships in the storm, in salvaged pieces fitted for rope work: over the leather top a rigger's harness hung with iron hooks, each hook etched with a small rune glowing deep teal; a single mismatched black-wings pauldron of feather-shaped plates on the left shoulder, a faint deep teal glow at its edge; scuffed plated vambraces from the tower stores re-strapped with leather over the forearms; the coils of rope at her waist; the tail hooked round a rope behind her. She grips the hooked rope-knife in one hand, its hooked edge glinting with faint spell-light, and a taut rope in the other, ready to cut a fouled line, a sharp, fierce look.

s5b_grom.why: 847年台心挨了一夜雷，到了传奇（LVL 214），家境已经不算了。他是看牢的锁匠，一向只穿围裙和粗布褂，所以按顶档用雷城最好的风暴蓝金属，自己锻成一身朴素的甲，不加装饰，围裙照穿。
s5b_grom.battle: Leading the long chain into the wasteland, in plain war gear he forged himself under the thunder: a heavy unadorned breastplate and pauldrons of storm-blue metal, faint stormlight crackling along the seams, worn under the leather apron belted tight over the sleeveless tunic; thick storm-blue vambraces; heavy boots; a heavy iron chain locked to his left wrist, its loose end coiled over the forearm, each link etched with small runes, the purple marks blazing along his arms. He grips the short-handled locksmith's hammer in his right hand, its iron head ringed with crackling violet stormlight, a still, heavy, braced look.

s5b_ugo.why: 灵格（LVL 70），穿的是格罗姆给的旧衣，家境穷，又不打仗，只给他进雷区要用的两件挡雷的东西：一件雷鬃狼皮披肩，一块格罗姆打的胸板。腰上的铁链和水囊照旧。
s5b_ugo.battle: On the long chain into the wasteland, last in the line, with only what keeps the lightning off: a short cape of thunder-maned wolf pelt over the patched coat; a single plain storm-blue metal chest plate strapped on beneath it, forged by his nephew, faint stormlight flickering at its rim; the coat belted, his brother's chain loops at his waist; a short length of the great chain locked to his wrist with a rune-lit lock; a big leather water-skin slung on his back. He holds out a clay bowl, about to pass water down the line; he carries no weapon.

s5b_shekker.why: 灵格（LVL 63），是被判了死的犯人，身上只有牢里发的东西。他认路靠的是碎石和一双手，不带兵器。原句里的雷鬃狼皮短衣照留，只添一块牢库发的旧肩甲和上了锁的脚链。
s5b_shekker.battle: Leading the chained line through the wasteland, in what the gaol issued against the storm: a short coat sewn from thunder-maned wolf pelt, worn against the lightning; a single dented storm-blue shoulder plate from the gaol stores strapped over it, faint stormlight crackling at its edge; leather wraps on the shins; iron rings sewn to the cuffs that spit small violet sparks; a length of chain locked to his ankle with a rune-lit lock. He holds one hand up, palm out, signalling the line to stop, and grips a handful of gravel in the other; he carries no weapon.

s5b_sirentia.why: 这一夜开场时是英雄（LVL 174），潮主世家出身，按档该穿量身做的深潮鳞甲。她要下水唱潮、不带兵器，所以甲做在短袍底下，样子朴素，下水用的开衩短袍和盐袋、海螺都留着。861年以后才有的鲨皮手套这里不加。
s5b_sirentia.battle: Singing on the reef at the mouth of the bay, in a deep-tide war dress cut for diving and singing: under the slit deep blue robe, soaked and belted tight, a fitted shirt of fine tide-blue scale that glows softly like deep water, its hem slit to the thigh to swim; a high scaled gorget of the same tide-blue at the throat; plain tide-blue scale vambraces; the salt pouch and the copper-bound shell at her belt, the oilcloth packet tucked in her robe, bare feet on wet rock. She lifts one hand palm-down over the water as if to hold back the tide, the other holding the shell, the lips parted to sing; she carries no weapon.

s5b_tama.why: 共鸣（LVL 28），守灯老户，家境中等，自己说不是打仗的人。按低档在干活的衣服外头加两三件港里拣来的东西护身，火盆和柴刀照留。
s5b_tama.battle: On the tower top the night the sea rose, in a few salvaged harbour pieces over her working clothes: the grey wool coat buttoned up and belted; over it a scuffed tide-blue scale half-vest from the harbour stores, glowing faintly like deep water; leather gloves stitched with a faint rune thread against the heat; an old enchanted steel bracer on the left forearm, one small crystal still lit at the wrist; the hatchet at her belt, soaked to the knees. She holds the copper fire basin against her side with a small flame still burning in it and grips the short hatchet in the other hand; she is not a fighter.

s5b_hakan.why: 灵格（LVL 66），是双礁港打鱼的，家里穷，比同档低一档。他不打仗，只划船救人，所以只加一件拣来改成四个袖口的潮蓝鳞衫，再加几道发光的缆环。
s5b_hakan.battle: Rowing back out into the surge for the boats behind, in salvaged deep-tide scale cut for four arms: under the oilcloth jacket, belted tight, an old tide-blue scale shirt with four armholes slashed in it, glowing faintly like deep water; scuffed scale guards on the upper forearms; a rope coiled across the chest, rune-lit iron rings clamped along it; the knife at his belt, the tide slip on its cord, sea boots. The upper hands grip a long oar held low and diagonally across his body, the lower hands hold a coil of rope; he carries no weapon but the knife.

s5b_joren.why: 灵格（LVL 56），无氏族、苇棚区出身，比同档低一档。她不是打仗的人，所以只在干活的衣服里罩一件墙上下来的旧附魔胸甲，大锅和长柄勺照旧。
s5b_joren.battle: Feeding a whole camp in a hard winter, with one piece of old war salvage under her working clothes: a dented grey wall-issue enchanted breastplate strapped over a thick wool coat, its rune line relit faint blue-white at the edges, the oilcloth apron tied over it; a wool scarf; a single scuffed enchanted steel bracer on the ladle arm; the great iron pot on her back, the small engraved marks round its rim glowing faintly from the fire beneath; the long-handled iron ladle gripped in one fist like a club; she is not a fighter.

s5b_sanna.why: 灵格（LVL 49），苇棚区河滩的绳匠，家里穷，比同档低一档。她不带兵器，下河进巷都是去找人，所以只在外套底下加一件拣来的旧附魔链衫，再加一只护臂。
s5b_sanna.battle: Going into the river after a rope end swept away, or out into the lanes after a lost child, with two salvaged pieces under her working coat: an old enchanted mail vest from the wall armouries, its relit rune line glowing faint blue-white at the hem; a scuffed enchanted leather bracer on the left forearm beside the burnt rope at her wrist; the long coat belted tight over it, the headscarf knotted firm; a coil of heavy rope over one shoulder; she carries no weapon.

s5b_carlotta.why: 共鸣（LVL 32），但是上城科赫家的长女，家境往上加一档。她是书记，不带兵器，所以不挂铳，只在扣到顶的外套里穿家里给的一件薄附魔胸甲，再配一只晶灯，护她把真账送到法庭。
s5b_carlotta.battle: The night she carries the true ledger to the court, with her house's quiet protection under a clerk's coat: a slim refitted enchanted breastplate from the family chest, worn beneath the deep blue coat buttoned to the top, its rune line showing as a faint blue-white glow at the collar edge; a small gem-set ward clasp at the throat; the black sleeve-guards over the cuffs; a small shuttered lantern at her belt lit by a pale crystal. She holds the thick ledger open against her forearm with the left hand pressed flat on the page; she carries no weapon.

s5b_dora.why: 共鸣（LVL 27），码头扛夫，家里穷，又不打仗。只照低档在干活的衣服外头加两件拣来的附魔件，护的是扛包的背和肩，儿子的腰牌照旧。
s5b_dora.battle: On the gangplank, leading the porters' work song, in two salvaged war pieces fitted for carrying: the canvas coat with the padded shoulders, the sleeves rolled; a dented grey wall-issue enchanted pauldron re-strapped over the load-bearing shoulder, its relit rune line glowing faint blue-white; a leather back-pad stiffened with an old enchanted plate, one small crystal still lit at its edge; her son's dented tin tag on its cord. A heavy sack of grain sits on one shoulder, steadied with one big hand, the other hand balled into a fist; she does not fight.

s5_helion.why: 英雄LVL186不看家境，用的是好料子；她在下街团里藏着真龙的身份，又不带刀，所以样子照旧是团里的旧皮甲和门板盾，不加装饰
s5_helion.battle: Standing guard as an escort, in the company's plain kit made from far better stuff than it looks: the old brown jerkin is lined with fitted plates of dark enchanted wall steel, the iron studs on both shoulders set into small steel pauldrons whose rune lines are worn almost dull; the oilcloth coat buttoned to the throat over it, the felt hat pulled low; the big door-plank shield braced on her left arm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) in front of her body, its planks bound with three bands of old enchanted steel, one faint blue-white rune line along the rim; the iron crowbar gripped low in her right hand; she carries no blade. Feet planted, shoulders square, a calm, immovable look.

s5b_jabir.why: 领一窟人跟角城将军对打，估极境；窟里出身穷，降一档，只有一套拼起来的熔铁甲，招牌是那把磨薄的黑曜刃
s5b_jabir.battle: On the black stone at the foot of the seven bends, in salvaged lava-cave war gear: the scorched leather jerkin overlaid with mismatched plates of dark forged iron on the chest and left shoulder, their seams glowing like cooling lava; leather wraps on the forearms over the fresh cuts, a narrow iron cuff riveted over each; the rust-red sash, hide boots; the clan's ridge mark burned into the shoulder strap and glowing faintly. He grips the thin obsidian blade, its edge ground almost transparent and lit from inside by an ember-line, a cold, unwavering look.

s5b_nadir.why: 赎罪军最老的兵，估灵格；赎罪军穷、他自己赎罪低头，只在皮甲外头加几件炉板打的旧件
s5b_nadir.battle: On the seven bends behind the general, in the Army of Atonement's plain salvaged kit: the black leather jerkin buckled tight, shoulder pieces forged from old furnace plate with thin seams glowing like cooling lava, a single dark iron plate strapped over the heart; leather bracers with iron splints; a broad carrying strap across the chest for bearing the wounded, its buckle rune-warmed; the short undyed wool cloak; heavy boots. He grips the iron-tipped spear in both hands across his body, a still, steady look.

s5b_nur.why: 742年启源，861年长成角城试火的人，估灵格；她靠角和光脚探地火，不拿别的兵器，只穿一套轻的熔铁件
s5b_nur.battle: Walking ahead of the Redemption Army over the cooling lava, in the Horn City's light forge-watcher's war gear: a short scorched leather jerkin over the soot-grey tunic, closing with plain round buttons or simple buckles; leather wraps on the forearms under narrow bands of dark forged iron; forged iron plate at the shoulder and shin, its seams glowing like cooling lava; the red cord tied tight; bare feet. One hand points ahead to where the fire runs, the other holds a short iron-tipped probing staff low; she carries no other weapon.

s5b_ambrose.why: 宴城血誓祭司，估极境，红园上层；他不拿兵器，战装就是祭袍上的血书符文和一条红园的棘纹圣带
s5b_ambrose.battle: On the seventh night of the ball, beside the silver dish, in rite vestments rather than armour: the faded red robe, blood-script runes along its hem now glowing a dull red, under a dark red stole embroidered with the garden's thorn pattern that pulses with living red light; a thin thorned silver clasp at the collar; the sleeves tied back. He holds a slip of paper written in blood in one hand and a thin bone stylus in the other; he carries no weapon.

s5b_vigilia.why: 最老钟楼的钟楼长，八百多岁，估极境；这一格是在档案库里翻名册，不打仗，只把腰上的灯换成钟冢的骨银灯
s5b_vigilia.battle: The thirteen nights in the deepest archive under the tower: the high-collared grey robe with the small bell at its hem, the sleeves tied back, at her belt a small bone-silver lamp hung with a tiny bell, its pale steady light falling on the page. She holds a mouldering old name-register open close to her face and reads it with her bare-boned fingertips; she does not fight.

s5b_baltina.why: 灰之魔女，估传奇，不看家境；她跟遗民吃一样的饭，铳不刻纹，用这一纪最好的料子，样子却是素的深灰，一件不多
s5b_baltina.battle: Riding in after a disaster to count who came back, plain but finer than anything in the camps: a grey hooded travelling cloak over the long deep grey coat with its mountain-copper buttons, the coat lined with fine mountain-copper mesh that shows only at the cuffs; the black glove to the right elbow and the short black glove on the left; riding boots; the notebook at her belt. She holds low in one hand the plain short-barrelled black-powder gun she made herself, no runes cut on it, pointed at the ground; a still, cold, level look.

s5b_sibylla.why: 镜殿家主，估极境；城睡在梦里那七天她守灯不打仗，镜殿规矩身上不带照得见人的东西，所以不嵌镜片，只在袍上缝护梦的符线
s5b_sibylla.battle: Through the seven days the city lay drowned in dreams: the teal robe belted tight, the sleeves tied back, dark dream-ward runes stitched along the cuffs and collar glowing a soft violet, nothing on her that reflects. She holds an oil can in one hand and a small lamp in the other, its flame a steady violet-white, keeping the lamps by the sleepers lit; she does not fight.

s5b_hesper.why: 高巢最老一家的领头人，估极境；塔倒那一夜她不下去也不打，这一格照原样不改，穿甲反倒不对
s5b_hesper.battle: The night the tower falls and she will not come down: the blue robe, the grey shawl pinned tight, the wings folded close. She stands with both hands resting on the rolled star chart, refusing to move; she does not fight.

s5b_feyle.why: 领荒地的人一百多年，估极境；荒地穷降一档，她靠手里的雷不拿兵器，只在狼皮外套上缝雷城的风暴金属件
s5b_feyle.battle: Leading her people out of the vault onto the great round dais, in the wasteland's storm gear: the thunder-wolf pelt coat belted, storm-blue metal plates sewn over its shoulders and down the back, thin purple-white stormlight crackling along their edges; storm-blue metal bands over the leather wraps on the forearms; the branding-iron head on its cord at her neck. One hand is raised to shoulder height with purple sparks crackling in the open palm, the other clenched; she carries no weapon.

s5b_dari.why: 矿带上的牛魔矿工，估共鸣；家里穷，干活的帆布衣外头只罩两件捡来的附魔件
s5b_dari.battle: Locked to the end of the chain beside the condemned, in her miner's clothes with salvaged pieces: the canvas work clothes belted tight, an old dented storm-blue metal plate strapped over the chest with a faint crackle along its rim; leather wraps on the forearms, a scuffed enchanted vambrace on the right forearm; a small crystal miner's lamp glowing at the belt; a short length of iron chain locked to her left wrist. She grips a short mining pick in her right hand, a fierce, set look.

s5b_bea.why: 八岁的孩子，荒地里走回家，不打仗也不该穿甲，照原样不改
s5b_bea.battle: On the long walk home through the wasteland: the brown jacket buttoned up over the wool tunic, a grey wool hood, the boots wrapped with cloth. She clutches a folded grey blanket to her chest; she does not fight.

s5n_lorena.why: 共鸣LVL31，下街洗衣妇的女儿，家穷；她是代书人不拿兵器，只添一件几枚铜币买来的旧附魔护臂垫着折板
s5n_lorena.battle: At work on a hard petition: the patched brown coat buttoned up, the oilcloth sleeve covers pulled high, the grey-blue scarf tucked in; on her left forearm an old wall-issue enchanted vambrace bought for a few coins, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge, the folding board unfolded and propped on it like a lectern, a sheet of paper pinned to it. In her right hand the reed pen, taken from behind her ear, its tip raised, a few lines of fresh ink on the page glowing faintly. The ink pot hangs open at her belt. The feet are planted, the chin up, a sharp, attentive look straight ahead.

s5n_hannes.why: 共鸣LVL28，碑匠街作坊的小儿子，家境寻常；他不是兵，只在皮围裙外头罩两件捡来的机兵件和附魔护臂
s5n_hannes.battle: Braced to hold a collapsing wall, in his work gear with salvaged pieces: the leather apron tied tight over a grey wool short coat with doubled leather patches at the elbows; brass-jointed knee plates salvaged from a clockwork war machine, an old enchanted vambrace on the right forearm with a faint blue-white rune line; a leather strap across the chest holding the canvas chisel bag close; in his right hand a heavy stone-carver's mallet, in his left a long iron chisel held point-down. The feet are wide and planted, the shoulders set, the pale blue eyes narrowed in concentration, the mouth closed.

s5n_dorothea.why: 共鸣LVL26，史官世家却住窄巷，家境中等；她是史官不拿兵器，只把父亲那件旧斗篷写成缝了护符线的旧附魔斗篷
s5n_dorothea.battle: Called to record at a dangerous hour: the deep-grey robe buttoned to the top, over it her father's old dark wool travelling cloak fastened at the throat, an old enchanted cloak whose hem carries a faint ward thread glowing pale blue-white; the black sleeve covers on, the bone paper-knife at the belt; an open day-record held flat on her left forearm and a pen in her right hand raised mid-word, the written lines on the page glowing faintly like embers. She stands perfectly straight, the feet together, the violet eyes behind the lenses fixed and unblinking.

s5n_yazga.why: 灵格LVL44，南境栎溪的半兽人猎户，家穷，降一档，鹿皮褂外头是拆来拼的旧墙甲件，猎叉照旧
s5n_yazga.battle: Holding the fork-line against a charging beast, in pieced-together salvage over her hunting clothes: the deerskin jacket laced tight, over it an old wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass re-laced with hide thongs, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge and one small crystal still lit at the breastbone; mismatched enchanted bracers on both forearms; the hair pulled back except the left braid. She grips the oak hunting fork in both hands, the butt planted hard against the ground behind her heel, the two iron prongs angled forward at chest height, the knees bent deep and braced low; the skinning knife stays sheathed at the belt. The moss-green eyes fixed ahead, the jaw set, the tusks showing.

s5n_guido.why: 共鸣新兵，磨坊小儿子揭条子来混两顿饭，家里出不起整套，只在新兵外套上罩捡来的两件墙甲；门板和短剑是故事里的东西，照旧。
s5n_guido.battle: The night of the tide, in salvaged wall gear over his recruit clothes: the grey recruit coat buttoned up under an old grey wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass re-strapped with a borrowed belt, its edge rune line relit faint blue-white and one small crystal glowing at the breastbone; a single scuffed enchanted vambrace on his right forearm; the tin tag on its cord on his chest. On his left arm he carries a heavy wooden door torn from an empty house as a shield, the family's painted door plate still nailed to it, gripped by a rope handle; in his right hand the short sword. The feet are wide, the shoulder set into the door, scared but standing, the brows drawn together.

s5n_britta.why: 灵格的公所信使，家里世代跑信，不穷也不富；她靠跑和鼻子吃饭，不披重甲也不带兵器，所以给的是轻的附魔件：衬网、护臂和刻了风纹的铁底靴。
s5n_britta.battle: Running the wall-top at night with the guild's dispatch, kitted light for speed: the rust-brown short coat buttoned up and belted tight, its lining quilted with a thin enchanted mesh whose rune thread glows faint blue-white at the collar and cuffs; slim rune-etched steel bracers over the cuffs; the flat letter satchel strapped against the back, its clasp a small lit ward crystal; the iron-soled boots, their nailed plates etched with wind runes that glow with each step. She carries no weapon; she leans forward in a running stride along an invisible line, one arm out for balance, the ears flat back, singing, a faint pale shimmer of light trailing her steps.

s5n_edwin.rank: 极境（LVL 118，这一剑到英雄 LVL 124）
s5n_edwin.pref: 轻快，出刀要快不穿重甲
s5n_edwin.why: 极境到英雄的那一剑，高原放牦牛的家底到这一位阶已经不怎么算数，护车的工钱撑得起一身成套的附魔战装；他的剑讲快，所以甲是轻的、为出刀让开的，招牌是那块重打的风晶铁护肩。
s5n_edwin.battle: The cut at the sealed pass, in a wind-fighter's light war gear bought with years of guard pay: the felt cloak thrown back over the shoulders, its standing collar lined with pale wind-rune thread; a close-fitted cuirass of old enchanted wall steel laced over brown leather, its edges cut back for reach, faint sky-blue rune lines running along them; on the left shoulder the iron pauldron reforged as an enchanted steel pauldron set with a single wind crystal; rune-etched gauntlets; the hemp rope at the small of the back. He grips the narrow straight single-edged sword in both hands, just drawn, held low and forward, NOT a curved sword; the empty white fir scabbard hangs at the left hip. The knees are bent, the weight forward, the sky-blue eyes fixed, no expression at all.

s5n_svala.why: 共鸣，长厅里管粮、讲故事的人，不拿兵器；只给她一件长厅传下来的霜纹护符扣，翻山时挡风寒，杆和刀照旧。
s5n_svala.battle: Crossing the ridge in a white blizzard: the wolf-skin coat turned fur-inward and belted tight, a fur hood up over the braid, the white robe tucked high; at the throat an old enchanted hall-ward clasp of frost-rune silver, a salvaged war piece whose runes breathe faint cold mist; thick mittens; the birch pole held upright in her right hand like a staff, frost spreading from her fingertips along the wood and lighting its notches pale white; the skinning knife stays at the belt. She leans into the wind, the white lashes rimed with frost, a fierce, unflinching look.

s5n_werner.why: 共鸣的车夫，农家出身，在赶车外套外头罩一件捡来的墙甲、挂一盏符文灯；他学过背靠货车搭盾，所以背上挂一面旧附魔圆盾，手里照旧只拿牛鞭。
s5n_werner.battle: Leading the wagons through a blizzard, in a driver's salvaged kit: the brown driver's coat buttoned to the throat with a long wool scarf wound around the neck, and strapped over it an old grey wall-issue enchanted breastplate, its rune line glowing faint blue-white through the snow; a small rune lantern with a pale crystal flame hung from the belt; a dented enchanted round shield slung on his back, its rim faintly lit; the felt cap's earflaps still up, thick mittens, gaiters over the boots. He carries no weapon: the ox whip uncoiled in his right hand, the wheat ears on the handle blowing, the left arm raised to shield his eyes, leaning forward into the snow, a determined look.

s5n_karys.why: 凝名、凭一人撑住一城倒影四十九夜，估英雄；她是画像的，不穿甲，档位落在设计过的法袍上；镜城不带照人的东西，所以镜片涂黑朝里缝。
s5n_karys.battle: Holding the drowning city, in a mirror-city sorceress's working gown: the indigo dress with its oilcloth hem soaked dark, its bodice and long sleeves embroidered with fine silver ward-thread runes that glow faintly, the sleeves pushed up; over the shoulders a fitted deep teal mantle sewn with small blackened mirror shards turned inward, nothing that reflects outward; the wet gauze on the left wrist bound with a thin silver binding ring. Both arms stretched forward with the fingers spread wide, dozens of fine glowing silver threads running from her fingertips out of the frame, pulled taut. A ring of silver light shines in her deep blue eyes; the shoulders strain, the lips pressed together, utterly unwilling to let go.

s5n_corvin.why: 凝名、拽住第七艘船，估英雄，英雄往上不看低巢的家境；样张给的黑翼城翼纹甲正对得上这一档，照样张交回。
s5n_corvin.battle: Hauling the seventh ship, in the black-wings war harness of his city: a fitted harness of overlapping dark feather-shaped metal plates across the chest and over the shoulders, the edges glowing a faint deep teal, leaving the wing roots free; dark plated vambraces with rope-grip palms; the broad belt with its rope loops; a heavy anchor cable looped over both shoulders and gripped in both hands at the chest, its frayed end trailing, rune-lit iron rings clamped along it. The wings are spread wide and beating, a faint dark feather-shadow flaring out beyond the real feathers, the deep teal at the roots glowing. The body leans hard against the pull, teeth gritted, the green eyes fierce.

s5n_takens.why: 八百多岁的老钟楼长，估英雄，用得起钟冢最好的骨银甲；可他把袍上的钟纹拆了，所以甲上挂铃的钩全空着、铃都剪掉，不加别的装饰。
s5n_takens.battle: On the night he climbs the old bell tower, in the bell-tomb's war harness worn bare: over the grey high-collared robe a fitted cuirass and shoulder plates of polished bone-silver, its old bell hooks all empty, the small bells cut away, faint smokeless white runes along the plate seams; bone-silver vambraces over the sleeves bound tight at the wrists with grey cord; a long ash-grey hooded travelling mantle over it with the hood down, the grey boots laced high. The grey stone scraping knife is held low and forward in his right hand, its edge glowing a faint smokeless white; his left hand is raised open and palm out as if to soothe someone; a calm, gentle, implacable face.

s5n_weisel.pref: 法袍，不带金属和照人的东西
s5n_weisel.why: 替噬名者守座的家主，估极境、世家；他是记名的人不是打手，镜城又不带金属和照人的东西，所以档位落在缝了符文的斗篷、骨片护臂和那一圈蜡板上。
s5n_weisel.battle: Going into the marsh: a long oiled dark cloak over the slate-teal robe, its lining stitched with matte grey-violet ward runes that glow faintly, the sleeves tied tight under close-fitted vambraces of dull white bone plate, no metal, nothing reflective; around his neck forty small white wax tablets threaded on cords hang in layers over his chest like a heavy collar, each pressed with a name-rune that glimmers soft pale silver. The bone stylus is in his right hand, held up like a pen about to write, not at his neck; his left hand is open, the waxed fingertips spread; a soft, counting look.

s5n_kutru.why: 碗主家领人上高座的祭司，估极境；他是祭司，不披整身棘甲，只加红园的活红光棘扣和一片棘纹肩甲，招牌是那只碗沿发红光的黑石碗。
s5n_kutru.battle: On the grain road: a dark red travelling cloak over the ochre-red robe, fastened at the chest with a red-garden clasp of black thorned metal whose thorns hold a slow living red glow; a single thorned dark-red shoulder plate on the left, the sleeves tied back with dark cord; at the cuffs the three rings of bowl-rim pattern stitched in thread that glows faint red. He lifts the black stone bowl in his left hand, its rim lit with a thin red line, and raises a short black stone striker in his right, about to tap the rim; a quick, hard, counting look.

s5n_strixx.why: 低巢剥骸银的夜翼，估灵格，家境穷；她身上的甲是从塔上自己撬下来再铆回去的翼纹甲片，拼凑不成套，撬棍和索刀照旧。
s5n_strixx.battle: Hanging off the tower in the gale, in salvage stripped from the tower itself: a rope harness over the leather vest, and over the chest a mismatched patchwork of dark feather-shaped wing-crest plates prised off and re-riveted, a few still glowing faint deep teal at the edges, leaving the wing slits free; one scavenged plated vambrace on the left forearm; a coil of rope over one shoulder, the canvas cloak tied tight, the wings half spread, the torn left tip showing. She grips the short iron pry bar in her right hand like a weapon and a small hooked rope knife in her left; a sharp, braced, calculating look.

s5n_zeruan.why: 替秋拍收货的生意人，估灵格，手头宽，买得起深潮的整件潮蓝鳞甲；他下水捞货，所以鳞甲穿在开衩短袍底下，螺和钩刀照旧。
s5n_zeruan.battle: The night at the sunken hall, in deep-tide war gear: a deep-blue short robe with a slit hem for swimming, under it a fitted vest of tide-blue scale that glows like deep water at every overlap; four slim tide-blue scaled vambraces binding the four sleeves tight at the wrists; a small brass ward charm at the belt beside the steelyard; dark trousers tucked into soft boots. Two arms hug a large pale white spiral conch shell to his chest, his upper right hand holds a short hooked rope-cutting knife; a calm, unyielding face.

s5n_laban.why: 账房家主，从不出手，自己也从不出面，这一格是坐在审判旁听席上；身上连钱都不带，不给他加任何附魔件，原句不改。
s5n_laban.battle: In the front row of the trial gallery: the pale grey wool coat buttoned to the throat, a dark grey wool mantle over the shoulders, dark trousers, black shoes. Both hands rest one over the other on the head of a plain walking stick; he says nothing.

s5n_tilei.why: 苇棚区十一岁的孩子，这一格是天亮念门楣，不打仗，原句不改。
s5n_tilei.battle: Reading the lintel at dawn: the cut-down brown coat buttoned up, the scarf pulled down off her mouth, a knitted cap over the braids, the straw-stuffed cloth shoes. One hand raised high, the other holding the small slate tablet; a loud, earnest face.

s5n_helma.why: 厨房守夜的帮工，这一格是端汤守夜，从不出手，原句不改。
s5n_helma.battle: On the night watch: a thick grey wool shawl crossed over the chest and tied behind, the brick-red dress, the floury apron, the blue-checked headscarf. She holds a steaming bowl of bean soup in both hands, a loud, warm look.

s5n_nottger.why: 极境，瓦赫特家剩下的一枝，家里败了，只剩传下来的守夜甲；他的剑讲稳不讲花，所以是成套的旧附魔链甲、护喉和护臂，符文重新点亮，不镀金，招牌是那盏塔灯。
s5n_nottger.battle: Ready to keep the night watch, in the Wacht house's handed-down watch harness: the deep-teal long coat belted at the waist over an old riveted enchanted mail shirt whose rings carry a faint relit white rune line at the hem and cuffs; a plain steel gorget engraved with the tower-and-lamp, its grooves softly lit, the silver badge at the collar; old wall-watchman's steel vambraces with relit rune lines, no gilding, nothing ornate. In his left hand he raises the silver tower lantern, its white flame flaring into a cold beam; in his right he holds a wall watchman's plain straight sword, a long double-edged blade with a simple cross guard, NOT a curved sword. His feet are planted and his back is straight, with a slow, unblinking stare.

s5n_saltcarrier.why: 原页写明极境，但她是被卖过的蛾子，一个人背盐走村，不赊账，说话像称东西。极境可以因家境减一档，所以定在2档：一套改合身的旧附魔甲，料子扎实，不加任何装饰。真本事在刀上那团火，不靠甲。
s5n_saltcarrier.battle: Ready to call out one name, in plain salvaged war gear over her road clothes: the dark leather jerkin laced tight over an old dwarf-forged enchanted mail shirt, its rings dulled by salt wind, a faint blue-white rune line running along the hem; plain riveted steel vambraces on both forearms, etched with worn runes that glow faintly, no ornament; the hood of the grey capelet thrown back; the seal-hide salt sack strapped close on her back with a buckled iron-ringed war strap. In her right hand she holds the palm-long short knife; its blade burns with a dark red fire that has a single thread of gold at its core, and the flame does not touch her hand. Her left hand is held open forward. Her feet are wide and low, the eyes fixed, the mouth set hard.

s5n_rannar.why: 极境LVL 92，北境小厅的厅主。厅里缺粮，但厅里传下来的战装还在，所以是3档：一身成套的北境霜纹附魔装，招牌是传了两百年的鹿崽皮。他是务实的猎人，按北境的样子照常穿。
s5n_rannar.battle: Leading a winter raid for grain, in the hall's handed-down northern war gear: under the reindeer-hide coat belted tight, a shirt of frost-rune steel scale whose runes glow pale blue and breathe a thin cold mist at the collar and hem; matching frost-rune steel vambraces on both forearms; the small white fawn skin over his shoulders pinned with the bone needle, a faint glitter of frost along its edge; the bow in his left hand, its grip bound with a rune-etched iron band, an arrow nocked and drawn; the short skinning knife and the deer-antler horn at the belt, the quiver on his back. His legs are braced wide, the eyes narrowed against the wind, the mouth set.

s5n_davi.why: 她是传奇，到这一层已不看家境。但她是不留名的带书人，人们只记得斗篷和书匣，手里不拿兵器。所以不给她穿甲，这一纪最好的东西只藏在斗篷里衬、手套和书匣上，外面看去仍是平常行路人的样子。
s5n_davi.battle: Breaking an encirclement, in nothing that looks like armour: the long grey-brown cloak tied back off the shoulders, its lining quilted with fine ward thread that shows a faint white glow only where it folds; the dark grey wool tunic belted close; the worn-thin leather gloves pulled tight, faint rune stitching along the knuckles lighting up as she blocks; the oilcloth-wrapped book case cinched tight to her back with an extra cord across the chest, its corners capped with old enchanted iron glowing faint blue-white; no weapon in her hands. She steps forward low, one forearm raised to block, the front foot pressing a glowing white footprint into the ground, the eyes calm and the mouth closed.

s5n_nilos.why: 传奇，已不看家境。她是双礁港的鳞民，以舞为战，赤脚，不拿兵器，所以按深潮蓝堡的样子用顶好的潮蓝鳞甲做轻装。背后留低，露出她自己的鳞片，不穿重甲，以免压住舞步。
s5n_nilos.battle: Ready to dance against the tide, in the light war gear of the deep-tide fortress: the deep-blue slit tunic worn over a fitted bodice of tide-blue scale that glows like deep water, the back left low and open to her own scales; slim tide-blue scale vambraces from wrist to elbow; the wide sash cinched tight and set with three small deep-sea crystals glowing teal; the coral-red cape thrown back; barefoot and planted.
