The silver-teal scales along her arms and back flare up and glow, and thin silver scale patterns spread over her skin. No weapon; she fights with a dance, one arm sweeping out wide, the body half turned, a fierce, unyielding look.

s6a_ruth.why: 灵格LVL58是二档底子，锻营里关了七十二年、身无一物再减一档；她是认誓人，刀放下就没再拿，不穿甲，只配契约法庭的衣裳和庭上的护符。
s6a_ruth.battle: Going in to stop a blood oath sworn behind closed doors: the contract court's long dark grey coat buttoned to the top button, the red oath cord at the throat glowing like a coal; she wears no armour by her own choice, only the court's issue lining of thin black iron scale glimpsed at the coat's front, stitched with faint ember-red contract runes; a narrow belt with the empty knife sheath and a small brass-capped court seal whose oath lines glow dull red; a leather satchel of oath records across the body, its brass clasp etched with a ward rune; sturdy boots. She holds one bare white-tipped palm out low and flat, the notebook in the other hand; she carries no blade.

s6a_stana.why: 灵格二档，大营难民出身减一档；她在台上刻碑，不打仗，所以只在干活的衣服外头加两三件锻营捡来的西边黑铁护件，挡火星用。
s6a_stana.battle: Carving the law stele on the scaffold, in a carver's salvaged forge kit: a heavy leather apron over the canvas work clothes, its bib faced with a scrap of old black iron war plate whose ember runes glow dull orange against the sparks; a cloth tied over her hair; on the left hand a thick leather glove reinforced with a salvaged black iron back-plate, its heat-ward rune glowing faint red; the belt of chisels, each tempered by her own hand, a thin ember line along their steel. She holds a chisel whose tip glows red-hot in the gloved hand and the hammer in the other, ready to strike at a slant.

s6a_goetz.why: 极境LVL91是三档底子，翻墙过来的逃兵，走了六十年车尾，家境差减一档；那件褪色旧皮甲他不肯换，所以好料子都缝在里头，外面不加装饰，招牌是那杆长钩。
s6a_goetz.battle: Holding the rear of the wagon train, in his own sixty-year kit, plain and unadorned: the faded leather armour buckled tight, its chest and shoulders now backed with old wall-issue enchanted plates sewn inside, only a thin blue-white rune line showing at the edges; the grey road coat over it; plain rune-etched steel bracers worn dull; a pouch of crushed white stone at his belt, the powder faintly luminous. He grips the long hook in both hands, slanted across his body with the iron hook-head low by his foot, a pale white line glowing along the old iron, a still, unmoving look.

s6a_barre.why: 共鸣一档，放羊人家的孩子，这一格是抱着书匣逃命，不打仗；只加一件路边捡来的魔晶小坠子，算这一纪穷孩子身上也有的东西。
s6a_barre.battle: Running the sheep paths to the great camp: the sheepskin vest pulled close over the long-sleeved shirt, a cord belt with the herding whip, bare feet; the only salvage on him is a small cracked magic crystal on a thong at his neck, picked up by the old grain road, giving off a faint warm glow against his shirt. He hugs the oilcloth-wrapped book box tight to his chest with both arms; he does not fight.

s6a_sepp.why: 共鸣一档，佃农的儿子，东边段城的兵，照东边的样子在兵衣外头罩捡来的旧附魔半胸甲和护臂，不用火药。
s6a_sepp.battle: Behind the crenels at night, in salvaged wall gear over his garrison clothes: the grey soldier's coat with an old wall-issue enchanted half-cuirass strapped over it, re-buckled with plough-harness leather, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along its edge and one dim crystal in its socket; a single dented enchanted pauldron on the right shoulder; a steel bracer on the left forearm etched with a glowing rune line; the quiver at his hip. He holds the wall-town's tall longbow low at an angle, its limbs inlaid with faint spell-lines that glow when drawn, an arrow nocked, the string not drawn, a steady, careful look.

s6a_birgit.why: 灵格二档，碑匠街的手艺人家，家境算中等，不加不减；她不打仗，好东西只用在干活的护具上，比如挡碎石的附魔链甲围兜和护腕。
s6a_birgit.battle: Carving at the boundary stone, in a carver's working kit with a little good salvage: a heavy leather apron over the canvas coat, its bib sewn with a panel of old enchanted mail from the wall armouries against flying chips, a faint blue-white rune thread along its hem; a cloth tied over her hair; a salvaged steel wrist plate on the hammer arm, its rune line dimly lit; the chisel case at her belt, the long tube on her back. She holds a chisel and the chasing hammer, ready to strike.

s6a_renzo.why: 灵格二档，大营扛夫的孩子，减一档；他不打仗，所以只在黑工装外头加两件西边余烬纹的黑铁护件，护住那只斜着的腕子。
s6a_renzo.battle: At work on black obsidian, with a few salvaged western pieces over his work clothes: a heavy leather apron over the black work clothes, its bib faced with a scrap of black iron plate whose ember runes glow dull orange; a cloth tied over the hair between the horns; a black iron wrist guard on the bent right wrist, its seams faintly ember-lit; the belt of slant-ground chisels. He holds a long slant-ground chisel and a stone mallet, the tail hooked tight around one ankle for balance.

s6a_iris.why: 灵格二档，七城派来的边官，拿公家的俸，家境算中等；她不带兵器，挡冷箭靠收拢的翅膀，所以不穿甲，只在官服上配黄铜件和衬里的护符线。
s6a_iris.battle: The night before a treaty is carved: the dark grey frontier officer's coat buttoned to the throat, brass steam-age fittings at the collar and along the wing slits, its lining stitched with faint ember-red ward thread; a dark scarf, leather gloves; her mother's empty message tube at her waist; no armour by her own choice, the wings drawn close around her shoulders like a cloak and serving as her only shield. She holds a small lit lamp low in one hand; she carries no weapon.

s6a_amalia.why: 灵格二档，内城代代誊册的书记人家，家境中等；七十岁的书记长不打仗，所以不穿甲，只配书记房的护符领扣和带护纹的封库钥匙。
s6a_amalia.battle: In the sealed archive under the old Tribunal building at night: the dark grey scribe's coat buttoned up, the black sleeve covers, the cap; she wears no armour, only the records office's warding: a small enchanted brass clasp at the collar holding a faint blue-white rune, and the key ring at her belt, the old enchanted keys glowing faint blue-white at their wards. She holds a small shuttered lamp in one hand and, in the other, half of an old yellowed warrant, folded, its edge cut clean by a sword.

s6a_christoph.why: 共鸣一档，净血院出来的灰袍，身上没有私财；他是医者，不带兵器，只把旅行斗篷换成墙上发的旧斗篷，下摆有一道护纹，别的都不加。
s6a_christoph.battle: On the road west with the cloister's ledgers: the washed grey robe under a plain grey travelling cloak, an old wall-issue cloak with a single faded ward rune at the hem still glowing faint blue-white, the hood down, the cuffs buttoned, the white stone at his collar, the flat wooden box of needles at his waist, a small cut on his brow from a thrown stone. He carries a bundle of old ledgers tied with cord against his chest; no armour, no weapon.

s6a_angela.why: 共鸣一档，下街剖鱼的人家；她不打仗，只把皮护腕换成鱼市上便宜买来的旧附魔钢护腕，这一纪穷人身上也有一两件。
s6a_angela.battle: Gutting at the fish market on a winter dawn: a heavy oilcloth smock with long sleeves tied at the wrist, a thick wool scarf, the kerchief; on both wrists a pair of salvaged enchanted steel wrist guards from the wall armouries, bought cheap at the market, a thin rune line glowing blue-white along each; the tin tag on its cord at her neck. She holds the short gutting knife low in one hand, a faint rune glint along its old blade, and a big fish by the gills in the other, a sharp, haggling look.

s6a_reva.why: 890年开局是灵格LVL45，二档底子，七坑矿工人家减一档；进隧道要护身，就在帆布围裙底下垫西边余烬纹的旧黑铁甲片、戴护臂，手里照旧只拿推杆。
s6a_reva.battle: Into the tunnel under the ridge, in salvaged western pit gear: the canvas apron over a heavy leather jerkin faced with old black iron plates, their ember runes glowing dull orange in the dark; thick black iron bracers on the bare forearms, salvaged and riveted wide to fit; a small brass-cased crystal lamp clipped to the apron pocket; the cowhide-soled boots. She grips the black hardwood push-bar in both hands across her body, braced, a loud, set look.

s6a_mansur.why: 灵格二档，修路的犯人，身无一物减一档；他靠灼地耐性光脚踩石头，靴子不穿，只在外套上绑两块铁轨队库里拿来的黑铁甲片。
s6a_mansur.battle: On night watch over the trains under the ridge: a heavy dark wool coat over the coarse tunic, two scavenged black iron plates from the rail gangs' stores strapped over its chest, their ember runes glowing faint orange; the leather apron; barefoot by choice, the opened lock at his ankle. He holds a short iron pry bar from the rail gangs low in one hand, a cold-mended rune line along its shaft glowing dull red.

s6a_linos.why: 灵格二档，守灯人家境清苦，减一档；他不带兵器，靠的是那盏铜灯，翅膀烧过以后怕火，所以只在夹袍衬里缝一道防火的护纹线，不穿甲。
s6a_linos.battle: In the tunnel on the night of the lost wagon: the grey robe belted tight, its lining stitched with a faint ember-red fire-ward thread, the wide left sleeve hemmed with the same; a dark scarf, boots, the oil flask at his belt; no armour by his own choice. He holds up the lit copper lamp at shoulder height, the burnt wing dragging behind him; he carries no weapon.

s6a_wiebke.why: 共鸣一档，段城兵户出身；她守火，不打仗，在兵衣和焦边围裙外头加两件捡来的东边附魔件：护喉，还有挡热的霜纹手套。
s6a_wiebke.battle: On fire watch in the field of fire on a night of east wind, with salvaged wall gear over her fire warden's clothes: the grey short coat buttoned up under an old wall-issue enchanted gorget, its rune line glowing blue-white; the scorched leather apron tied tight; a damp cloth around her neck to pull over the mouth; salvaged steel-backed gloves, frost runes glowing pale blue against the heat; the wet sack over her shoulder. She holds the bell pole low and slanting in one hand and the horn-shaded lantern in the other; she does not fight.

s6b_bojan.why: 共鸣一档，契约民种麦的人家；他在挖火道，不打仗，身上只多一对捡来的西边黑铁护胫，拿麻绳绑在裤子外头。
s6b_bojan.battle: Cutting a firebreak: the linen shirt streaked with soot, a wet cloth knotted round his neck ready to pull over his mouth, cloth strips wound round both palms, the wooden tag at his belt, the seed bag across his chest; the only salvage on him is a pair of scavenged black iron shin plates tied over the trousers with hemp, their ember runes faintly glowing. He grips a long-handled iron hoe in both hands, its blade dark with earth.

s6b_hadiya.why: 极境的契约法官，赤脊氏是落了的老氏，家境中等。她查火场、不带兵器，所以这一档的好东西都做成护身和查验用的，不加甲也不加兵器。
s6b_hadiya.battle: At a fire site, in a contract judge's field kit of the black empire: the long black coat buttoned to the collar with its single red cord, belted close with a brass-buckled belt, the hem tucked up; ember-ward thread stitched along its seams glows a faint dull red against the heat; brass-riveted leather knee guards set with small heat-ward plates; a rune-stitched scarf hanging at her neck, ready to tie over her nose and mouth against smoke; the pouch of ash bags at her waist; the two halves of the sawn iron ring on their cord at her chest. She holds an open book of drawn fires in one hand and a stick of charcoal in the other; she carries no weapon.

s6b_glad.why: 这一格画的是926年门洞里那一刻，位阶到了顶上一档，用不着看家境。他是修鞋的，雷狱出来以后只靠一双山铜的拳头，自己选了不披甲，所以照他的路子只换上自己做的几样东西。
s6b_glad.battle: Standing between someone and a falling blow, by his own choice in no armour at all, only a cobbler's things made with a legend's hands: the coarse undyed coat belted tight with a heavy leather belt he stitched himself, the sleeves rolled to the elbows, the forearm scars showing; fresh cloth bands on both fists already charring black, ember-red light seeping through the weave where the boiling blood is pressed into them; a short iron chain with a clasp hooked at his belt; iron-shod boots of his own cobbling, their soles thick and rune-nailed. He carries no weapon.

s6b_suhaila.why: 灵格本是第二档，她出在焦门氏家主那一支，是西边的氏族世家，家境往上加一档，穿氏族配的成套战装。招牌是那截断链，她干活用的护手和铁环袖口照旧留着。
s6b_suhaila.battle: On the slope below the grey ridge, in the Charred-Gate clan's hammer-warden harness: ember-lit black iron plates at the chest and shoulders buckled over the black leather jacket, its seams glowing like banked coals; iron-ringed cuffs reinforced with brass-riveted chain guards so no link can catch them; the small clan gate-and-flame badge at the chest glowing like a coal; the worn-thin leather hand guards now lined with ember-runed palm plates; the chain unwound from her waist, ember-lit lines etched along its links. She grips the heavy broken chain in both hands, a length of it swinging low and ready to throw, a hard, steady look.

s6b_jarna.why: 944年到了灵格，可她是谷里管谱系的，家里清贫，自己也不出手。所以只在干活的衣服外头罩两件捡来的附魔件，护得住身子，不当兵器用。
s6b_jarna.battle: On the ridge, calling names, in a couple of salvaged pieces over her keeper's clothes: a sheepskin-lined leather jerkin cut down from a black-empire army issue, three ember-lit black iron plates still riveted across its chest, glowing faint red; a single rune-etched bracer on the left forearm above the frayed rope end tied at her wrist; the pouch of chisels at her waist; heavy boots. She holds the rolled genealogy in one hand and cups the other at her mouth; she does not fight.

s6b_jarna_child.why: 这是926年门洞里那个八岁被绑进门祭的孩子，她身上本来就没有战装，原句不改。
s6b_jarna_child.battle: The dawn in the gate: the short homespun tunic, bare feet, dust on her knees, the bitten rope end on her wrist.

s6b_rudiger.why: 灵格本是第二档，他是北岸新朝军门鸢羽家的人，家境往上加一档，穿长兄传下来的整套附魔半身甲，招牌是家传骑枪。他是三子，甲大一指，白盾照规矩什么也不画。
s6b_rudiger.battle: Holding a gateway, in his eldest brother's handed-down enchanted harness: the white surcoat with a single kite feather embroidered at the collar and a hem of woven dike-pattern stitching, over half-plate a finger too big, its pauldrons lashed tight with leather thongs, rune lines along every plate edge glowing blue-white; the open-faced helm with the grey-white kite feather; rune-etched steel gauntlets; the blank white round shield rimmed with iron on his left arm, a pale crystal lit in its boss, its face still unpainted. He holds the heirloom lance with its grey tassel low and angled forward in his right hand, its head faintly rune-lit, a tense, determined look.

s6b_moda.why: 灵格，是灰雨遗民老营出来的军团兵，家里不富，穿七城军团配的一身旧战装，就是改合身的那一档。那一截灰袖子和角城枪是她的东西，不能换。
s6b_moda.battle: Leading her company across the stones at dawn, in the seven cities' army war kit: the grey army coat buttoned, brass steam-age buckles and a small pressure-gauge charm at the belt; ember-lit black iron plates strapped over the chest and left shoulder; brass-riveted leather bracers; the powder flask and shot bag at her belt; a bronze company token stamped with a seven-rayed sun on her chest; thin red contract-lines sewn along the cuffs and shoulder seam, glowing faintly. The old sleeve is tied tight round her upper arm. She holds the single-shot horn-city musket in both hands, the stock wrapped in grey cloth, its muzzle low and angled down, ready to raise, a hard, focused look.

s6b_wenzel.why: 他是极境的段守，措尔家是南段的边军世家，穿成套的附魔战装，招牌是那面刻堤纹的盾和换俘门的钥匙。人守墙上的规矩，那件旧链甲不卸，样子也不加装饰。
s6b_wenzel.battle: Standing his ground, in a wall-town commander's plain enchanted kit: the grey-brown surcoat with a dike-pattern hem stitched in dark thread, over the old chain mail he never takes off, its links now rune-lit a faint blue-white; a plain enchanted gorget and pauldrons; an open iron cap with a thin rune line round its brim; rune-etched steel gauntlets; the round shield on his left arm painted with the same dike pattern, the pattern's grooves lit and a crystal glowing at the boss; the copper key tucked inside the mail glowing a faint amber. He holds the short spear forward and low in his right hand, its head glinting with spell-light, a slow, immovable look.

s6b_bromgar.why: 这一夜他还是英雄，炉脉家是世家，到了这一位阶家境已经不算数，穿量身打的锻工战装。他是炉头，那条烧穿又补好的围裙不肯换，所以料子用最好的，样子还是匠人的。
s6b_bromgar.battle: On the night the King-Forge falters, in a forge-master's harness made for the King-Forge itself: the burnt, many-times-patched apron tied tight over a fitted coat of fire-proofed enchanted leather, heat-ward runes along its seams glowing white-orange; dwarf-forged steel shoulder plates and a gorget etched with the Forgevein anvil line; heavy rune-lined forge gauntlets that glow dull red at the knuckles; the testing hammer and the rolled drawing of cracks at his belt; iron-capped boots. He grips the long-handled forging hammer handed down from Lanvig in both hands across his body, its head lit by white-hot runes, a fierce, immovable look.

s6b_tove.why: 她这一夜从灵格跨到极境，深井一支是下井的矿工人家，家境中等，穿改合身的旧附魔井下护具。她干的是听塌、撑木的活，不加打仗的甲。
s6b_tove.battle: In the hall of the King-Forge on the night it sank, in the Deepwell line's refitted shaft gear: the short dark leather coat buttoned, its knee and elbow patches backed with salvaged enchanted plates whose rune lines glow a faint blue-white; a close iron cap with a rune-lit brim; thick rune-stitched gloves; the cold, flameless blue-white crystal lamp and the brass listening cone at her belt; a bundle of wooden props on her back, each tied with rune-cord. She grips the prop-splitting hatchet in her right hand, its edge glinting with old enchanted steel, a still, counting look.

s6b_frode.why: 他是灵格，出了家门，靠段城守兵的饷过日子，穿墙上发的旧附魔件，改合身了照穿。家里的戒环他不戴，人素，样子不加装饰。
s6b_frode.battle: On the night of the re-forging on the wall, in wall-issue gear refitted for the furnace: the old leather coat of the wall-town guards belted over a thick leather apron, a salvaged enchanted half-cuirass strapped over the coat with rune lines glowing blue-white along its edges; heavy heat-ward gloves with rune-etched steel cuffs; the ring of thirty-two iron keys at his waist. He grips a forging hammer taken from the old rack of the Redforge house in his right hand, its worn head faintly rune-lit, a tense, determined look.

s6b_barnaby.why: 他是灵格的白烛医祷士，赶一辆车过日子。这一路人不带兵器，只在法袍上添一枚护符、几道符文，护着自己往两边的伤号里走。
s6b_barnaby.battle: Going among the wounded on both sides of the wall, in a White Candle healer's warded dress: the grey-white robe belted short, its front stained with medicine and soup, the sleeves tied back, a white candle embroidered at the chest in thread that glows a soft gold; a small ward charm of salvaged crystal on a cord at his neck; a canvas satchel of bandages and splints across his body; a folding table strapped to his back. He holds a roll of bandage in one hand and the white-candle lantern in the other; he carries no weapon.

s6b_linnie.why: 她是九岁、关在净血院里受审的孩子，没有战装，原句不改。
s6b_linnie.battle: The days of the court on the black stone terrace: a too-big grey coat from the blood-cleansing house wrapped round her, the shaved head bare, small shoes.

s6b_bonifaz.why: 原页没写位阶，照他做了三十年执石长估成灵格。他是修院里的人，骑马上台地是去替院里说话，不打仗，衣着也一向素，所以原句不改。
s6b_bonifaz.battle: Riding to the court on the black stone terrace: the grey robe under a heavy grey travelling cloak with the hood thrown back, riding boots, the white stone at the collar. He holds the flat wooden case of needles and stones in both hands.

s6b_lorenz.why: 他是灵格的老段守，家境中等，穿墙上发的旧附魔甲，凹了也照穿。人守规矩，样子朴素，不加装饰。
s6b_lorenz.battle: On the south gate tower the night of the fire, in wall-issue enchanted armour worn for forty years: the old mail shirt over the grey coat and a dented enchanted iron breastplate over both, rune lines along its edges glowing blue-white; a short grey cloak pinned with a black-and-white boundary-stone pin; an open-faced iron helm; rune-etched gauntlets; a round shield on his left arm with a crystal lit at its boss and faint pale rune scratches glowing along the rim. He holds his drawn sword point down, a hard, grave look.

s6b_roland.why: 共鸣本是第一档，他是公国群布兰肯家的次子，家境往上加两档，穿家里铁匠打的整套附魔板甲，擦得锃亮。他爱出风头，所以光亮、晶石都做在明处。
s6b_roland.battle: Ready to ride out of the south gate, in his family's full enchanted harness: plate made by the Blanken smiths and polished to a mirror shine, rune lines along every plate edge glowing a crisp blue-white, a magic crystal set bright at the breastplate and one at each pauldron; a short white surcoat over it; an open-faced helm with a rune-lit brow band; a quiver of arrows fletched with white goose feathers bound with red thread at his hip. He grips his drawn longsword in both hands, point low, a pale crystal glowing in its pommel, a hot, eager look.

s6b_meti.why: 共鸣的西边边官，那一夜她空着手背对界碑站着，靠的是约不是兵器。所以不穿甲，只让她那块铜岗牌上的约号亮起来。
s6b_meti.battle: The night of the burnt wheat, in her border officer's coat and no armour at all: the long black wool coat of the western cut buttoned to the throat, the narrow dark red sash, the small bronze post plate on the left shoulder whose engraved contract mark holds a faint ember-red glow; dark trousers and boots; at her belt the leather contract case, its brass clasp stamped with a seal that glows dull red. A smear of soot on her cheek. No blade, no gun, no plate anywhere on her.

s6b_luther.why: 碑匠街的老碑匠，只管描界碑上的字，从不出手。所以只给他一套干活的家什，用的是捡来的旧附魔料，不披甲。
s6b_luther.battle: On the road along the wall in autumn, in a mason's kit with a little salvaged war craft in it: the grey canvas clothes patched with two layers of leather at the knees and elbows, under a heavy grey work coat; a thick leather apron; a row of chisels at the wide belt, their tips cut from old enchanted wall plate and glinting faint blue-white; a small rune lantern with a pale crystal flame hung at the hip for reading worn letters at dusk; a pack of tools on his back. No armour and no weapon.

s6b_ziyad.why: 焦门氏角冠家的家主，四百多岁，侄孙法鲁克已是极境，所以估他是英雄。给他一身给他本人打的西边余烬黑铁甲，招牌是那把平鞘的短刀。
s6b_ziyad.battle: On the grey ridge at dawn, in the Horn-Crown house's gate-burner harness: the long black leather coat of the Charred-Gate cut with its iron-ringed cuffs, worn open over a fitted breastplate and tassets of black iron forged for him, the seams glowing like embers under ash, the edges riveted in dark brass; black iron vambraces whose iron rings hold a dull red heat; a wide dark red sash; the obsidian rings on his horns polished. He grips the short, heavy, broad-bladed knife in his right hand, its plain edge faintly red from the heat of his palm, a cold, patient look.

s6b_helfried.why: 英雄位阶，又是公爵的侄子，穿量身打造的银鹿成套战甲。银晶匣的施法铳就是他的招牌，东边不用火药。
s6b_helfried.battle: Leading his knights down a rope over the wall at night, in the harness made to his measure in Silverstag: dark steel half-plate of a single designed set, edged and chased in silver, fine spell circuits running along the plates in a cold silver-white glow, the silver stag on the breastplate lit from within; matching articulated pauldrons, gauntlets with a small crystal set at each wrist, steel greaves; a dark green cloak lined with ward-stitched thread. He holds the engraved casting-gun, a spell implement and not a firearm, low in one hand, its silver crystal chamber glowing faintly, a cool, intent look.

s6b_secunda.why: 白骸边官，近两百岁，当场带走了极境的贾瓦德，所以估她是极境。给她一身成套的西边余烬黑铁边官甲，招牌是那面骨盾。
s6b_secunda.battle: Holding the gateway, in a border officer's war kit of the black empire: the long black coat belted tight over a fitted cuirass of black iron plates, their joins lit by a dull ember glow and fastened with brass buckles; black iron vambraces; the small bronze post plate on the left shoulder, its contract mark glowing ember-red; the narrow dark red sash. The round bone shield raised on her left arm, a faint pale light along its rim, an iron-shod staff in her right hand, its iron ferrule etched with contract script. A calm, unmoving look.

s6b_munir.why: 桥西村的契约民，是半夜从床上被带走的，不出手，身上也没有任何附魔件。所以照原样，只把冬天按约领的灰外套写明。
s6b_munir.battle: The morning he was taken over the wall, in nothing but his contract-folk clothes: the coarse undyed linen shirt untucked, the grey winter coat issued under the law thrown over his shoulders, the left sleeve pushed back over the scarred wrist, the hemp-rope belt with its small wooden tag branded with his family's contract number, rough brown trousers and worn boots. No armour, no charm, no weapon; he was pulled from his bed in the night.

s6b_jorun.why: 灵格，但出身苇棚区，又是个烤面包的，从不打仗。只给她一对墙上炉房捡来的防热护臂，配着她手里的炉铲。
s6b_jorun.battle: On the night the cold furnace heart was lit again, in her baker's clothes with one piece of old wall-forge gear: the oilcloth apron with its patched burn holes tied tight over the long brown wool dress, the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a cloth tied over the braids; on both forearms a pair of salvaged forge-ward vambraces from the wall armoury, scorched dark, their old heat-ward runes glowing faint blue-white; the iron ladle, salt pouch and kitchen knife at her waist, the knotted cord on her wrist. Soot on her face.

s6b_ranveig.why: 从前王炉的炉头，教过三代炉头，不出手。她的好东西在炉头的围裙、手套和试锤上，不穿甲。
s6b_ranveig.battle: In the royal hall on the night it sank, in a forge master's working gear and nothing more: the long soot-dark wool dress, over it the King-Forge master's heavy apron of scorched fire-hide leather, riveted with fire-copper and lined with old heat-ward runes that glow a low ember orange at the hem; the thick knitted shawl knotted at the chest; heavy fire-hide gloves with copper-plated knuckles tucked in the belt; sturdy old boots. The small testing hammer in her hand, its fire-copper head faintly warm with light. No armour, no weapon.

s6b_ato.why: 八岁的契约民孩子，掉进了缝里，不会打。所以照原样，不加任何附魔件。别页长大以后也照这个偏好往上走。
s6b_ato.battle: The evening he fell into the crack, in his shepherd-boy clothes and nothing more: the faded homespun tunic smeared with earth, belted with a cord, the sheepskin vest with the fleece inside, wool leggings, one small mended boot on and the other foot bare, a rope tied round his waist. He clutches the small copper goat bell. No armour, no charm, no weapon; he is eight and was never meant to fight.

s6n_dort.why: 共鸣的下街碑匠学徒，盾就是那块碑坯。所以在工褂外头罩一两件捡来的墙上附魔件，东边式样，不用火药。
s6n_dort.battle: Holding a line, in salvaged wall gear over her workshop clothes: the linen smock under a short grey canvas work coat with leather patches on the knees and elbows; a single grey wall-issue enchanted pauldron re-strapped on her right shoulder, its rune line glowing faint blue-white; old enchanted steel bracers on both forearms with one small lit crystal at the left wrist; the headscarf knotted tight. The carrying frame is off. Her left hand grips the blank stone slab upright by its edge as a shield, and her right hand raises a heavy wooden mallet bound with a band of old rune-lit iron. Feet planted wide, a hard, steady stare, the mouth set.

s6n_hogel.why: 共鸣，又在接便宜活的三便士团，样张给的半身甲加肩甲加护臂加罩袍超了一档。改成翻毛外套外头只罩一件肩甲、一只护臂。
s6n_hogel.battle: Ready to fight, in the few salvaged pieces a cheap company can afford: the fur jacket buttoned up to the throat under an old padded company vest with the copper three-coin badge; a single salvaged enchanted pauldron strapped on the right shoulder, its rune line glowing blue-white and its edges rimed by his own cold; one rune-etched steel vambrace on the left forearm with a small lit crystal at the wrist; the braid tucked in. He holds the short ice spear low in both hands with its frosted head forward, a faint ring of frost spreading from the point and runes of ice glowing along the shaft. A light, wide stance, white breath streaming from his lips, a sharp, alert look.

s6n_ruhsana.why: 纺誓家的家主，系了八百年誓结，靠的是结和绳，不靠甲。所以照英雄的料子给她一件量身做的、缝了誓文的骑装，不加护甲。
s6n_ruhsana.battle: Tying the great knot, in the oath-spinner's battle dress rather than armour: a tailored dark wine-red riding coat buttoned to the throat over the dress, its lining and high collar stitched with fine oath-script in dark red thread that glows like banked coals; the ash-grey shawl thrown back; close black gloves with small red rune knots sewn at the wrists. Nine dark red cords braided into one heavy rope are wrapped around her left forearm, their knots pulsing with faint red light, and her left hand grips a large many-layered knot. Her right hand holds the oath knife drawn, point down. The ebony spindle is tucked through her belt. A cold, intent stare, lips pressed thin.

s6n_zandak.why: 血誓那一边最能打的一个，所以估他是极境。给他一身成套的余烬黑铁骑甲，招牌是铁面和那根血绳。
s6n_zandak.battle: Hunting with his riders, in a blood-oath rider's war harness: over the black coat a fitted cuirass of dark iron plates and black leather, the seams glowing a dull ember red, heavy iron pauldrons riveted in old brass; iron-ringed vambraces; the smooth iron mask on, its rim faintly warm with red light, iron bands on the horn stumps. The dark red blood-cord is unwound from his right arm and twisted hard into a long rigid spear in his right hand, its tip sharp as iron and lit with red light. A loose net of red cord trails from his left hand. A low, forward-leaning stance.

s6n_hasso.why: 旱渡人的头，引得动亡者，所以估他是灵格。他说在这片坡上带刀的人活不长，不穿甲也不带刃，只有油布外套下摆一道旧护符线。
s6n_hasso.battle: Leading the dead, in his ferryman's coat and no armour at all: the patched olive oilcloth long coat buttoned up, the hood thrown back, its hem stitched long ago with a faded ward thread that glows faint blue in the dark; the rope belt; wide canvas trousers wrapped at the shins. He holds the white ash pole slantwise in both hands like a staff. The brass lantern at its tip blazes blue, with a half-burned stub of grave candle set inside it, and faint blue light washes up over his face. A grim, quiet look. He carries no blade.

s6n_gaudenz.why: 管粮仓的家主，不上墙，从不出手，资料又写他不戴别的首饰。所以只在骑装衬里织一道护身线，不配铳也不配甲。
s6n_gaudenz.battle: Inspecting the mills along the wall road, in good upper-city riding clothes and nothing martial: a dark umber riding coat buttoned up, its lining woven with a thin ward thread that shows faint blue-white at the cuffs, a cream scarf, a low-brimmed hat and polished riding boots; his hands bare so the copper thumb ring shows. He leans on a slim walking cane and looks out with a mild, calculating expression. No armour and no weapon in hand; he does not go up on the wall.

s6n_nestor.why: 新朝军门奥兰家的家主，资料写他是最高一级的枪骑，所以估他是英雄。给他一身量身打的白金两色附魔甲和骑枪，东边式样。
s6n_nestor.battle: Leading his lancers, in the Oran house's designed war harness: tailored half-plate enamelled white over fine glowing mail, the plates edged in gold and engraved with rune lines that shine a clean blue-white, a small war crystal lit at the gorget; matching pauldrons, steel vambraces and greaves; a white surcoat with gold edging and a short white cloak. He holds a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, its pennon white and gold, a thin blue-white light running along the rune-etched head, with the sword and its white-and-gold tassel at his hip. A stern, calm face.

s6n_gunther.why: 原页没写位阶，照坑底推绞盘、挖了一百多年山铜的契约民估作共鸣。他从不打仗，镐是干活的家什，所以只在工装外头加两件捡来的东西，一件挡落石的旧附魔甲片，一盏晶矿灯，都是干活用的。
s6n_gunther.battle: At the mine face, in his work gear with two salvaged pieces: a sleeveless leather work vest over the linen shirt, a thick leather apron with an old grey enchanted plate from the wall armouries strapped over the chest against falling rock, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; a crystal mining lamp on a strap at his chest, a pale magic crystal lit inside its brass cage; heavy gloves; the branded wooden contract tag at his belt. He holds the mining pick in both hands, braced to swing at rock.

s6n_shapur.why: 原页没写位阶，照守空座的一百七十岁老炎角、手掌常年烫人估作灵格。山里氏族家底一般，给一套改合身的旧氏族皮甲。他靠手上的火，不带兵器，样子朴素。腰上的铜碗跟故事有关，照留。
s6n_shapur.battle: Stopping the cart, in the old Blackflint mountain war gear, plain and worn: a dark rust-red cloak over a soot-stained jerkin of hardened hide set with small black iron plates, ember-red runes smouldering dull in their seams; one black iron pauldron on the left shoulder; hide bracers bound with thongs; the fire-blackened copper bowl hanging at the wide hide belt. The hood is down so the hooked horns show, small flames burning along both horn tips. His right hand is raised open, glowing red-hot at the palm. He carries no weapon. A cold, unmoving stare.

s6n_yasmin.why: 她是八岁的契约民孩子，那一夜被人带走又换了回来，不出手，手里也不拿东西。这一格是她冬夜那一身，加任何甲件都不对，照原句不改。
s6n_yasmin.battle: The night she was taken and given back: an oversized grey wool winter coat over the linen smock, the sleeves rolled three times, thick stockings and boots, a knitted cap pulled down to just above the horn nubs; both hands clutching the coat front.

s6n_marquard.why: 灵格（LVL 62），新朝军门家主，家里钱多，料子和铳都照四档给。他不上墙、不带刃，所以不穿甲，只在外套里衬上新朝的琥珀护纹，不镀金。铳是上城的老规矩，做得好，从不拔出来。
s6n_marquard.battle: At the council when the wall's grain is weighed: a severe black long coat closing down the front with plain old-copper buttons over the navy one, its lining stitched with faint amber ward lines in the new court's austere style, no gilding; a slim rune-engraved spell-gun of fine family make, wand-like, NOT a firearm, fed with a small glowing crystal cartridge, hanging at his right hip by old upper-city custom and never drawn. He holds the ledger open in his left hand and points to a line with his right.

s6n_petrus.why: 灵格（LVL 52），公国施特拉克家的三儿子，家里给得起成套的附魔半身甲。三子拿不到传家的那一件，所以比四档低一档。他在东边，不用火药。
s6n_petrus.battle: On the wall the night the cannons woke, in the Strack house's war kit for a younger son: a fitted half-plate of old enchanted wall steel worn under the cornflower-blue surcoat, blue-white rune lines glowing along the plate edges and a magic crystal lit at the gorget; matching steel pauldrons and rune-etched vambraces; tall boots. A straight sword drawn in his right hand, NOT a curved sword, its fuller lined with faint blue-white runes; an iron pry bar in his left. A hard, eager look.

s6n_faruk.why: 极境（LVL 90），出身焦门氏家主一脉，在山里逃了二十年，家境如今是贫。到了极境家境差不大，给一套焦门破门撞角的旧战具。他靠角撞，手里不拿兵器；角上二十年没亮过火，甲上的余烬纹也跟着暗下去。
s6n_faruk.battle: Before the door-board at the fissure, in the old Scorchgate door-breaker's harness kept through twenty years in the hills: the black leather jacket buckled to the throat under a heavy black iron breastplate and broad ram-shouldered pauldrons, the ember runes in their seams gone dull dark red; the iron-ringed cuffs over rune-etched black iron vambraces; a coarse dark grey hooded cloak thrown back. The head lowered for his clan's door-breaking charge with the cloth-bound horns thrust forward, both fists clenched; no weapon in his hands.

s6n_wilfried.why: 原页没写位阶，照河上打捞团的团长估作共鸣。他不是兵，不拿兵器。捞沉船的人身上自然有捞上来的东西，所以加一块旧附魔胸甲，绳具上配刻纹的铜件，都是打捞用的。
s6n_wilfried.battle: At the edge of the fissure, in the Sunken Barrel Company's salvage kit: the olive oilcloth coat belted tight, a grey enchanted breastplate hauled up from a river wreck strapped over it, one faint blue-white rune line along its edge; heavy leather gloves with salvaged brass knuckle plates; a harness of tarred rope around his waist, its brass pulley clamps etched with grip runes glowing faintly; both hands hauling a thick rope that runs off past the frame.

s6n_mona.why: 共鸣（LVL 23），一辈子没有凝名，下街筛面的姑娘。她做成的三件事没有一件靠本事，手里只提一盏灯，加甲会坏了这个人，照原句不改。
s6n_mona.battle: On the road to the fire in deep winter: a borrowed hooded grey-blue wool travelling cloak over the blue dress, a thick scarf, the apron still on with the wrapped bread in its pocket, wool mittens, boots wrapped with cloth; a small lantern held up in her right hand.

s6n_andai.why: 原页没写位阶，照酒棚女招待估作启源。这一格是她追着去立誓的赶路那一身，她不打仗，也不拿兵器，照原句不改。
s6n_andai.battle: Walking off after her man to swear the oath: a hooded deep red wool travelling cloak closing down the front with buttons over the brown dress, a scarf, sturdy boots, a small travel bundle in her left hand.

s6n_kuisi.why: 巨像那一夜凝名成了传奇，档照传奇给，家境不再算。她是碑匠，一身干活的衣裳去剥巨像，画花的围裙是故事里两边弓手都看见的东西，必须留着。所以只用最好的料子，样子照旧朴素，不加一点装饰。
s6n_kuisi.battle: On the colossus, in a carver's kit of the finest make and no ornament at all: the grey-blue apron tied tight, its canvas woven with faint white ward thread, rubbing papers in the hem pockets and the small white flower painted at the corner; the sleeves rolled; close-fitting dark mountain-copper plates at the knees and elbows where leather patches would be, engraved with thin white crack-runes; thick-soled boots. A heavy iron chisel in her left hand and the mallet raised in her right, white light branching from the chisel tip like flower stems; small golden flower patterns glow in her gold-brown eyes.

s6n_gunna.why: 传奇，家境不再算。她是炉城的矮人匠人，凝名那一夜穿的是工装，所以照炉城最好的手艺做，围裙面上缀余烬纹的黑铁鳞，扣具用蒸汽年代的铜件，样子还是干活的那一身，不加装饰。封炉锤和铜珠照留。
s6n_gunna.battle: On the cliff face, in plain forge-city work harness of the finest make, no ornament: the heavy leather apron faced with thin black iron scales whose seams glow ember-red, fastened with copper buckles; forge gauntlets of fine mountain-copper mesh; a climbing rope belted at her waist through brass steam-age clasps; iron-capped boots; the furnace-sealing hammer, a short-hafted heavy hammer with a squared iron head, in her right hand, the copper bead tucked into her collar; glowing copper rings around her wrists and golden-red stitch-lines of light running from the hammer head.

s6n_hagler.why: 传奇，家境不再算。他是枷匠氏，这一身照这一纪顶上的给，是他自己打的铁环胸甲和环片肩甲。绿外套是他的样子，照穿在外头。前臂缠着锁链，腕骨要透出光，所以只加护臂，上臂露着。
s6n_hagler.battle: Holding the train, in fetter-smith war harness of his own forging: under the cut-sleeve green coat belted tight a cuirass of thick interlocked black iron rings, its seams ember-lit; broad riveted ring-plate pauldrons on both shoulders; heavy black iron bracers etched with ring runes; long chains of interlocked iron rings wound round both forearms and running out of the frame, both arms stretched forward, blue-white ring-shaped light glowing from his wrist bones and deep blue cord-like veins standing on his arms; the feet shifting, never planted; a fierce, straining look.
